prompts.prompt:
Create a 15-second, 16:9, 24fps premium hand-drawn 2D fantasy tribal comedy.
STORY:
A beautiful young Antelope High Priestess Princess calmly patrols a bright tropical tribal village. She hears rustling behind her, turns, and discovers ONE enormous colorful python. She tries to stay dignified, makes eye contact with it, instantly panics, and runs away. While escaping, she brushes hanging vines and accidentally startles a small flock of tropical birds, turning the elegant scene into colorful chaos.
EMOTION:
REGAL → SUSPICIOUS → SHOCK → PANIC → RUN → CHAOS.
STYLE:
Premium animated feature-film quality, clean hand-drawn outlines, soft cel shading, vivid high-saturation colors.
Palette: deep peacock blue + cyan + sky blue environment, golden tribal architecture, small pink accents, white + turquoise + gold princess.
No photorealism, no 3D CGI, no dark or muddy grading.
CHARACTER:
Exactly ONE princess throughout.
Deep brown skin, long thin black braids, gold antelope headdress with EXACTLY TWO curved horns, turquoise forehead gem, white one-shoulder dress, peacock-blue belt, gold/turquoise jewelry.
She always carries the SAME ceremonial staff with circular top, turquoise crystal and white feather.
No face, costume, hairstyle, horn or staff changes.
ENVIRONMENT:
Simple tropical tribal village:
white waterfall in background,
golden thatched hut and cyan/gold totem on left,
cyan/gold temple with animal skull on right,
large blue tropical leaves in foreground.
TIMELINE:
0–3s: Princess stands calm and majestic. Slow push-in. She hears rustling behind her.
3–5s: She slowly turns, confused and alert.
5–7s: ONE turquoise-green/yellow python rises from vegetation BEHIND her.
7–8.5s: Princess foreground, python background. Eye contact. Brief comedy freeze.
8.5–10s: Reaction close-up. Her regal expression collapses into adorable panic. She spins and runs.
10–12s: Continuous LEFT → RIGHT side-tracking chase. Princess always ahead; python remains 2–4 meters behind.
12–13s: She brushes hanging vines. 6–10 colorful birds burst upward.
13–15s: Princess keeps running right, python behind, birds scattering upward. She ducks, nearly trips, recovers, looks at snake then birds in total disbelief. Princess exits right first, python shortly after.
STRICT:
Princess always in front, python always behind.
No overtaking, no side-by-side snake, no direction reversal, no teleportation, no extra humans, no duplicate princess, no second snake, no attack, bite, blood or horror.
Birds are startled only; they do not attack or chase.
ABSOLUTELY NO text, subtitles, logos, labels, numbers, UI, watermarks or readable writing.
Final look: beautiful mysterious first half → fast colorful comedic second half.

Photorealistic cinematic cozy 1990s-inspired American café, warm wooden interiors, red leather booths, chrome details, vintage coffee machines, large windows, soft morning sunlight, realistic customers, subtle handheld camera texture, rich lived-in detail, natural film grain. Use the provided reference image as the exact character lock for the girl. Preserve her facial identity, eye color, hairstyle, skin texture, body proportions, makeup, and outfit consistency throughout.
0–4s — [Medium Wide]
The girl sits peacefully at a café table enjoying her coffee and a slice of cake. She smiles toward the camera, takes a sip, then stands up to grab a napkin. As she turns, she accidentally bumps into a waiter carrying a large tray of coffees and pastries.
4–9s — [Dynamic Tracking → Super Slow Motion]
The collision sends everything flying. Coffee cups, pastries, whipped cream, spoons, and coffee droplets explode into the air. Suddenly, time freezes completely at the peak of the chaos. Every customer, the waiter, and every flying object remains perfectly suspended.
Only the girl can move.
She looks around in disbelief, slowly walks through the frozen coffee disaster, picks up one perfectly suspended croissant, looks directly into the camera, and casually takes a bite.
9–12s — [Smooth Tracking Shot]
She calmly walks toward the café exit while eating the croissant. Frozen coffee droplets sparkle in the sunlight around her. She casually fixes her hair and continues walking as if nothing happened.
12–15s — [Medium Close-Up]
Just as she reaches the door, time snaps back to normal. Cups crash onto tables, coffee splashes everywhere, pastries hit the floor, and the waiter reacts in shock. She turns toward the camera, raises her eyebrows, gives a tiny guilty smile and shrugs before walking out.
Ultra-realistic coffee and pastry physics, realistic liquid splashes, accurate gravity, believable reactions, precise time-freeze effect, cinematic camera orbit, natural facial expressions, realistic reflections, shallow depth of field, warm cinematic lighting, subtle film grain, movie-level temporal coherence, 4K HDR, 24fps, 16 9

prompts.prompt:
Create a 15-second, 16:9, 24fps ultra-photorealistic live-action Y2K fashion film blended with one pure 2D manga fairy.
HIGHEST-PRIORITY RULES
Exactly TWO characters: ONE fictional 22-year-old Korean female idol + ONE tiny 2D manga fairy. No extras, duplicates, clones, motion-trail copies, or identifiable reflections.
ZERO readable text or numbers anywhere: no captions, logos, labels, signs, UI, watermarks, license plates, posters, or environmental writing.
CHARACTER LOCK
Woman: elegant oval face, cool fair skin with realistic texture, almond eyes, glossy pink lips, extremely long silky straight black hair to the waist with thin bangs. Face, hair, proportions, makeup and wardrobe remain identical.
Wardrobe: black satin cropped camisole with lace detail, cropped glossy motorcycle jacket loosely around her arms, black low-rise pleated micro skirt, silver waist chain/jewelry, black over-the-knee boots. Premium, sensual, sophisticated K-pop editorial.
Fairy: tiny PURE 2D cel-shaded manga character with clean outlines, short black hair, elf ears, large pink eyes, pink-and-white cropped top, silver pleated skirt, translucent pink wings. Always flat 2D—never 3D, photorealistic, or humanized.
ENVIRONMENT
One continuous bright pink-and-ice-blue neon fashion studio. Black vintage convertible in the center, silver vanity mirror, transparent acrylic chair, chrome spheres, silver props, glossy floor. Style: K-pop comeback film × glossy Y2K campaign × cute high-energy MV.
PHYSICAL CONTINUITY
No teleportation, clipping, spawning, or passing through objects. Fairy must physically fly above, below, around, or beside the windshield, car, mirror, chair, props, and woman. Glossy surfaces show only abstract light, never recognizable reflections.

SHOT FLOW
0:00–0:01.5 — Low-angle wide shot. Only fairy is visible behind the wheel. She waves, opens wings on beat, flies vertically until fully above the windshield, exits through the open roof, half-spins, then flies toward the woman. Driver seat becomes empty.
0:01.5–0:03.5 — Reveal woman leaning outside the car door, looking down while adjusting a ring. Fairy curves toward her shoulder and gives a TA-DA pose. The same woman raises her head, looks at fairy, then camera. Diagonal push-in from headlight.
0:03.5–0:05.5 — Woman flicks one finger toward fairy on a sharp beat. Fairy reacts with one continuous half-spin to camera-right. Woman shifts into a mischievous smile. Fast side arc; car door briefly wipes foreground.
0:05.5–0:07.5 — Fairy flies around the OUTER edge of the vanity mirror, never through it. Camera follows and finds the same woman seated on the acrylic chair. She crosses her legs and makes a tiny finger heart. Fairy hovers beside her face and imitates it. Woman smiles.
0:07.5–0:09.5 — Woman opens her palm. Fairy descends continuously and visibly lands, feet making contact. Fairy poses proudly and copies woman’s head tilt. Woman pauses, then smiles warmly. Add a cute electronic bling; push from hand toward faces.
0:09.5–0:11.5 — Fairy physically takes off from palm first. Woman stands and walks 2–3 confident steps toward center studio. Camera tracks backward with a lateral arc while fairy flies backward in front of her.
0:11.5–0:13.0 — Woman strikes a sophisticated K-pop pose with convertible diagonally behind. She touches her long hair; fairy imitates fixing her own short hair. Woman notices and breaks into a smile. Slight low-angle push-in.
0:13.0–0:14.5 — Medium close-up. Woman makes a finger heart near her face while holding her hair. Fairy hovers beside her, wings open, cheerful double-V pose. Both look into camera. Final beat triggers ONE camera flash without washing out the studio.
0:14.5–0:15.0 — Freeze the ACTUAL previous frame. No new photo, card, border, or white background. Keep neon studio, car, silver props and depth visible. Add only 4–6 small clean pink hearts/stars/sparkles near the corners, inside frame, never covering either character.
CAMERA & PERFORMANCE
Use low angles, diagonal views, subtle ultra-wide shots, foreground occlusion, mirror framing, curved push-ins, short tracking, gentle rises/drops. Avoid repetitive static frontal framing.
Emotion: cool fashion pose → curiosity → playful interaction → amused smile → joyful final pose. Natural, confident, star-like, never childish.
MUSIC
Bubblegum Pop × Kawaii Pop × Y2K Dance Pop, 125–135 BPM, punchy drums, bouncing bass, crisp claps, sparkling synths. Sync wing opening, finger flick, fairy spin, finger-heart, palm landing, takeoff, hair imitation, final pose and camera flash to major beats.
NEGATIVE
No second human/fairy, duplicates, face drift, hairstyle/color/costume changes, malformed hands, clipping, teleportation, 3D or photorealistic fairy, white ending, Polaroid/frame/PIP, chaotic doodles, readable text, letters, numbers, logos, subtitles, labels, UI or watermarks.

prompts.prompt: A cinematic creation film follows one maker reconstructing the main subject shown in the referenced image completely from scratch. The referenced image defines the finished subject’s complete visible appearance, proportions, structure, materials, colors, clothing or surface details, and distinctive features; ignore its background, framing, lighting, and unrelated elements.  Begin directly on an empty, clean virtual workbench. Use a stable front three-quarter overhead view that keeps the developing subject readable. There is one maker throughout, represented by the same consistent left and right hands and forearms. Show no more than two hands at once.  From 0 to 14 seconds, the entire creation unfolds as a clearly accelerated timelapse with rapid, purposeful hand movement and restrained motion blur. Short jump cuts compress repetitive manual work only after each action has visibly completed. Every cut inherits the exact form and progress left by the previous action.  0-2 seconds: One hand enters already holding the first foundation material, armature, or base element appropriate to the referenced subject and places it at the center. The second hand steadies it as the maker establishes the initial supporting form.  2-8 seconds: The maker rapidly develops the subject’s major structure and volumes using one coherent creation method appropriate to what the referenced image depicts. A living subject is sculpted as one continuous, non-gory digital form from armature to anatomy; a vehicle or machine is built from chassis to functional structure; an object is formed or assembled from its supporting body outward. Each additional material or component enters from outside the frame while firmly held by one of the maker’s hands, is carried to its destination, and remains under hand control until attached or shaped.  8-12 seconds: The same hands develop the recognizable outer form and reference-specific features. The maker sculpts, fits, wraps, stitches, fastens, carves, or polishes only where appropriate to the subject. Facial features, hair, clothing, body panels, wheels, glass, surfaces, accessories, or equivalent defining elements emerge through visible hand and tool contact, never through spontaneous transformation.  12-14 seconds: The maker refines proportions, edges, joints, surface transitions, textures, colors, and distinctive details until the developing subject closely matches the referenced image. One hand stabilizes the form while the other performs each final adjustment with a hand-held tool.  14-15 seconds: The maker removes the last tool by hand and withdraws both hands. The timelapse returns to normal speed as the camera makes a restrained push toward the completed subject and holds on a clean final view.  Materials and components do not need to be visible before use, but anything newly introduced must enter the frame already held by one of the maker’s hands. Nothing moves, assembles, appears, disappears, or changes material independently. Maintain one maker, one continuous subject, one creation position, and one category-appropriate construction method. No assistants, extra hands, detached anatomy, duplicated elements, magical morphing, drawing phase, software interface, cursor, menus, annotations, or text overlays.

prompts.prompt:
30 seconds | 16:9 | Ultra-photorealistic live-action
Create a natural Korean summer day-in-the-life video featuring one young Korean man spending a quiet afternoon preparing a simple chilled fruit snack at home.
Use the reference image only for his exact facial identity, hairstyle, skin tone, and body proportions. Keep his appearance consistent throughout the entire video.
OUTFIT: Lightweight pale-yellow short-sleeve shirt, loose white cotton pants, simple canvas shoulder bag, clean white low-profile sneakers, minimal silver watch. Outfit remains unchanged from beginning to end.
TIME & LIGHTING: Warm late-afternoon summer sunlight. Consistent weather, shadows, color temperature, and time of day across every scene.
00–05s — Neighborhood walk
He leaves a small Korean apartment building carrying his canvas shoulder bag and walks down a quiet residential street.
Trees move gently in the summer breeze. Parked scooters, apartment entrances, utility poles, bicycles, parked cars, and distant pedestrians create an authentic Korean neighborhood atmosphere.
The camera naturally follows him as he walks.
He briefly looks toward the camera and casually says:
“I need something refreshing today.”
His expression is relaxed and natural, not posed.
05–10s — Local fruit stand
He arrives at a small neighborhood fruit shop with crates of peaches, grapes, melons, Korean pears, and other seasonal fruit.
Instead of immediately choosing something, he slowly walks around comparing the fruit.
He notices a basket of ripe peaches, picks one up carefully, examines its surface, smells it, and gives a subtle satisfied smile.
The shop owner casually says something off-camera.
He responds naturally:
“This one looks perfect.”
He places several peaches into his canvas shoulder bag.
10–15s — Walking home
He walks back through the neighborhood carrying the slightly heavier bag.
The camera follows naturally from behind and then moves alongside him.
He adjusts the shoulder bag against his body as the peaches shift naturally inside.
A bicycle passes in the background.
Leaves move gently in the breeze. His hair moves subtly with the air.
His walking pace and body movements remain completely natural and unscripted.
15–21s — Apartment kitchen
He enters his apartment kitchen and places the peaches carefully on the counter.
He turns on the faucet and rinses them under cool running water.
Water droplets collect on the peaches and fall naturally into the sink.
He picks up one peach, dries it with a clean kitchen towel, and places it onto a small ceramic plate.
The apartment feels modest, lived-in, and realistic rather than professionally designed.
21–26s — Preparing the snack
He sits at the kitchen counter.
Using a small kitchen knife, he carefully slices the peach in half.
The knife encounters realistic resistance before passing through the soft fruit.
He removes the pit, cuts several thin slices, and casually arranges them on the plate.
Close-up of realistic peach texture, moisture, juice, and small imperfections in the fruit.
His hands and fingers move naturally and accurately.
26–30s — First bite
He picks up one peach slice and takes his first bite.
He pauses briefly, enjoys the flavor, smiles naturally, and quietly says:
“So good.”
He looks toward the nearby window as warm sunlight falls across the kitchen.
The camera slowly drifts backward, capturing the cozy kitchen, open window, gentle curtain movement, and quiet late-summer atmosphere.
Cut naturally at the end.
CAMERA STYLE: Documentary lifestyle footage with smooth handheld movement. Natural tracking shots, occasional subtle camera sway, realistic focus transitions, restrained depth of field, natural lens behavior, and authentic perspective. Avoid overly cinematic shots or commercial advertising aesthetics.
AUDIO: Real environmental audio only — distant neighborhood sounds, footsteps, bicycle passing, casual fruit-shop conversation, plastic bags, fruit being handled, apartment door, running water, knife against cutting board, refrigerator hum, subtle curtain movement, breathing, and natural eating sounds. No background music.
PHYSICAL REALISM: The shoulder bag reacts naturally to the weight of the fruit. Peaches shift according to gravity and momentum. Hands maintain believable grip and pressure. Water flows naturally. Knife movement shows realistic cutting resistance. All body movements, walking, reaching, lifting, sitting, washing, cutting, and eating should feel spontaneous and physically accurate.
CONTINUITY: Same man, facial identity, hairstyle, body proportions, outfit, bag, fruit, apartment, kitchen, weather, lighting, and time of day throughout. No unexplained object changes.
NEGATIVE PROMPT: No CGI look, synthetic skin, beauty filter, excessive sharpening, HDR, artificial blur, unrealistic depth of field, robotic movement, weightless objects, floating fruit, impossible hand positions, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, face drift, character replacement, wardrobe changes, hairstyle changes, teleportation, instant cutting, duplicated people, inconsistent shadows, sudden weather changes, excessive wind, text, subtitles, logos, watermark, background music, commercial advertisement style.

@Hailuo_AI
@midjourney

----

[Prompt / Minimax H3]
※WORD 1〜5の英単語、自由に変えてください。

A 15-second editorial fashion film / fashion magazine commercial. Fast, stylish, contemporary, and visually bold. The film should feel like a rush of sharp fragments rather than a quiet portrait montage. Prioritize visual quality, movement, and editorial design above everything.

Use the reference images as live visual material for face presence, fashion language, silhouette, surface texture, and mood, but do not recreate them as frozen portraits. Transform them into a living fashion film.

Core rules:
- The people must feel real first: breathing, blinking, gaze shifts, weight shifts, shoulders, fingertips, and mouth corners should always be alive.
- No doll-like stillness, no paper-doll motion.
- Every performer should have a distinct personality readable through movement, gaze, breathing, reaction speed, hand habits, posture, and expression.
- Poses must be strong and clearly modeled, like fashion-model poses.
- Cuts must be fast.
- No shot should last longer than 2 seconds.
- Scenes should change constantly, like a rush of sharp momentary fragments.
- Use split-screen often enough to matter, with left and right sides acting on different intentions and never fully synchronized.
- Keep the camera constantly moving: push-in, pull-out, orbiting, oblique travel, occlusion, depth shifts, and rapid reframing.
- Use expressive transitions: flash cuts, match cuts, reverse flips, shutter-like wipes, split-screen interruptions, and speed-based continuity.
- Avoid boring fades, boring slides, and quiet portrait sequences.

Performer directions:
- Performer 1: cold observer, restrained, gaze leads the motion.
- Performer 2: ritual-like, hand-driven, meaningful interaction with clothing or props.
- Performer 3: model-like, visual anchor, confident center presence.
- Performer 4: trembling, breathable, delayed reactions, human softness.

Subtle fashion gestures:
Each performer should include subtle expressive fashion gestures as accents:
- licking a finger
- touching the cheek or chest
- brushing hair back
- blowing a soft breath toward the camera
- winking
- kiss-like motion
- gaze-play

Keep the tone chic, suggestive, and editorial rather than explicit.

Typography:
- English typography only.
- The typography should feel like a designer logo system or a world-building mark, not subtitles.
- It should behave like a continuous organism across the entire video: stretching, wrapping, splitting, colliding, trailing, slipping in front of and behind people, crossing cuts, and remaining present as an integrated graphic force.
- Prioritize aesthetic motion and graphic presence over perfect readability.
- The text may be abstracted, symbolic, geometric, and design-forward.

Use words related to the project theme, such as:
[WORD 1], [WORD 2], [WORD 3], [WORD 4], [WORD 5]

Overall feel:
A chic fashion magazine commercial with runway energy, crossed with an editorial visual language.
The final video should feel like distinct personalities moving through one editorial world, with living typography cutting through the frame like a second organism.
Strong, modern, editorial, with a little strange beauty and controlled unease.

prompts.prompt:
ULTRA REALISTIC 15 SECOND PERSONAL HOME VIDEO. 1080p render of 4:3 early 2000s MiniDV tape footage. Single continuous handheld take, no cuts. Dialogue driven, Hinglish. Title: THE FRINGE.

CONCEPT
She just got a fringe cut and immediately regrets it. Her friend films her checking herself in a shop mirror instead of reassuring her. The clip ends before she decides how she feels.

SUBJECT LOCK
Indian woman, early twenties, warm medium brown skin, realistic pores, faint under eye shadow, minimal makeup. Dark brown hair loosely tied back with a freshly cut blunt fringe sitting slightly too short and too straight on her forehead, loose cut hairs still on her shoulders. Oversized cream knit sweater with stretched cuffs, blue jeans, white sneakers scuffed at the toe, small canvas shoulder bag across the body. Same face, hair and outfit for the full 15 seconds. Fidgeting, pushing the fringe left then right.

SECOND VOICE LOCK
The friend holding the camcorder is never seen, not a hand, not a shadow. Voice only, young female, close to the mic, deadpan. Never addresses an audience.

SETTING
Narrow front room of a small neighbourhood salon, late afternoon. Wall mirror with a chipped frame, a swivel chair, combs in a jar, a plastic cape draped over the chair back, a pedestal fan turning, sunlight coming in flat through an open doorway. Lived in and unstyled. No visible brands, no logos, no readable signage.

CAMERA
Raw handheld MiniDV camcorder held at chest height from behind and to the side, so most of her face is seen only in the mirror reflection. Autofocus hunting between her actual head and the reflection, never settling. Exposure pumping between the bright doorway and the dim interior. One unmotivated zoom into the mirror that goes soft. Framing crooked, her head near the top edge. Tape noise, interlace combing, one dropout glitch. No stabilization, no gimbal.

BEATS
0:00 to 0:04 She leans into the mirror, lifts the fringe with two fingers and drops it, already unhappy.
0:04 to 0:09 The exchange, quick, overlapping, both half laughing.
0:09 to 0:12 Dead air. She stops touching it and just looks at herself. Nobody speaks for three full seconds, only the fan.
0:12 to 0:15 She turns to face the camera for the first time, says the last line, does not wait for an answer, tape cuts.

DIALOGUE
Hinglish code switching, natural overlapping delivery, flat and unprojected.
0:04 She says Sach batao, kaisa lag raha hai
0:06 Friend off camera says Sach sach?
0:07 She says Ruko, mat batao
0:12 She says Grow to ho hi jayega na
Visible mouth movement with bilabial closure on m, b and p. Friend lines off camera only, closer to the mic.

AUDIO
Diegetic only. Pedestal fan oscillating, scissors clinking into a tray, a scooter passing the open door, a chair squeak, her sleeve brushing the mirror, faint hand noise on the camcorder. No music, no score, no added ambience beds.

STYLE RULES
Nothing dramatic happens. No posing, no makeover reveal energy, no hero framing, no beauty lighting. Realism comes from the awkward laugh and the dead air. If she performs for the lens the illusion breaks.

NEGATIVE
No music. No subtitles. No captions. No watermark. No timestamp. No slow motion. No color grading. No lens flare. No shallow depth of field. No visible second person. No brand logos. No readable text.

LAST FRAME
Her half turned toward the lens, fringe uneven, frame crooked and slightly underexposed, one frame of tape tear, hard cut to black. Absolutely no on screen text, no title card, no lettering, no numbers, no logo, no signage of any kind in the final frame.

prompts.prompt:
ULTRA REALISTIC 15 SECOND PERSONAL HOME VIDEO. 1080p render of 4:3 early 2000s MiniDV tape footage. Single continuous handheld take, no cuts. Dialogue driven, Hinglish. Title: EK MOMBATTI.

CONCEPT
A birthday with no cake. One candle stuck into a pastry from the corner shop, lights switched off in a small room, one friend filming and singing badly. Twelve seconds later the lights are back on and it is over.

SUBJECT LOCK
Indian woman, early twenties, warm medium brown skin, realistic pores, minimal makeup, face lit almost entirely by a single candle flame from below so the shadows are unflattering and the highlights blow out. Dark brown hair loosely tied back with strands falling loose. Oversized cream knit sweater with stretched cuffs, blue jeans, white sneakers scuffed at the toe. Same face, hair and outfit for the full 15 seconds. Sitting cross legged on the floor, embarrassed, hands in her sleeves.

SECOND VOICE LOCK
The friend holding the camcorder is never seen, not a hand, not a shadow. Voice only, young female, close to the mic, singing off key with no shame. Never addresses an audience.

SETTING
Small rented room at night with the ceiling light switched off. A single pastry on a steel plate on the floor with one thin candle in it, a mattress on the floor, a plastic chair with clothes on it, a curtain with street light leaking around the edge. Lived in and unstyled. No visible brands, no logos, no readable signage, no decorations.

CAMERA
Raw handheld MiniDV camcorder held low and close, sitting on the floor across from her. Severe exposure pumping in near darkness, the candle flame blooming into a smeared vertical streak, her face crushed to noise then recovering. Autofocus hunting constantly and never locking. One clumsy zoom in on the candle. Heavy low light tape grain, interlace combing, one dropout glitch. No stabilization, no gimbal.

BEATS
0:00 to 0:05 She is sitting in the dark behind the candle looking mildly embarrassed while the friend sings the birthday song off key. No lyrics needed, humming and improvised words.
0:05 to 0:09 The exchange about the wish, quick, overlapping, both laughing.
0:09 to 0:12 She blows the candle out. Total darkness on tape for two full seconds, only sound, image reduced to noise and a faint window edge. Nobody bothers to fix it.
0:12 to 0:15 The ceiling light snaps on, the frame blows out white then settles on her squinting, and the tape cuts.

DIALOGUE
Hinglish code switching, natural overlapping delivery, flat and unprojected.
0:05 She says Wish kya karun
0:06 Friend off camera says Bata mat, warna nahi hoga
0:08 She says Nahi bata rahi, chill
0:13 Friend off camera says Light on kar diya, sorry
Visible mouth movement with bilabial closure on m, b and p while she is lit. Friend lines off camera only, closer to the mic. The birthday singing is improvised humming, not a quoted song.

AUDIO
Diegetic only. Off key singing very close to the mic, a ceiling fan, the plate shifting on the floor, her breath blowing out the candle, a light switch click, a scooter outside, a neighbour's television, faint hand noise on the camcorder. No music, no score, no added ambience beds.

STYLE RULES
Nothing dramatic happens. No posing, no celebration montage, no hero framing, no warm candle glamour lighting. Realism comes from the bad singing, the two seconds of black, and the harsh light at the end. If she performs for the lens the illusion breaks.

NEGATIVE
No music. No subtitles. No captions. No watermark. No timestamp. No slow motion. No color grading. No lens flare. No shallow depth of field. No visible second person. No brand logos. No readable text.

LAST FRAME
Her squinting into the newly switched on ceiling light, overexposed and off center, smoke still rising from the candle, one frame of tape tear, hard cut to black. Absolutely no on screen text, no title card, no lettering, no numbers, no logo, no signage of any kind in the final frame.

prompts.prompt:
ULTRA REALISTIC 15 SECOND PERSONAL HOME VIDEO. 1080p 16:9 widescreen render of mid 1990s Hi8 camcorder tape footage. Single continuous handheld take, no cuts. Dialogue driven, Korean. Title: GASOLINE DREAMS.

CONCEPT
1997. A borrowed car at a rural highway petrol station outside Seoul, dusk in late autumn. Three hours still to drive. She is waiting for the tank to fill and her friend is filming instead of reading the map. Nothing happens. The tape is just running.

SUBJECT LOCK
Korean woman, early twenties. Realistic skin with visible pores, faint under eye shadow, minimal makeup, nose and ears pink from the cold, breath faintly visible. Dark brown hair loosely tied back, front strands loose, flattened on one side from sleeping against the car window. Oversized cream knit sweater with stretched cuffs pulled down over her hands, blue jeans, white sneakers scuffed at the toe. Same face, hair and outfit for the full 15 seconds. Slouched, stiff from sitting, stretching her back.

SECOND VOICE LOCK
The friend holding the camcorder is never seen, not a hand, not a shadow, not a reflection in the car glass. Voice only, young female, close to the mic, sleepy and unbothered. Never addresses an audience. A station attendant in a padded work jacket is visible at a distance but never speaks.

SETTING
Small rural petrol station on a two lane highway outside Seoul, late autumn dusk, 1997. Two pumps under a concrete canopy with one flickering fluorescent tube, a stack of oil cans, a plastic stool, a beige sedan with the fuel flap open and the passenger door hanging open. Beyond the canopy, bare rice paddies, a line of poplars, low grey hills, a truck passing, sky going orange to deep blue. Lived in and unstyled. No visible brands, no logos, no readable signage, no Hangul text anywhere in frame.

FRAMING
16:9 widescreen throughout, treated as a later widescreen transfer of the original tape. The extra width is used badly, not compositionally. She sits low and off to one side with dead empty space filling the other half of the frame. Horizon slightly tilted. Nothing centred on purpose.

CAMERA
Raw handheld Hi8 camcorder at chest height, operator leaning on the car. Autofocus hunting between the pump, the car glass and her face, repeatedly grabbing the wrong thing. Exposure pumping hard as the lens drifts from the bright sky to the shade under the canopy. One lazy unmotivated zoom that overshoots past her shoulder and corrects. She drifts out of frame once and the operator is late to follow. Analogue tape noise, chroma bleed on the orange sky, mild tracking wobble at the frame edges, one dropout glitch. No stabilization, no gimbal, no cinematic choreography.

BEATS
0:00 to 0:04 She climbs out of the passenger door mid stretch, arms up, yawning, and walks toward the pump. The camera swings after her too slowly and catches empty canopy for a beat.
0:04 to 0:08 She stands at the open fuel flap watching the numbers on the pump. The exchange, overlapping, both half laughing.
0:08 to 0:12 Dead air. She sits sideways on the car bonnet, feet not reaching the ground, a hot can held against her cheek, watching a truck pass. Nobody speaks for four full seconds. The fluorescent tube flickers.
0:12 to 0:15 A horn from the road. She slides off the bonnet, says the last line without turning around, and the camera is still pointed at the empty bonnet when the tape cuts.

DIALOGUE
Spoken language locked to Korean, casual banmal between friends, flat and unprojected, thinned by the camcorder mic.
0:05 She says Gadeuk chaewoya dwae, apeuro amugeotdo eopseo
0:07 Friend off camera says Neo don isseo
0:08 She says Dangyeonhi eopji
0:13 She says Gaja, got eoduwojinda
Visible mouth movement with bilabial closure on the m, b and p sounds. Friend line off camera only, closer to the mic. No other speech, no narration.

AUDIO
Diegetic only. Fuel pump motor humming, nozzle clicking off, fluorescent ballast buzz, a truck passing with a doppler horn, wind across open paddies, a can tab, her sneakers on grit, faint hand noise on the camcorder body. No music, no score, no radio, no added ambience beds.

STYLE RULES
Nothing dramatic happens on purpose. No posing, no road trip montage energy, no wind in hair, no golden hour beauty lighting, no hero framing. Realism comes from the cold, the flat delivery and the four seconds of dead air nobody bothered to cut. She is talking to her friend, not to viewers. If she performs for the lens the illusion breaks.

NEGATIVE
No music. No subtitles. No captions. No watermark. No timestamp burn in. No slow motion. No colour grading. No lens flare. No shallow depth of field. No visible second person. No brand logos. No readable text.

LAST FRAME

prompts.prompt:
ULTRA REALISTIC 15 SECOND PERSONAL HOME VIDEO. 1080p render of 4:3 early 2000s MiniDV tape footage. Single continuous handheld take, no cuts. Sung Hindi vocal, diegetic performance. Title: TERI AADAT.

CONCEPT
Dusk on a terrace. A young man plays an old acoustic guitar sitting on the parapet, and the young woman sings along with him, badly and happily, halfway through a verse. Their friend is filming on a camcorder from a few feet away. It is a love song but nobody is performing a love song, they are just two people killing an evening and the tape happened to be running.

SUBJECT LOCK ONE
Indian woman, early twenties, warm medium brown skin. Realistic skin with visible pores, faint under eye shadow, minimal makeup, slight shine on the forehead in the low sun. Dark brown hair loosely tied back with strands pulling loose in the wind. Oversized cream knit sweater with stretched cuffs, blue jeans, white sneakers scuffed at the toe. Same face, same hair, same outfit held identically for the full 15 seconds. Sitting cross legged on a folded mat, knees tucked, unposed and slightly slouched.

SUBJECT LOCK TWO
Indian man, early twenties, medium brown skin, short unstyled hair, faint stubble. Faded olive shirt with sleeves pushed to the elbows, dark jeans, worn sandals. Sitting on the low parapet with a scratched acoustic guitar across his lap, head down watching his own fingers, glancing up at her twice.

SETTING
Open concrete terrace of an older residential building, autumn evening. Low parapet with peeling paint, a black water tank, a sagging clothesline with nothing on it, dry leaves in one corner. Beyond the parapet, a dense low rise neighbourhood of flat roofs, cables and water tanks, hazy warm sun almost down. Lived in and unstyled. No visible brands, no logos, no readable signage anywhere in frame.

CAMERA
Raw handheld MiniDV camcorder held by a friend sitting a few feet away, angle slightly low and off center. Autofocus hunting between the guitar strings and her face. Exposure pumping as the lens drifts toward the bright sky and back down. One slow unmotivated zoom in on her, overshooting so her forehead is cropped, then correcting. Framing keeps both of them in shot but never composes them nicely. Mild tape noise, interlace combing on fast movement, one brief tape dropout glitch. No stabilization, no gimbal, no cinematic choreography, no rack focus.

BEATS
0:00 to 0:04 He is already mid strum. She listens with her chin on her knee, mouthing the words before she commits to singing them.
0:04 to 0:10 She sings the first two lines properly, off pitch on the second, and laughs at herself without stopping. He keeps playing and grins down at the guitar.
0:10 to 0:13 She sings the last two lines quieter, watching him instead of the camera. He looks up at her once. Neither reacts, no kiss, no held gaze, they both look away.
0:13 to 0:15 The guitar rings out unresolved, she pulls her sleeve over her hand, wind hits the mic, tape cuts.

VOCAL AND LYRICS
Original composition, not an existing song. Spoken and sung language locked to Hindi. Single female voice, untrained, close and unmixed, sung at conversational volume.
0:04 Dheere dheere shaam dhalti hai
0:07 Kuch bhi nahi kehna aaj
0:10 Teri aadat si ho gayi hai
0:12 Rehne de, bas yahi theek hai
Precise lipsync to the sung line, bilabial closure on the m, b and p sounds, jaw and throat movement consistent with singing rather than speaking. Slight breath before each line. No harmony, no second voice, no backing vocal.

AUDIO
Diegetic only. The acoustic guitar visible in frame is the only instrument, recorded on the camcorder mic so it is thin and boxy. Her voice, wind across the terrace clipping the mic, guitar body knocks, crows, a distant pressure horn, a television faint from a floor below, faint hand noise on the camcorder body. No studio track, no backing music, no reverb, no score, no added ambience beds.

STYLE RULES
Nothing dramatic happens on purpose. No lip biting, no slow motion hair, no romantic staging, no golden hour beauty lighting, no lingering eye contact, no music video choreography. The romance is only in the fact that neither of them looks at the camera. Realism comes from the off pitch line, the imperfect framing, and the unresolved chord at the end. If either of them performs for the lens the illusion breaks.

NEGATIVE
No music track. No subtitles. No captions. No watermark. No timestamp burn in. No slow motion. No color grading. No lens flare. No shallow depth of field. No crowd. No third visible person. No brand logos. No readable text.

LAST FRAME
Wide slightly crooked frame of both of them on the terrace with the sun gone and the sky flat blue, image tears with one frame of tape distortion, then hard cut to black. Absolutely no on screen text, no title card, no lettering, no numbers, no logo, no signage of any kind in the final frame.

prompts.prompt:
FORMAT: 15 seconds | 9:16 vertical | Ultra-photorealistic smartphone vlog | Real-world Tokyo at night

CHARACTER LOCK
Use the attached girl as the exact character and identity reference throughout the entire video. Preserve her recognizable facial features, face shape, warm skin tone, brown eyes, natural makeup, soft features, and dark brown hair styled in a messy high bun with loose strands framing her face.
She is an adult woman with a natural, approachable travel-vlogger appearance.

OUTFIT LOCK

Match the outfit shown in the storyboard:

Cream-colored knit top

Light beige lightweight jacket, worn open

Charcoal/dark gray straight-leg trousers

Clean white sneakers
Small silver hoop earrings
Simple silver wristwatch
Minimal accessories
Natural, understated makeup
The hairstyle, face, outfit, accessories and overall appearance must remain identical across all six storyboard scenes.
00–04s — RUNNING FOR IT
Handheld selfie footage on a crowded Tokyo street at night.

The girl from the attached reference walks quickly toward the camera, slightly out of breath. Her beige jacket moves naturally as she walks.

Bright Tokyo signs, storefronts, pedestrians and traffic create an authentic nighttime city background.

She looks directly into the phone camera and laughs:

“Wait—my train leaves in two minutes!”

She quickly turns the phone forward and starts jogging toward the station.

04–08s — THE STATION

Handheld camera follows her from behind and slightly beside her as she rushes down the station stairs.

Her messy brown bun and beige jacket remain clearly recognizable.

She reaches the ticket gate, taps her transit card and quickly passes through.

The phone camera shakes naturally from her movement and briefly loses autofocus.

08–12s — MADE IT

She reaches the platform just as the train arrives.

The camera captures the approaching train headlights before returning to her face.

She steps inside, turns the phone toward herself and smiles while catching her breath.

She says:

“I actually made it!”

The train doors close behind her.

12–15s — TOKYO THROUGH THE WINDOW

Inside the train, she turns the phone toward the window.

Tokyo's illuminated buildings and streets naturally blur past as the train accelerates.

Her face appears softly reflected in the glass.

She looks toward the city and quietly says:

“Okay… Tokyo at night hits different.”

Natural cut.

REALISM & CHARACTER CONSISTENCY

Same attached girl in every shot. No character changes.

Maintain the exact:

Facial identity

Brown eyes

Dark brown messy high bun

Loose face-framing hair strands
Skin tone
Facial proportions
Cream knit top
Beige jacket
Charcoal trousers
White sneakers
Silver earrings
Wristwatch
Natural skin texture, realistic hair strands, authentic blinking, subtle facial expressions and believable body movement.
No outfit changes, no hairstyle changes, no different woman, no face morphing, no beauty-filter effect.

VISUAL STYLE
Authentic handheld smartphone footage rather than a polished movie.

Natural motion blur, autofocus hunting, slight exposure shifts, realistic low-light phone noise, imperfect framing, natural Tokyo crowds and physically accurate movement.

No cinematic transitions, no fantasy effects, no exaggerated neon, no artificial-looking skin, no duplicated people, no impossible camera movement.

AUDIO
Natural Tokyo ambience, footsteps, station announcements, crowd noise, train brakes, door chime and her real voice.

No background music, no subtitles, no watermark.

【角色】Anna @图片1（全片唯一角色）。五官、脸型、身形严格锁定参考图，变装前后不漂移。

【景别与机位基准】固定机位，略低角度（相机高度约在坐姿时膝盖位置、微微仰拍），椅子居画面中央偏右，左侧大面积逆光窗帘过曝形成高光留白，右侧深色木质墙面和暗色窗帘压暗，形成强烈的明暗对比（Chiaroscuro Lighting）。全片机位不移动、不推拉摇移。

【核心变装机制：抛鞋→踢腿】
道具触发变装——Anna 坐在椅子上把一只黑色高跟凉鞋向上一抛，鞋子离手还在空中上升的那一帧硬切（Hard Cut）→ 下一帧她已经穿好全套造型，右腿猛地向上一甩踢向镜头、鞋底正对镜头（鞋子已经穿在脚上），踢腿和抛鞋形成一对跨越剪辑的镜像动作——"抛出去的鞋，下一帧就穿在了脚上"。踢腿后右腿缓缓收回，跷成二郎腿坐定。变装前后椅子位置、机位、光线完全一致，只有人物的穿着和姿态整个换掉。

[00:00-00:01.5] 镜头1：空椅子·悬念开场（Establishing Shot）
画面：酒店房间内，左侧落地窗透过白色薄纱窗帘漫进大片柔和白光（窗帘过曝），右侧深色木质竖条纹护墙板和深灰色厚窗帘形成暗部。画面中央偏右一把黑色哑光金属框架扶手椅（黑色皮质坐垫），椅子空着，右上角墙上隐约可见一幅装裱画的边角。深灰色哑光地板。
画面里没有人——空椅子制造悬念。

[00:01.5-00:02.5] 镜头2：入场·浴袍登场（Character Entrance）
Anna 从画面右侧走入镜头，赤脚踩在深灰色地板上。她穿着白色酒店浴袍（厚实毛巾布料质感、腰间系带打结、左胸口绣有酒店首字母），头上裹着白色浴巾扎成高高的包头巾（turban），脸上已经画好全妆——正红色哑光唇膏（红唇是全画面唯一的高饱和色彩点）、精致眉眼。双手捧着一双黑色绑带高跟凉鞋（细带交叉款，鞋跟约8厘米）放在腰间。
她面对镜头走到椅子前方站定，表情冷淡从容，嘴唇微微抿起，下巴微微抬高，眼神直视镜头——"给我几秒钟"的自信态度。

[00:02.5-00:04.5] 镜头3：落座·把玩高跟鞋（Seated Tease）
Anna 转身坐到黑色扶手椅上，浴袍下摆散开，赤足的双腿自然并拢垂在椅子前方。她把两只黑色高跟鞋放在膝盖上，双手握住鞋子，低头审视。
表情：微微垂眼看着手中的鞋，嘴角不笑、红唇轻抿，带着一种"我在挑选武器"的挑剔和笃定。
动作细节：她把两只鞋分开，左手一只右手一只，轻轻掂了掂重量，手指拨弄鞋面的黑色细带。

[00:04.0-00:04.5] 镜头4：抛鞋·变装触发（The Throw）
Anna 右手握住一只黑色高跟鞋，手腕一翻、向上一抛——鞋子脱手飞向空中，黑色细带在空中散开甩动。左手同时还握着另一只鞋。
表情：抛鞋瞬间眼睛微微闭上，红唇轻抿，下巴微扬，一副"就这样吧"的随意。
鞋子离手、还在空中上升的那一帧——**硬切（Hard Cut）**

[00:04.5-00:05.5] 镜头5：踢腿亮鞋·变装完成（The Kick Reveal）
硬切之后，Anna 依然坐在同一把黑色扶手椅上，但整个人焕然一新：
穿着：白色浴袍和包头巾消失，头发放下来自然散落（hair down）。妆容比变装前更精致——眉形利落、眼妆深邃带微光、正红色哑光唇膏依旧，整体是高端时尚大片级别的妆面质感。身穿黑色无袖高领修身连衣裙（halter-neck mini dress，面料紧贴身体轮廓、裙摆到大腿中段），双腿穿着黑色薄透丝袜（sheer black tights，织纹细腻可见），脚上穿着刚才手里那双黑色绑带高跟凉鞋（细带交叉绑到脚踝上方）。
关键动作：硬切的第一帧，右腿猛地向上甩踢，整条腿斜着踢向镜头方向——高跟鞋鞋底正对镜头、占据画面中央，鞋底的皮质纹理清晰可见。这一踢和上一帧的抛鞋动作形成跨越剪辑的因果呼应："刚才抛出去的鞋，这一帧已经穿在脚上了。"
表情：踢腿瞬间目光斜睨镜头，眉梢微挑，红唇微启——冷飒的"准备好了"。
随后右腿缓缓从高处收回，优雅地跷在左腿上（二郎腿），身体微微向左后方靠进椅背，左手手指搭在左侧扶手边缘——慵懒、松弛、掌控一切的坐姿。

[00:05.5-00:10.0] 镜头6：慵懒女王·时尚大片（Slow Fashion Pose）
接下来4.5秒内，Anna 在椅子上做一组极慢的时尚大片姿态变换（Fashion Editorial Posing），每个动作之间自然衔接、一镜到底没有剪辑：
① 二郎腿跷腿姿势稳定，目光从镜头缓缓移向左侧窗帘方向，侧脸轮廓被逆光勾勒出金色边缘光；
② 右手从扶手上缓缓抬起，五指微张在空中做了一个轻柔的"弹指/拨弄"手势，手指骨节分明；
③ 右手继续向上，指尖触到右侧肩旁的一缕发丝，轻轻捻起发梢向外拉出一小段，发丝在指间缠绕；
④ 头微微向右后方仰，闭上眼睛约0.5秒，红唇微启，发丝从指间滑落；
⑤ 缓缓睁眼，目光重新对准镜头，嘴角带出一丝极淡的微笑——但只有嘴角，眼神依然是冷的。右手回落到扶手上。
画面在这个"冷眼微笑"的定格中自然结束。

【音效】
前半段（00:00-05:30）：安静的酒店房间环境音底噪——远处隐约的城市嗡鸣、空调低频运转。叠加：赤脚踩地板的轻柔脚步声、浴袍布料摩擦的窸窣声、鞋子被拿起和翻转时皮革与金属扣的轻微碰击声。
硬切瞬间（05:30）：一声干脆利落的低频鼓点"咚"（Kick Drum Hit），标记变装切点。
后半段（05:30-10:00）：慵懒的电子氛围音乐缓缓铺开（Lo-fi Chill / Downtempo），节奏极慢，配合Anna 的慢动作姿态。叠加：丝袜面料在交叉腿时的轻微摩擦声、高跟鞋跟在换姿势时轻轻碰到椅腿的"嗒"声、手指拨弄发丝的细微声响。

【一致性锁定】
1. 全片固定机位，不推拉摇移，不换角度。
2. 同一把黑色扶手椅，位置不变。
3. 变装前后光线一致：左侧窗帘逆光过曝、右侧暗部压低。
4. 脸部严格锁定 @图片1，变装前后不出现任何面部漂移。
5. 变装前的高跟鞋和变装后脚上穿的是同一双鞋（黑色细带交叉绑带凉鞋），细节一致。
6. 红唇是全片唯一的高饱和色彩，变装前后保持一致。
7. 变装只用一次硬切，不许出现任何转场特效、模糊、叠化、黑场、闪白、魔法粒子。
8. 画面内不出现任何品牌logo、文字、字幕、水印。
9. 不出现镜面反射或水面倒影中的人像。
10. 后半段pose变换是连续拍摄，不再有任何剪辑切换，一镜到底。

prompts.prompt:
一、整体基础设定

生成一支30秒、英式复古写实电影质感、原生同步英文对白的古典剧情短片。
画幅为宽银幕20:9，胶片写实电影摄影，24fps纯正电影观感，轻微细腻35mm复古胶片颗粒，无数码锐化感。
故事发生在19世纪中期英国庄园书房，古典深木色精装墙面、复古雕花实木书柜、老旧皮质单人沙发、窗边垂落的暗丝绒窗帘。傍晚温柔暖调自然光从侧窗斜向切入，光线柔和朦胧，带轻微光影层次。
整体色调极致克制高级，以深胡桃木棕、墨绿、米白、低饱和暗金为主，复古暗沉油画质感，画面干净厚重。全程规避所有现代物品、电子设备、现代装修风格与商业质感，纯古典英伦庄园氛围。
整体表演摒弃戏剧化夸张演绎，全程依靠人物眼神微动、面部肌肉变化、呼吸节奏、细微肢体张力推进情绪，用克制的爆发力呈现底层灵魂的倔强与平等的呐喊。

二、故事内核&表演基调

核心冲突：身份卑微的家庭教师女主角，面对贵族主人的身份试探与阶级碾压，压抑情绪彻底爆发，挣脱身份桎梏、呐喊灵魂平等、人格对等的核心信念。
表演基调：内敛、倔强、隐忍又充满力量，无嘶吼、无大哭、无夸张肢体。情绪层次：隐忍拘谨→内心震颤→坚定反驳→情绪破防→温柔却决绝的灵魂告白，全程靠微表情和声线层次递进，安静却极具冲击力。

三、人物一致性

女主角

20岁左右英国年轻女性，身形清瘦单薄、体态挺直不佝偻，自带倔强清冷气质。浅棕色中短发整齐利落，发丝柔软朴素，无精致造型；皮肤白皙通透，保留原生细腻皮肤纹理，无磨皮美颜，眉眼干净清澈，眼神坚定有韧劲。
身着19世纪英式朴素女佣高领素色米白长裙，剪裁简约无装饰、干净素雅，面料轻薄垂坠。
声线：清澈温柔的青年女中音，音色干净柔和，情绪从拘谨平稳逐渐变得坚定有力，尾段带着隐忍的哽咽，温柔却极具穿透力。

男主角

40岁左右英国贵族男性，身形挺拔高大、骨架宽阔，气质沉稳阴郁、自带沧桑疏离感。深棕色微卷短发，鬓角略带成熟质感，面部轮廓硬朗，眉眼深邃，额头沉稳，自带上位者的压迫感，眼神深沉内敛。
身着19世纪英伦复古深色丝绒西装马甲、白色复古立领衬衫，穿搭庄重华贵，贵族质感十足。
声线：低沉磁性的醇厚男低音，语气从从容试探、带着阶级优越感的淡然，逐渐转为错愕、收敛锋芒、温柔动容。

全局人物约束

两人全程保持面孔、年龄、发型、服装、神态、身形完全一致，无面部漂移、五官变形、妆容变化、服装穿帮、年龄波动。无任何现实演员、公众人物五官特征。
严格遵守180度镜头轴线：男主角位于画面左侧，女主角位于画面右侧，两人面对面站立，间距一米左右，视线精准对接，全程站位固定无错乱、无互换位置。

四、分镜头时序模块

【镜头一｜0.0—6.5秒】

85mm人像镜头，男主角胸部以上近景，三分之二侧脸朝向画面右侧的女主角。背景虚化深木色书柜与丝绒窗帘，极浅景深，突出人物面部情绪。
摄影机近乎完全固定，仅保留极其细微的电影手持呼吸感，无任何推进、晃动、环绕、升降运镜。
0.0—3.0秒：男主角姿态松弛淡然，眉眼微垂，眼神带着上位者的从容与试探，眉心舒展，嘴唇轻抿，下颌放松，语气慵懒疏离，带着轻微的阶级俯视感。
3.0—6.5秒：说话间眼神微微抬升，紧盯对面的女主角，眼睑轻微收紧，面部神态依旧沉稳，无大幅情绪波动，语气平淡笃定。
表情辅助：AU2眉部放松、AU12嘴角轻微放平、AU48眼部平视聚焦
男主角语速平缓、语气淡然试探：
“Do you think, because I am poor, obscure, plain, and little, I am soulless and heartless?”
台词节奏均匀，尾音轻微拉长，自带贵族沉稳气场。
本镜头结束后硬切转场，无淡入淡出、无转场特效。

【镜头二｜6.5—18.0秒】

硬切至女主角越肩近景，男主角的肩膀与轮廓作为模糊前景，占据画面左下角六分之一。女主角居于画面绝对中心，胸部以上构图，背景虚化窗边光影与书柜，画面干净聚焦。
摄影机全程固定机位，仅有几乎无法察觉的细微呼吸晃动，无任何动态运镜。
6.5—10.0秒：女主角身体微微挺直，肩背收紧，原本柔和的眉眼瞬间绷紧，眉心轻微聚拢，上眼睑抬起，双眼清亮坚定，直视对方，无丝毫闪躲。嘴唇轻闭，呼吸轻微加快，隐忍的情绪开始积蓄。
表情辅助：AU4眉心微蹙、AU5眼睑抬起、AU23嘴唇收紧
10.0—14.0秒：情绪逐步上扬，眼神更加锐利澄澈，面部无愤怒狰狞，只有倔强与坦荡。下颌轻轻咬紧，颈部线条绷紧，身体无晃动，仅气场彻底打开。声线从温柔变得清亮有力，字字铿锵。
14.0—18.0秒：彻底挣脱自卑桎梏，眼神坦荡明亮，眉眼舒展却依旧坚定，积压的情绪尽数释放，语气决绝又赤诚。
女主角语速平稳、坚定有力，无急促嘶吼：
“You think wrong! I have as much soul as you—and full as much heart!”
重读“soul”“heart”两个单词，语气掷地有声，温柔却不卑微。
本镜头保持神态定格，精准卡点台词结束瞬间硬切。

【镜头三｜18.0—26.0秒】

硬切回男主角同角度近景，焦段、光线、构图、机位与镜头一完全统一，画面衔接丝滑。
女主角画外音持续输出，声音来自画面右侧，清晰通透。
18.0—21.0秒：男主角瞬间错愕，原本松弛的眉心骤然收紧，双眼微微睁大，眼底的从容与优越感瞬间消散，出现明显震动与意外，嘴唇微张，欲言又止。
21.0—24.0秒：上位者的压迫感彻底褪去，眼神变得深沉柔和，眼睑放松，下颌收紧，沉默倾听，面部神态从试探转为动容、愧疚与惊艳。
24.0—26.0秒：气息放缓，目光牢牢锁定前方，眼底满是复杂情绪：震撼、怜惜、认同，彻底放下阶级偏见。
女主角画外音，声线温柔却无比坚定，情绪层层递进：
“If God had gifted me with some beauty and much wealth, I should have made it as hard for you to leave me.”

【镜头四｜26.0—30.0秒】

硬切至女主角面部极近特写，聚焦眉眼与面部神态，比前序镜头更贴近面部，极致放大情绪细节。
26.0—28.0秒：女主角眼眶轻微泛红，眼底蓄满细碎水光，无夸张流泪，睫毛微颤，呼吸轻柔急促，带着隐忍的委屈与赤诚的渴望。嘴角微微放平，眼神柔软却依旧倔强。
28.0—30.0秒：情绪落定，眼神澄澈坦荡，眉眼温柔，语气平缓治愈，完成灵魂平等的终极告白。
女主角带着温柔哽咽、无比真诚的语气收尾：
“as it is now for me to leave you.”
台词结束后，定格女主角含泪坚定的面部神态0.3秒，直接黑屏收尾，无淡出、无残留画面。

五、声音设计

1. 原生精准英文对白生成，双人声线辨识度极高，口型与每一个英文音节100%精准同步，无口型错位、无延迟偏差。
2. 男主角人声：低沉醇厚男低音，情绪曲线：从容试探→错愕震动→温柔动容，声线全程沉稳，无尖锐、无浮夸。
3. 女主角人声：清澈治愈女中音，情绪曲线：温柔拘谨→坚定倔强→赤诚坦荡→隐忍温柔，层次细腻完整，强弱有度，无全程大喊大叫。
4. 保留真实人声细节：细微换气声、轻柔呼吸、尾音轻微颤音、隐忍哽咽，不降噪、不抹平真实人声质感。
5. 环境音：仅保留极其轻微的窗外晚风簌簌声、书房安静空气底噪、细微窗帘飘动声，极致安静空灵。
6. 全程无背景音乐、无配乐、无旁白、无额外音效、无人声混响过度，纯人声+轻环境音，凸显台词力量。

六、影像限制（强制规避BUG）

禁止字幕、禁止任何文字、禁止水印、禁止LOGO、禁止任何现代元素。
禁止第三人入镜、禁止场景切换、禁止光线色调突变、禁止人物服装/发型/神态中途变化。
禁止面部漂移、五官扭曲、眼神涣散、目光错位、嘴唇粘连、牙齿畸形、虚假过度流泪。
禁止美颜磨皮、过度曝光、高饱和色彩、广告质感灯光、舞台戏剧打光。
禁止夸张肢体动作、挥手、摇头、身体晃动、嘶吼尖叫、慢动作、环绕运镜、快速推拉镜头。
禁止人物体型畸变、比例失调、穿模、画面CG感，全程保持真人写实电影质感。

七、核心主旨重申

本片核心魅力不在于镜头炫技，而在于极致细腻的微表情情绪递进。通过双人眼神博弈、声线层次变化、细微神态张力，演绎跨越阶级的灵魂平等，画面安静克制、情绪厚重有力量，贴合原著温柔又倔强的内核。

prompts.prompt:
嘴上说不要，照片却笑得很甜

【时长】18秒
【画幅】9:16竖屏
【风格】真人街头摄影短视频，手机纪实影像与专业写真照片交替剪辑，傍晚黄金时刻，真实皮肤质感，长焦浅景深，时尚街拍氛围，轻喜剧反差
【语言】中文对白，无字幕
【人物数量】画面中始终只有女主一人；摄影师只出现画外男声，不能实体出镜

【人物角色卡】
  @ 命名“方圆”，街头偶遇摄影师的女生。人物脸部、身形、发型、妆容、服装及原有配饰完全继承参考图。增加一部手机和一只单肩托特包作为剧情道具。

【核心情绪反差】

动态视频状态：
方圆表现得冷淡、拽、有距离感。下巴微抬，嘴唇轻抿，眉毛略微压低，眼神像是在审视镜头。说话时不撒娇、不害羞、不甜笑，拒绝动作干脆从容。

写真照片状态：
只要硬切进入写真，方圆的表情瞬间改变。眉眼完全舒展开，眼睛弯起，脸颊抬高，露出明亮、自然、毫无防备的甜美笑容。笑容必须明显比动态视频更温柔、更亲近、更有感染力。

情绪切换不能渐变：

动态冷脸 → 快门声与硬切 → 写真甜笑；
写真甜笑 → 硬切回视频 → 笑容立即消失，恢复冷淡。

这条“冷脸视频与甜笑照片”的反差是全片最重要的喜剧效果。

[00:00-00:04.20] 镜头1｜第一次冷脸拒绝

方圆站在现代创意园区的林荫道路旁，肩背托特包，低头看手机。

手持摄影机从侧前方缓慢靠近，由中远景推进到胸部近景。

00:00-00:00.80
方圆低头操作手机，完全没有注意镜头。右手拿手机，另一只手轻点屏幕，嘴唇闭合，表情平静冷淡。

00:00.80-00:02.40
听见陌生人搭话，她的手指先停下来。

她没有立刻抬头，而是停顿半拍，先把眼睛从手机屏幕移向镜头，随后才缓慢抬起头。

下巴微微上扬，眉毛轻压，眼神带有明显的审视感，脸上没有笑容。

【画外年轻男声】
“哎，你好，我是一名街头摄影师，可以邀请你拍两张照片吗？”

男声礼貌、自然，带一点试探感。

00:02.40-00:03.90
方圆先冷冷看着镜头，停顿约0.2秒，再开口：

【方圆】
“不要拿镜头对着我。”

语气平静、直接、有距离感，不能带娇嗔语气。

说“不要”时，她才抬起空闲的左手。

说“拿镜头”时，左手五指逐渐打开，掌心朝向摄影机。

说“对着我”时，左掌从容地靠近镜头，遮挡大半画面。右手始终拿着手机。

她从手掌旁边继续冷冷盯着镜头，嘴角不笑，也不害羞躲闪。

00:03.90-00:04.20
方圆收回手掌，干脆转身离开。肩膀先转，头部随后转动，头发产生真实甩动惯性。

[00:04.20-00:07.80] 镜头2｜第一组甜笑写真

在方圆冷脸转身之后，伴随清脆快门声，画面突然硬切成专业写真。

照片中的她不再冷漠，而是立即露出非常甜美、明亮的笑容。

照片一｜00:04.20-00:05.10
半身逆光回眸写真。

方圆身体朝前，脸回转看向镜头，露出灿烂的露齿甜笑。脸颊明显抬起，眼睛弯成柔和月牙形，整个人突然变得亲近温柔。

人物、发丝和背景完全静止。

照片二｜00:05.10-00:06.00
林荫道路全身写真。

方圆保持交叉迈步的优雅走姿，低头露出自然甜笑，像是被摄影师逗笑。笑容柔软放松，没有任何冷漠感。

照片三｜00:06.00-00:06.85
黄金逆光中近景写真。

一只手放在头顶发间，另一条手臂扶住托特包。方圆直视镜头，露出明亮甜美的露齿笑，眼尾弯起，脸颊饱满上扬。

照片四｜00:06.85-00:07.80
面部与上胸特写写真。

方圆头部轻轻侧歪，双眼温柔看向镜头，露出整组照片中最甜、最有感染力的笑容。牙齿自然露出，眼睛弯起，背景形成金色散景。

四张照片全部是真正静止的写真成片，不眨眼、不呼吸、不飘发。相邻照片通过快门声和硬切切换，不使用大面积白闪。

[00:07.80-00:10.30] 镜头3｜切回视频，笑容立即消失

硬切回手机动态视频。

切回的第一帧，方圆脸上的甜美笑容必须完全消失，重新恢复冷淡、拽、不耐烦的状态。

00:07.80-00:08.50
摄影机从侧后方跟拍。

方圆背对镜头继续向前走，手机拿在胸腰之间，托特包随脚步轻微晃动。

【画外年轻男声】
“很快很快，就两张。”

听见摄影师继续央求，方圆没有马上停下。

她先用眼角向后看，再缓慢转动头部和肩膀。她的眼神冷淡，下巴微抬，嘴唇轻抿，像是觉得摄影师很烦。

00:08.50-00:10.00
方圆一边走一边看向镜头：

【方圆】
“我没有配合你的义务。”

语气平静、坚定、带明显边界感，不能微笑。

说“我没有”时，她直视镜头，眉毛轻轻压低。

说“配合你的”时，空闲手从胸前抬起，五指逐渐打开。

说“义务”时，掌心正对摄影机并向前靠近，形成明确的“停止拍摄”手势。

她嘴上拒绝得很冷，但肩膀已经自然打开，腰部形成漂亮侧转，头部角度和手掌位置都非常适合拍照。

00:10.00-00:10.30
她放下手掌，冷淡地转回前方继续走。整个过程中不能出现甜笑。

[00:10.30-00:13.50] 镜头4｜第二组甜笑写真

就在方圆冷着脸转身离开时，快门声响起，画面再次硬切成甜美写真。

照片五｜00:10.30-00:11.10
大腿以上中景写真。

方圆双手在腰前拿着手机，身体微侧，脸转向镜头，突然露出放松明亮的露齿甜笑。眼睛弯起，肩膀柔和，与上一秒的冷脸形成强烈反差。

照片六｜00:11.10-00:11.90
道路边全身写真。

方圆一只手叉腰，另一只手抓住托特包肩带，髋部自然侧移。虽然姿势利落时尚，但表情非常甜，嘴角明显上扬，露出自然牙齿，眼神温柔亲近。

照片七｜00:11.90-00:12.70
林荫道路全身回眸写真。

身体保持向前迈步，后脚脚跟抬起，头和上胸向后回转。方圆回头看镜头时露出灿烂笑容，脸颊抬起，像是在开心地回应摄影师。

照片八｜00:12.70-00:13.50
胸腰以上近景写真。

方圆双手拿着手机，头部轻轻侧歪，双眼直视镜头，露出温柔甜美的笑容。笑意同时出现在嘴角和眼睛里，不能只是机械地咧嘴。

四张写真全部完全冻结，不能出现眨眼、呼吸、头发移动或背景运动。

[00:13.50-00:15.20] 镜头5｜再次切回冷脸动态视频

硬切回动态视频的第一帧，甜笑再次立即消失。

摄影机位于方圆侧后方，以腰胸以上中近景跟拍。

【画外年轻男声】
“就两分钟，两分钟，真的，就两……”

男声带一点执着和央求感，最后一句没有说完。

方圆没有台词，不跟随画外声音张嘴。

00:13.50-00:14.00
她回头冷冷看摄影机一眼。嘴唇闭合，眉毛略压，下巴微抬，表情像在说：“你怎么还在拍？”

00:14.00-00:14.50
她把脸转回前方，背对镜头继续走。长发自然覆盖背部，托特包随脚步轻轻晃动。

00:14.50-00:15.20
她借着下一步突然向镜头方向回身。

肩膀先转，头部随后转回，大束头发因惯性向外甩开，形成真实流畅的发丝弧线。

她的脸仍然保持冷淡，不能在甩发过程中提前微笑。

[00:15.20-00:18.00] 镜头6｜冷着脸却已经摆好Pose

摄影机由侧后方绕到侧前方，并缓慢推进至胸部近景。

00:15.20-00:15.80
方圆完成回身，左手抬到后脑和头顶发根，手肘自然向外打开。

眼睛准确找到镜头，目光稳定直接；嘴唇轻抿，下巴微抬，依然是一副不愿意配合的冷淡表情。

00:15.80-00:16.40
左手沿头发外侧向下滑动，把甩到脸前的发束拨开。

头发依靠真实惯性继续向一侧飘动。与此同时，她的肩膀自然打开，身体逐渐转成三分之二侧身。

00:16.40-00:17.10
左手落到托特包上缘，把包轻轻抱稳在身体侧面。

她把重心放到一条腿上，腰部轻微侧移，一侧肩膀向后打开，已经形成完整的专业模特Pose。

她的脸仍然冷淡，不能出现与写真相同的甜笑。

00:17.10-00:18.00
摄影机缓慢推进至近景。

方圆保持侧身抱包姿势，下巴先微抬，再缓慢压低一点；双眼从略低的眉骨位置直视镜头，嘴唇维持冷淡的闭合状态。

最后0.4秒，她只让一侧嘴角出现极其轻微、几乎看不出来的得意弧度，像是在说：

“我没有答应拍照，只是刚好会摆Pose。”

结尾仍是动态视频，保留轻微呼吸与发丝余动，不能变成甜笑写真。

【声音设计】
使用节奏利落的时尚流行音乐。

动态视频段保留脚步声、手机握持声、衣料摩擦声、托特包摆动声和甩发声。

每次从冷脸动态视频切入甜笑写真时，必须加入清脆机械快门声，并与画面硬切和音乐重拍同步。

摄影师始终为镜头后的画外男声。只有方圆说两句拒绝台词时产生口型。

【主要约束】
动态视频中的方圆必须冷淡、拽、不甜笑；
写真照片中的方圆必须笑得明亮、自然、甜美；
冷脸和甜笑只能通过硬切瞬间切换，禁止缓慢渐变；
写真段必须完全静止，动态段保持真实连续运动；
禁止换脸、人物外观漂移、口型错位、额外人物、字幕、Logo和水印。

prompts.prompt:
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical, 15 seconds
STYLE: Ultra-realistic luxury UGC, high-end fashion campaign, cinematic studio lighting, sophisticated, minimal, premium, photorealistic 4K.
PRODUCT CONSISTENCY — CRITICAL:
Use the uploaded handbag images as the exact and only product reference. Preserve the handbag’s exact shape, proportions, black color, smooth material, long structured handles, side bow/tie details, hardware, stitching, opening, and CHARLES & KEITH logo. Do not redesign, resize, recolor, add/remove details, or change the construction. The same handbag must remain perfectly consistent throughout every shot.

🎬 SHOT-BY-SHOT
0–2s — UNBOXING HOOK
Close-up UGC shot of a stylish woman opening a CHARLES & KEITH black box on a clean, elegant table. She lifts the lid and gently pulls back the white dust bag/tissue paper, revealing the exact black handbag inside. Natural hand movement, satisfying packaging sounds, warm soft lighting.
On-screen text: “Okay… this is even prettier in person.”

2–4s — HERO REVEAL
Smooth cinematic camera movement from left to right, revealing the handbag’s full silhouette and distinctive oversized handles. Subtle realistic shadow beneath the bag. Premium fashion-commercial lighting.

4–6s — DETAIL SHOT
Macro close-up of the CHARLES & KEITH logo and smooth black finish. Camera gently racks focus from the material to the logo. Highly detailed texture, realistic reflections, shallow depth of field.
6–8s — SIDE DETAIL
Three-quarter angle matching the uploaded reference image. Slowly orbit around the bag to showcase its structured shape, side construction and elegant tie details. Keep the product geometry identical to the reference.
8–11s — UGC LIFESTYLE MOMENT
A stylish woman wearing a minimalist black blazer and tailored trousers naturally picks up the handbag from the studio surface. Frame primarily focuses on the handbag and hands rather than her face. The long handles fall naturally as she lifts it.

11–13s — CARRY SHOT
Close-up tracking shot as she carries the handbag beside her. Soft studio-to-fashion-editorial transition, subtle movement, natural hand interaction, realistic material behavior.
13–15s — FINAL HERO
Return to a clean front three-quarter product shot. The handbag is placed elegantly on the surface while the camera slowly pushes in. Soft luxury lighting, beautiful shadow, crisp product details.

On-screen text:
“Timeless. Effortless. Yours.”
🎥 CAMERA & QUALITY

Smooth controlled camera movements, macro lens details, shallow depth of field, realistic reflections, soft diffused key light, subtle rim lighting, natural shadows, premium editorial composition, realistic hand movement, physically accurate materials, no artificial CGI appearance, no excessive transitions.
AUDIO: Soft luxury fashion beat + subtle tissue-paper crinkle + gentle handbag placement sound. No distracting music.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
No product redesign, no altered proportions, no different handbag, no extra straps, no missing handles, no distorted logo, no warped geometry, no floating objects, no plastic-looking material, no excessive gloss, no shaky footage, no cartoon/CGI appearance, no unrealistic hands, no face distortion, no text glitches.

description.en: A source-verified MiniMax H3 music video prompt with attached video evidence from @ImaStudio_ai.

prompts.prompt:
Turn a still concept into a moving ink-style visual with flowing brush textures, soft diffusion, and a cinematic Eastern aesthetic.
Prompt idea ↓

Create a 15-second, 16:9 widescreen, 24fps pure black-and-white Chinese ink-wash action short film. The overall visual style is a minimalist premium ink-wash cinematic title sequence: pure white background, extensive negative space, dense black character silhouettes, translucent gray-black ink smoke, and ultra-fine flowing ink filaments. All characters are NOT realistic humans. Every character is entirely formed from black ink, ink smoke, and delicate ink filaments, appearing as living humanoid figures condensed from liquid ink. HIGHEST PRIORITY — FACE DESIGN: Every character's face must remain extremely abstract, blurred, and completely devoid of recognizable facial features. NO VISIBLE FACIAL FEATURES. NO DETAILED EYES. NO VISIBLE PUPILS. NO DETAILED NOSE. NO DETAILED LIPS. NO FACIAL HIGHLIGHTS. NO FACIAL SHADOW MODELING. NO REALISTIC FACE. NO SKIN. NO SKIN COLOR. Never construct facial features through lighting or tonal contrast. No eye highlights, no illuminated nose bridge, no lips, no skin texture. Every face should look like a solid deep-black or dark-gray ink silhouette, preserving only an extremely vague outline of the head, jawline, or side profile. Facial features must appear completely swallowed by ink. Characters must be distinguished only through hats, hairstyles, conical hats, clothing silhouettes, body proportions, weapons, and movement — NEVER through facial features. The entire film contains only BLACK + WHITE + GRAY INK. Absolutely no skin tones and no color anywhere. 0–2.5s — WESTERN INK GUNSLINGER: A completely pure white empty space. Extremely thin and translucent black ink smoke drifts slowly into frame from the left. The smoke behaves like ink dispersing through clear water, creating delicate fluid strands that curl, twist, and intertwine. The strands converge toward the center and gradually form a tall Western gunslinger. Wide-brim cowboy hat, long trench coat, boots, hip holster, revolver. His entire body from head to toe consists exclusively of black and gray ink. Beneath the hat brim, the entire face is one deep-black ink shadow. Absolutely no eyes, nose, mouth, facial highlights, or skin. The lower edges of the trench coat are not fully solid; they dissolve into hundreds of translucent ink filaments trailing behind him. The gunslinger stands sideways with his head lowered, right hand hovering near the holster. Suddenly he performs an extremely stylish quick draw — draw the revolver, pivot sharply, raise the gun, then freeze completely for 0.15 seconds. BANG! He fires. The muzzle flash must be an extremely brief PURE WHITE impact flash only. No yellow or orange flame. The revolver produces strong physical recoil. At the exact instant of the shot — BONG! — the recoil shock violently travels backward through the gunslinger's body. His gun arm is the first to disintegrate into hundreds of long, thin ink filaments, followed sequentially by the shoulder, chest, trench coat, hat, torso, and legs. This is NOT an explosion of solid fragments. His body behaves like a concentrated mass of liquid ink suddenly blasted apart by an enormous gust of wind. Hundreds of black and gray ink-smoke strands accelerate violently along the direction of the shot and directly become the material used to form the next character. 2.5–5s — RONIN SWORDSMAN: The ink smoke from the previous gunslinger continues moving horizontally without a hard cut. The flowing strands curl, twist, contract, and intertwine in midair, gradually forming a completely different ronin swordsman. High-tied long hair, worn loose robe, waist sash, slender katana. The ends of his hair, shoulders, sleeves, and robe remain connected to translucent black ink filaments. His face is again a single deep-black ink mass. No eyes. No nose bridge highlight. No mouth. No facial modeling. The swordsman rapidly draws his blade. First strike: a fast diagonal upward slash from low to high. The blade leaves behind an extremely thin translucent black ink line. Second strike: his body rotates naturally into a rapid horizontal slash. His long hair and robe react with beautiful delayed secondary motion and physical inertia. He suddenly stops completely for 0.15 seconds. Both hands grip the sword. His body lowers into a powerful compressed stance. Clear anticipation and stored physical force. Suddenly explode forward. Final strike: an extremely violent diagonal heavy slash from lower left to upper right. WHOOSH! BONG! The strike appears powerful enough to cut through the entire pure-white canvas. A huge diagonal ink slash instantly tears across the frame. At the same moment, the swordsman's own body is pulled apart by the inertia of the strike. His arms, robe, torso, hair, and legs stretch into long black ink-smoke filaments and violently disintegrate along the sword's trajectory. The entire frame should feel as though the slash itself has physically sliced the composition apart. 5–7.5s — CONICAL-HAT WUXIA WARRIOR: The enormous diagonal ink trail from the previous slash keeps moving through the white space. No hard cut. The smoke bends into a smooth sweeping arc and gradually condenses into a third character: a mysterious masked wuxia warrior wearing an oversized conical hat, loose black martial-arts robes, extremely wide sleeves, long robe tails, waist belt, and holding a short staff. His face is completely hidden beneath the conical hat and a dense black ink shadow. Do NOT reveal his eyes. Do NOT create a sharp or intense gaze. His entire face must remain a featureless black ink silhouette. The warrior forms already in motion. He lands sideways with one foot striking the ground, immediately using the momentum to spin rapidly. His wide sleeves whip outward through centrifugal force. The sleeve edges dissolve into hundreds of transparent black ink strands, producing a huge circular ink-smoke trajectory around his body. He continues rotating, then suddenly swings the short staff violently across the camera. WHOOSH! The staff and wide sleeve pass extremely close to the lens. BONG! The resulting pressure wave instantly blows his entire body apart. The conical hat dissolves first, followed by the wide sleeves, shoulders, torso, waist, and legs, all stretched into high-speed black ink filaments. The character appears to be consumed by the violent wind generated by his own sweeping attack, completely dispersing toward the opposite side of the frame. 7.5–10s — FEMALE INK SPEAR WARRIOR: The ink smoke from the previous warrior does not disappear. Instead, the strands form an enormous rotating circular ring across the white frame. The ring gradually contracts toward its center and condenses into the fourth character: a female spear warrior. High ponytail, tall slender silhouette, fitted black wuxia clothing, trousers, lightweight flowing coat tails, and an extremely long black spear. The tip of her ponytail directly dissolves into ink smoke. Her face remains completely featureless. The entire facial plane is a flat deep-black ink silhouette. No eyes. No nose. No lips. No facial highlights. She spins the long spear rapidly with one hand, rotating it around her body for a complete circle. The spear tip creates an enormous circular black ink-smoke trajectory, with countless fine filaments flying elegantly through the pure white space. Suddenly the motion stops. She grips the spear with both hands, lowers her body, and holds a 0.15-second moment of visible anticipation. Then she violently pivots and unleashes a devastating horizontal spear sweep directly across the camera. WHOOSH! The spear shaft passes extremely close to the lens. BONG! The sweep generates an enormous wall-like wave of translucent black ink. At the same time, the female warrior is physically stretched apart along the spear's movement direction. Her ponytail, arms, waist, torso, clothing, and legs transform into long, delicate ink filaments. Her entire figure merges into the sweeping ink wave and exits the frame at high speed. 10–12.5s — HEAVY-BLADE CLOAKED WARRIOR: The giant black ink wave gradually becomes thinner and more transparent. Inside the fading wave, an enormous humanoid silhouette slowly emerges. The fifth character condenses from the ink: a towering heavy-blade warrior, visibly taller and broader than every previous character. He wears an enormous damaged black cloak and carries a massive broad-bladed sword. His face is a completely solid deep-black ink shadow with absolutely no facial features. Never use lighting to reveal his face. The cloak is extremely important: near the shoulders it is dense, solid black ink, but as it extends backward it gradually becomes translucent until the edges separate into hundreds of long, fine ink-smoke strands. The warrior initially stands with his back toward the camera, dragging the heavy blade. He slowly turns sideways. Suddenly he pivots violently. His enormous cloak whips upward with strong physical inertia. Using his entire body weight, he performs one powerful 360-degree spinning heavy slash. WHOOSH! The broad blade sweeps across nearly the entire frame and generates a gigantic semicircular ink arc. BONG! At the exact moment the blade crosses the frame, the cloak is ripped into smoke by the rotational inertia. Then the shoulders, torso, arms, waist, and legs violently disintegrate. The entire massive warrior is thrown outward into one enormous rotating black smoke ribbon, which continues spinning through the pure white space and naturally becomes the transition material for the final character. 12.5–15s — NAMELESS INK WARRIOR, FINAL SLASH: All rotating black ink smoke suddenly decelerates. Hundreds of fine ink filaments float suspended inside the pure white space. Complete stillness for 0.15 seconds. Then, instantly, every filament reverses direction. Hundreds of black ink strands rush violently toward the center of the frame and condense into the final nameless warrior. His silhouette must NOT repeat any previous character. No hat. No conical hat. No cloak. Slightly long, messy black ink hair. Minimalist long black robe. Tall slender physique. One hand holding a minimalist long blade. His entire face remains hidden inside a featureless black ink shadow. NO FACIAL FEATURES. The warrior stands silently with his head lowered. The camera slowly pushes forward. His hair tips and clothing edges gently release extremely thin drifting ink strands. Suddenly he raises his head, but absolutely no eyes, nose, mouth, or facial structure become visible. Only a featureless black human-shaped face silhouette remains. Hold for 0.15 seconds. In the next instant, he violently steps directly toward the camera while simultaneously drawing his sword. An extremely fast horizontal slash. WHOOSH! The blade cuts directly toward the camera. BONG!!! This is the strongest impact of the entire film. The blade sweeps horizontally across the entire 16:9 frame. The warrior's body instantly disintegrates following the direction of the slash. Hair, head, shoulders, arms, robe, torso, and legs transform into thousands of ultra-fine black ink-smoke strands. Massive quantities of ink filaments rush directly toward the camera and briefly cover the frame. Then they rapidly disperse. The black ink becomes progressively lighter. The smoke becomes increasingly transparent. Eventually only a few extremely faint gray-black filaments remain floating against the white background. They slowly disappear completely. Final frame: PURE WHITE. MATERIAL LOCK: Every character must always consist of solid black ink core + translucent gray-black smoke edges + ultra-fine ink filaments. The central body mass is dense black ink. Toward the edges, the body gradually becomes transparent. The outermost silhouette dissolves into numerous extremely fine, lightweight black smoke filaments. Ink smoke must behave like liquid ink dispersing through clear water: lightweight, translucent, filament-like, elegant, fluid, organic, and continuously flowing. Never use thick black paint. Never cover the entire frame with random heavy ink splashes. Maintain extensive pure white negative space throughout the entire film. CHARACTER DIFFERENTIATION: Gunslinger = wide-brim hat + long trench coat + revolver. Ronin swordsman = high-tied long hair + worn robe + katana. Wuxia warrior = oversized conical hat + wide sleeves + short staff. Female warrior = high ponytail + fitted wuxia clothing + long spear. Cloaked warrior = massive physique + enormous damaged cloak + heavy broad blade. Nameless warrior = messy medium-long hair + minimalist long robe + long blade. All six characters must be instantly distinguishable through silhouette, clothing, weapon, hairstyle, body proportions, and movement. NEVER distinguish them through facial features. ACTION RHYTHM: The entire film follows the rhythm of effortless elegance → brief stillness → sudden explosive acceleration → BONG impact → ink-smoke disintegration → next character condensation. Movements must NOT remain constantly fast. Every major attack must contain a very brief moment of absolute stillness beforehand. Use dramatic speed ramps only during attack bursts. Every weapon must feel physically heavy and possess believable momentum. Clothing, long hair, cloak fabric, weapons, and ink smoke must have realistic inertia, drag, delayed secondary motion, and follow-through. The direction in which one character disintegrates must naturally continue into the direction from which the next character forms. The entire 15-second sequence must feel like one continuous choreographed ink-wash action performance rather than six separate clips. TRANSITIONS MUST BE PHYSICAL AND MOTION-DRIVEN: character disintegration → traveling ink filaments → reorganization → next character formation. No automatic morphing. No generic dissolve. No fade transition. No hard cut. ABSOLUTE NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS: NO VISIBLE FACIAL FEATURES. NO DETAILED FACE. NO FACE LIGHTING. NO FACIAL HIGHLIGHTS. NO FACIAL SHADOW MODELING. NO EYE HIGHLIGHTS. NO VISIBLE PUPILS. NO DETAILED EYES. NO DETAILED NOSE. NO DETAILED LIPS. NO SKIN. NO SKIN COLOR. NO COLORED FACE. NO BEIGE. NO PINK. NO BROWN. NO COLOR ANYWHERE. NO REALISTIC HUMAN FACE. NO PHOTOREALISTIC SKIN. NO TEXT. NO SUBTITLES. NO CAPTIONS. NO LOGO. NO WATERMARK. NO UI. NO ORANGE MUZZLE FLASH. NO YELLOW MUZZLE FLASH. NO FIRE. NO FIRE EXPLOSION. NO BUILDINGS. NO FOREST. NO ROOM. NO LANDSCAPE. NO REALISTIC ENVIRONMENT. NO ANIME. NO CARTOON. NO CYBERPUNK. NO MAGIC SPELLS. NO ENERGY BEAMS. NO GLOWING MAGIC EFFECTS. NO RANDOM CHARACTER MORPHING. NO AUTOMATIC DISSOLVE. NO SIMPLE FADE. NO HARD CUT. MOST IMPORTANT RULE: Under absolutely no circumstances should the model reconstruct, complete, illuminate, or reveal any character's facial features. Every face must remain a single deep-black, blurred, flat ink silhouette without facial highlights, facial shadows, eyes, pupils, nose definition, lips, skin, or skin color from the first frame to the final frame. All charisma, identity, visual appeal, and character differentiation must come entirely from body silhouette, clothing, hairstyle, weapons, posture, and movement. From the first frame to the final frame, the only visual elements allowed are a PURE WHITE BACKGROUND and BLACK/GRAY INK.

description.en: A source-verified MiniMax H3 fashion prompt with attached video evidence from @johnAGI168.
description.zh: 由原作者公开 X 帖提供并已核验视频结果的 MiniMax H3时尚提示词。

prompts.prompt:
【风格】复古像素换装游戏穿搭短片（Pixel Dress-Up Game），真人时尚摄影（Photorealistic Fashion Video），Y2K森系早秋穿搭，奶油棕色调，4K高清，30fps，像素动画与真人画面结合
【时长】15秒
【画幅】9:16竖屏
【场景】暖灰色居家卧室兼试衣区，浅米色地毯；左侧摆放黄铜阅读灯、深蓝细条纹扶手椅、白色兔子抱枕和圆形木边几，边几上放一杯咖啡；中央后方有一株绿植；右侧是白色房门，门上挂深棕托特包和灰棕色衣物，旁边摆放浅木色藤编玻璃柜
【角色】@  命名为“米娅”。下文只使用“米娅”代称；面孔、肤色、五官和身材比例严格匹配参考图，全程保持同一身份，换装时不得换脸或改变身体比例
【声音】轻快复古电子音乐混合8-bit游戏音效；机械爪移动、加载完成、鼠标点击、单品装备和通关提示分别对应清晰音效；无对白、无真人字幕

【全局摄影】
固定竖屏全身镜头，正面略高机位轻微俯拍，约24–28mm手机广角，米娅从头到鞋完整入画。摄影机全程不推、不拉、不摇、不移；人物和家具位置稳定，所有视觉节奏来自像素动画、鼠标移动和卡点硬切换装。

[00:00-00:02.80] 镜头1：像素机械爪投放角色（Pixel Claw Entrance）

【开场钩子】
第一帧是空房间。一个巨大的棕白色像素机械爪从画面右上方快速进入，同时把米娅从画面右侧水平吊运进来。

【初始穿着】
米娅穿奶油香槟色亮面缎质睡衣套装：宽松长袖翻领上衣、同面料直筒长裤，布面布满细小深棕圆点，翻领、门襟、袖口和裤脚带深棕滚边，脚穿纯白色包头软底居家拖鞋。造型完整不透明。

【造型】
铜橘红色长卷发自然披肩，轻薄刘海，无帽子、无项链、无手提包。

【动作】
像素机械爪夹持在米娅头肩上方，把她从右侧吊运到画面正中央。米娅双眼闭合，头向左肩歪斜，双臂无力垂下，双脚并拢，身体像睡着的游戏角色一样轻微晃动。

机械爪到达中央后停止横移，爪臂松开并垂直升出画面。米娅落在地毯上保持站立，身体轻轻回弹，双脚稳定着地。

机械爪是平面像素动画（2D Pixel Overlay），边缘清晰、色块规整，不是写实金属装置，不遮挡或改变米娅的面孔。

[00:02.80-00:05.40] 镜头2：苏醒与换装菜单加载（Game UI Loading）

【动作】
米娅先保持低头闭眼，随后缓慢抬头睁眼，直视镜头，嘴唇微张，像刚从睡梦中醒来。

画面底部弹出一条奶油色与棕色描边的像素加载条。加载条从左向右逐格填充。

米娅闭上眼睛打哈欠，两只手从腿侧抬起，双肘弯曲经过肩部，随后双臂完全伸直举过头顶，形成宽V形伸懒腰姿势；头部轻轻后仰，肩膀上提，缎面袖子产生真实褶皱。

加载条填满时发出短促游戏提示音。五张像素服饰卡从画面左上方高速落下，依次排列成左侧竖向选择栏。

【像素界面】
左上显示奶油色像素边框标题“DRESS UP”，右侧排列三颗粉红色像素爱心；右上显示像素边框“X”。

左侧五张服饰卡从上到下分别显示：
1. 奶油白蕾丝细肩带上衣；
2. 棕色格纹蕾丝层叠短裙；
3. 可可棕毛绒针织开衫；
4. 奶油色堆堆袜与棕色毛绒厚底鞋；
5. 橙棕色问号卡“?”。

大型白色像素鼠标箭头从画面右侧进入，移动到第一张服饰卡旁边。所有UI保持平面像素风，不遮挡米娅的脸和主要身体轮廓。

[00:05.40-00:10.80] 镜头3：逐项点击换装（Rhythmic Outfit Jump Cuts）

【统一换装规则】
每次均严格按照“鼠标移动到服饰卡→点击音效→停顿一拍→固定机位硬跳切→对应单品瞬间装备”的顺序进行。

人物站位、身体大小、双脚位置、头部方向和手臂高度在硬切前后保持一致。禁止衣服逐渐生长、粒子生成、融化变形或遮镜换装。

【第一次点击｜00:05.40-00:06.20】
鼠标点击第一张上衣卡。

下一拍，香槟色睡衣上衣瞬间替换成奶油白修身细肩带上衣；胸前有小型棕色动物刺绣和深色纽扣，下摆拼接奶油白蕾丝荷叶边。

香槟色睡裤、白色居家拖鞋继续保留。米娅把举过头顶的双臂放到身体两侧，展示新上衣。

【第二次点击｜00:06.20-00:07.10】
鼠标下移并点击第二张短裙卡。

下一拍，香槟色睡裤瞬间替换成棕咖色格纹多层百褶短裙；裙摆由多层格纹荷叶边和奶油白蕾丝组成，轮廓轻盈蓬松。

颈部同时出现多层复古项链：短链带星形小吊坠，长链带钥匙或十字形吊坠。白色居家拖鞋暂时保留。

【第三次点击｜00:07.10-00:08.10】
鼠标下移并点击第三张针织开衫卡。

下一拍，米娅上身增加一件可可棕色毛绒短款针织开衫，V领、长袖、宽松袖口，敞开穿着，完整露出奶油白吊带和多层项链。

双腿同时增加白色半透明花纹连裤袜，纹理细密清晰，不透明过度、不出现破损。

【第四次点击｜00:08.10-00:09.20】
鼠标下移并点击第四张鞋袜卡。

下一拍，白色居家拖鞋消失，替换为奶油米色抽绳堆堆腿套和棕色长绒毛厚底鞋。腿套在小腿处形成多层自然褶皱，奶油色系绳松散垂落；毛绒鞋头宽大蓬松，深棕厚鞋底完整落地。

米娅始终双脚并拢，服装替换后身体只产生轻微自然回弹，不抬脚、不手动穿鞋。

【第五次点击｜00:09.20-00:10.80】
鼠标移动到最下方问号卡，短暂停顿后点击。

下一拍，米娅头上瞬间出现奶油白软呢贝雷帽，右手同时出现深棕色复古结构手提包。手提包带短提手、金色环扣和皮革装饰带，垂落至膝盖附近。

右臂因手提包重量自然下沉；铜橘长卷发从贝雷帽两侧蓬松垂落。米娅低头快速检查完整穿搭，随后抬头看向镜头。

[00:10.80-00:13.00] 镜头4：最终穿搭展示（Final Outfit Check）

【完整造型】
奶油白贝雷帽、铜橘长卷发、可可棕毛绒短开衫、奶油白蕾丝吊带、棕色格纹多层蕾丝短裙、多层复古项链、白色花纹连裤袜、奶油色绑带堆堆腿套、棕色毛绒厚底鞋、深棕色复古手提包。

【动作】
米娅先低头看向自己的裙摆和鞋袜，左手轻轻整理开衫下摆，右手稳定提包。

她重新抬头直视镜头，左手移到腰部，手肘向外打开；右手提包垂在身体侧面。身体重心轻轻移向一侧，形成自然S形站姿，双膝靠拢，头部微微侧倾。

左侧五张服饰卡从下到上依次缩小并消失，只保留左上“DRESS UP”、三颗爱心和右上“X”。

[00:13.00-00:15.00] 镜头5：游戏通关定格（Complete Screen）

【画面】
中央偏下位置弹出大型像素文字“COMPLETE!”：奶油白色字面、深棕色像素描边和浅色立体阴影，横跨腰部下方，但不完全遮住裙装层次。

出现文字时配一声清晰的8-bit通关音效，三颗粉红爱心同步闪亮一次。

米娅保持左手扶腰、右手提包、双腿靠拢的全身定妆姿势，直视镜头，嘴角轻轻上扬；人物只保留自然呼吸和细微头部动作。

最后1秒，顶部“DRESS UP”、爱心和“X”以隔帧像素扫描方式轻微闪烁；“COMPLETE!”始终基本完整。人物、服装和背景保持稳定。

15.00秒停留在完整UI和完整穿搭画面上直接结束，不渐隐、不切黑。

【负面约束】
禁止主角换脸、身份变化、肤色变化、年龄变化、身体比例漂移；禁止像素机械爪变成写实机械、机械爪压住人物面孔、机械爪导致身体悬空变形；禁止菜单文字乱码、服饰卡顺序改变、鼠标点击错误单品、鼠标穿过人物面部；禁止先换装后点击、点击后没有装备反馈、多个单品提前同时出现；禁止渐变换装、魔法粒子换装、烟雾换装、服装融化、衣物从身体内部生长；禁止换装前后人物位置漂移、镜头角度改变、背景家具跳动；禁止丢失吊带、短裙、开衫、项链、花纹袜、堆堆腿套、毛绒鞋、贝雷帽或手提包；禁止衣物透明、裙底暴露、意外走光、连裤袜破损、包带穿过手臂；禁止多余肢体、多余手指、融合手指、扭曲面孔、发丝穿过身体；禁止背景人物、镜面反射、摄影机摇晃、随机推拉、UI遮挡人物脸部；禁止乱码字幕、水印、品牌标识、塑料皮肤、塑料CG质感和动漫人物渲染。
