prompts.prompt:
High-Speed K-pop Fashion MV, luxury fashion advertising + Material Kinetic Typography + Experimental Fashion Film + 3D Spatial Typography. Strictly use @Image1 as the only character reference throughout the entire film. Core visual concept: the same girl + giant physical English typography + constantly changing materials + typography moving through foreground, midground, and background around the character + high-speed camera movement + aggressive beat synchronization. This is NOT a conventional MV where a person simply stands in front of text. All typography must physically exist inside the same 3D space as the character. Typography can generate behind her, wrap around her shoulders into the foreground, then rush toward the camera; it can also fly in from the extreme foreground, pass along both sides of her body, and extend behind her. She can stand inside giant typography, walk between oversized letters, and become fully surrounded by text. All typography must have realistic occlusion, spatial depth, perspective, shadows, reflections, and interactive lighting.【CHARACTER LOCK｜HIGHEST PRIORITY】Strictly use the girl from @Image1. Maintain exactly the same face shape, facial-feature proportions, eye shape, eyebrow-to-eye proportions, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, age, body proportions, long straight black hair, and wispy bangs throughout the entire film. Young East Asian woman with a refined small oval face, dark eyes, petite natural nose, soft pink lips, and fair natural skin. Realistic skin texture, visible natural pores, realistic eyelashes, and individually defined black hair strands. Keep the clean K-pop makeup from the reference: natural base makeup, subtle pink eye makeup, thin eyeliner, natural lashes, and glossy pink lips. No face swapping, no Westernization, no facial drift, no face-shape changes, no age changes, no skin-tone changes, no hair-color changes, and never lose the bangs. Long black hair and wispy bangs are essential identity features and must remain consistent at all times.【WARDROBE】Use the original black edgy outfit from @Image1 as the visual foundation. Keep the overall palette BLACK + SILVER + DEEP RED. LOOK01: black fitted sleeveless crop top, black choker, silver necklace, silver earrings, silver mirrored low-rise mini skirt, black knee-high boots. LOOK02: black sleeveless top and choker, used for the Beauty Close-Up. LOOK03: black oversized cropped biker leather jacket + black tank top + black leather mini skirt + silver waist chain. LOOK04: deep burgundy modern reinterpreted short qipao, black piping, minimalist silver frog-button details, black knee-high boots. LOOK05: black cropped top + silver metallic mini skirt + black choker. LOOK06: black modern Chinese-inspired structured cropped top + black layered mini skirt + silver metallic accessories. LOOK07: distressed gray-blue denim cropped top + charcoal-black asymmetric low-rise mini skirt + silver waist chain. LOOK08: Final Dark Idol Look, black asymmetric cropped top + black ultra-short layered skirt + silver waist chain + black choker + black knee-high boots. Do not radically change the fashion identity between scenes; the character must remain visually unified throughout.【MUSIC】145–155 BPM, high-energy, sexy, edgy K-pop Fashion Beat. Music style: K-pop Girl Group + Electro Hip-Hop + Jersey Club + Fashion Runway Beat + Y2K Club Beat. Start immediately with an aggressive rhythm at 0 seconds, no slow intro. Strong Kick, Heavy Bass, crisp Snare, rapid Hi-Hat, Electronic Percussion, short Glitch Hits. Rhythm pattern similar to BOOM — CLAP — BOOM BOOM — CLAP. One obvious heavy beat every 1–1.5 seconds. Every outfit transition, typography appearance, text deformation, camera push, rotation, and material explosion must hit precisely on the beat. No lyrics, no vocals, no dialogue, no lip-syncing. Add material-specific sound effects including Smoke Whoosh, Neon Buzz, Metal Impact, Electric Crack, Plant Growth, Paper Flip, Fabric Whip, Wind Rush, and Bass Impact.【OVERALL COLOR PALETTE】Restrict colors to BLACK, WHITE, HOT PINK, DEEP PINK, BURGUNDY, SILVER. Black is the dominant spatial base, Hot Pink provides energy and highlights, silver defines metallic materials, white provides typography contrast, and burgundy adds a sophisticated fashion tone. No rainbow colors. No blue-purple cyberpunk palette. Overall aesthetic: K-pop Girl Group Comeback Concept Film × High Fashion Campaign × Experimental Typography MV.【SCENE 01｜0–1.6s｜FREE YOUR MIND｜SMOKE TYPOGRAPHY】Enter the climax immediately on the first beat. The girl wears a black fitted sleeveless crop top, black choker, silver necklace, silver mirrored mini skirt, and black knee-high boots. Full-body shot, standing exactly in the center of a vast black space with a subtly reflective floor. She faces the camera and suddenly reaches one hand toward the lens. BOOM! A massive burst of white + extremely pale pink smoke erupts from her palm. The smoke first forms a gigantic “FREE” behind her, approximately twice her height. On the next beat, smoke curls out from behind her left shoulder, passes into the space in front of her body, and forms “YOUR”. Finally, the smoke continues toward the camera and forms a gigantic “MIND” in the extreme foreground. Establish three clearly separated spatial layers: FREE in the background, character + YOUR in the midground, MIND in the foreground. She is genuinely surrounded by the typography. Smoke-letter edges continuously roll, expand, contract, and breathe. High-Speed Push-in from a frontal full-body view, rapidly approaching her, then fly directly into the interior of the “MIND” letters until the dark interior fills the entire frame for transition.【SCENE 02｜1.6–3.1s｜LIGHT YOUR OWN WAY｜NEON FACE CLOSE-UP】Instantly cut from darkness into an Extreme Beauty Close-Up. This is the most important face-locking shot in the entire film. Preserve exactly the same long black hair, wispy bangs, eyes, nose, lips, face shape, silver earrings, and choker from @Image1. Her face is slightly turned to the side. Her eyes first look to the right, then shift directly toward the camera. One finger rises from the bottom of the frame and a bright Hot Pink point of light appears at the fingertip. On the next beat, a pink Neon Line shoots rapidly from the fingertip. The neon first sweeps across the extreme foreground, passes beside her cheek, curves beneath her chin, crosses in front of her shoulder, then wraps behind her head to create a giant S-shaped 3D light trail. The trail gradually forms “LIGHT YOUR OWN WAY”. LIGHT occupies the foreground, YOUR wraps around her shoulder, OWN appears beside her, and WAY extends into the background. The neon realistically illuminates her eyes, cheekbones, nose bridge, and the edges of her black hair. The camera follows the neon trajectory at high speed, beginning at the front of her face, orbiting approximately 180 degrees around her, then rapidly Pull-out until the complete sentence becomes clearly readable once.【SCENE 03｜3.1–4.7s｜BECOME WHO YOU CHOOSE｜LIQUID CHROME】BOOM! Instant wardrobe transition into the black biker look: black oversized cropped leather jacket, black tank top, black leather mini skirt, silver waist chain. Cut to Ultra-Wide + Extreme Low Angle. Large volumes of silver liquid metal rise from the floor like mercury, rapidly stretching upward into gigantic Chrome Typography two to three times taller than the character: “BECOME WHO YOU CHOOSE”. The typography must not form a flat wall. It behaves like monumental typographic architecture. Some letters stand in front of her, others flank her left and right sides, and others rise behind her. She physically stands between the giant letters and takes one step forward through a gap between them. She raises her right hand; moving her palm left stretches the Chrome letters in the same direction, moving right makes them distort like liquid mercury. On the next beat she suddenly clenches her fist. CLAP! All letters instantly solidify, clearly displaying “BECOME WHO YOU CHOOSE”. The camera races closely along the reflective Chrome letter surfaces, briefly revealing her reflection in the silver metal, then performs a high-speed Pull-out.【SCENE 04｜4.7–6.3s｜LET YOUR FUTURE BLOOM｜BOTANICAL CIRCLE】Completely change composition to a 90° Top Shot. She now wears a deep burgundy modern reinterpreted short qipao, youthful and fitted, with black piping and minimalist silver frog-button details. Avoid traditional portrait-photography aesthetics. She is positioned exactly at the center of the frame, slightly crouching, with the tip of her right finger touching the ground. A tiny flower bud appears beneath her fingertip. On the next beat, vegetation suddenly grows outward at extreme speed. Black vines, deep burgundy petals, and small amounts of pink and white flowers spread 360 degrees around her. The plants do not form a background wall; they grow into a gigantic circular Typography Garden surrounding her. “LET YOUR” grows along her left side, “FUTURE” forms a massive semicircle above her, and “BLOOM” expands beneath her. Eventually “LET YOUR FUTURE BLOOM” becomes a complete giant botanical typography ring with the girl perfectly centered inside it. BOOM! Every flower blooms simultaneously and a storm of petals flies directly toward the lens. The camera rapidly descends from the overhead position and dives through the flowers for transition.【SCENE 05｜6.3–7.9s｜POWER YOUR CHOICE｜ELECTRIC FOREGROUND】Hard Cut to a frontal centered composition. She returns to a black + silver outfit: black cropped top, silver metallic mini skirt, black choker. She stands relatively close to the camera and suddenly thrusts both hands toward the lens. Due to wide-angle perspective, both hands become large foreground elements, but anatomy must remain realistic and natural. A tiny Hot Pink electric spark appears between her fingertips. BOOM! Electricity violently erupts. Pink + white electrical currents first rush toward the camera and form a gigantic “POWER” between her and the lens. Then electricity passes between her hands and surrounds her torso to form “YOUR”. Finally, the current extends behind her and forms “CHOICE”. Create three clear spatial layers: POWER — foreground, YOUR — surrounding the character, CHOICE — background. Her face remains visible through gaps in the Electric Typography and her eyes must never be obstructed. High-speed Rack Focus sequence: fingertips → POWER → her eyes → YOUR → CHOICE → her eyes. Finally, a massive pink electrical bolt strikes directly toward the camera, creating a white flash transition.【SCENE 06｜7.9–9.5s｜STEP INTO YOUR STORY｜SHADOW TYPOGRAPHY】The white flash fades into an extremely wide side composition. She wears a black modern Chinese-inspired structured cropped top, black layered mini skirt, silver waist chain, and black knee-high boots. She is positioned on the left side of the frame, while a huge gray-white wall extends far toward the right. Strong directional side lighting creates an enormous elongated shadow across the wall and floor. She begins walking toward the right. On the first step, her shadow stretches and transforms into “STEP”. On the second step, STEP climbs from the floor onto the wall. Then “INTO” stretches away into the distance following spatial perspective. Finally, “YOUR STORY” suddenly expands from behind her into enormous Shadow Typography. She continues walking forward, physically passing between giant shadow letters S, T, O, R, Y. The camera performs high-speed Side Tracking parallel to her movement. At the end, she walks directly into the enormous black interior of “STORY”, and the shadow completely consumes the camera.【SCENE 07｜9.5–11s｜TURN THE PAGE｜PAPER TYPOGRAPHY】A storm of paper suddenly erupts from the darkness. Use a strong Dutch Angle composition. She now wears a distressed gray-blue denim cropped top, charcoal-black asymmetric low-rise mini skirt, and silver waist chain, positioned slightly left of center. Large quantities of white paper, black paper, deep pink magazine paper, and burgundy paper fragments fly through the space at high speed. Paper sheets first fold together in the foreground to form a gigantic “TURN”. TURN then flips upward like an enormous magazine page, passing from the foreground over her head and physically landing behind her. Simultaneously, “THE” forms along both sides of her body, while a gigantic “PAGE” expands from behind her toward the camera. She swings one hand. WHOOSH! The entire “TURN THE PAGE” structure flips like an enormous Fashion Magazine from in front of her to behind her. The camera races between flying sheets of paper. Sheets passing extremely close to the lens create realistic Motion Blur.【SCENE 08｜11–13s｜LIVE BY YOUR RULES｜RIBBON TYPOGRAPHY】The music reaches maximum intensity. She instantly changes into the Final Dark Idol Look: black asymmetric cropped top, black layered ultra-short skirt, silver waist chain, black choker, silver earrings, black knee-high boots. She stands exactly in the center and performs a fast turn. Large amounts of real Hot Pink, deep burgundy, and black ribbons explode from behind her. The ribbons must have realistic weight, folds, reflections, inertia, and aerodynamic drag. The first ribbon group shoots from behind her left shoulder, curves over her head into the extreme foreground to form “LIVE”, then continues around and behind her. The second group emerges again from behind her right side, crosses in front of her waist, and forms “BY YOUR”. The third group rises from around her feet, spirals around her legs, then angles toward the camera to form “RULES”. Eventually “LIVE BY YOUR RULES” becomes a gigantic 3D Typography Spiral. Typography continuously moves from foreground → side → background → extreme foreground → back behind her. She genuinely stands inside the center of the typographic vortex. The camera performs a high-speed 360° Orbit around her while the character and Ribbon Typography rotate in opposite directions. On the final BOOM, all ribbons instantly freeze and the complete phrase “LIVE BY YOUR RULES” remains clearly readable once.【SCENE 09｜13–15s｜CHOOSE YOUR LIFE｜IRIS TYPOGRAPHY TUNNEL】Hard Cut to an Extreme Macro of both eyes, filling almost the entire 16:9 frame. Preserve exactly the same eye shape, eye makeup, bangs, eyebrows, and realistic skin texture from @Image1. A tiny Hot Pink light appears in the center of the pupil. Deep inside the iris, “CHOOSE” gradually appears, followed by “YOUR”, then “LIFE”, forming “CHOOSE YOUR LIFE”. The typography is NOT printed onto the eyeball surface; it exists as miniature 3D Neon Typography suspended deep inside the iris. The camera suddenly rushes toward the right pupil and enters it. The pupil instantly transforms into a gigantic black + Hot Pink typography environment. Countless repetitions of “CHOOSE YOUR LIFE” extend through spatial depth to form an Infinite Typography Tunnel. Nearby typography is enormous, mid-distance typography is medium-sized, distant typography becomes progressively smaller, creating extreme infinite perspective. The camera races through the typography tunnel while gigantic letters sweep past from the left, right, above, and below. Finally, all typography suddenly collapses toward the center. In the middle of the black space, only one complete and clearly readable “CHOOSE YOUR LIFE” remains. The Hot Pink light contracts into a single point. Final Bass Hit: the girl blinks, instant cut to black.【TEXT ACCURACY｜HIGHEST PRIORITY】The following phrases must be generated exactly and spelled correctly: FREE YOUR MIND; LIGHT YOUR OWN WAY; BECOME WHO YOU CHOOSE; LET YOUR FUTURE BLOOM; POWER YOUR CHOICE; STEP INTO YOUR STORY; TURN THE PAGE; LIVE BY YOUR RULES; CHOOSE YOUR LIFE. No gibberish, random letters, extra words, or spelling errors. Even during high-speed typography movement, every phrase must have at least 0.3–0.5 seconds of complete, stable, clearly readable presentation.【ALL NINE SCENES MUST HAVE CLEARLY DIFFERENT COMPOSITIONS】01 Frontal full-body + Smoke Typography across foreground/midground/background; 02 Extreme Face Close-Up + Neon wrapping around the face in an S-shaped 3D path; 03 Extreme Low Angle + giant Chrome Typography architecture; 04 90° Top Shot + character centered inside a botanical typography ring; 05 frontal wide-angle forced perspective + Electric Typography in the foreground; 06 ultra-wide side view + Side Tracking + character walking into Shadow Typography; 07 Dutch Angle + Paper Typography flipping from foreground to background; 08 centered character + Ribbon Typography surrounding her in 360° space; 09 Extreme Eye Macro + Infinite Typography Tunnel. Never use the same composition for two consecutive scenes.【HIGH-SPEED CAMERA LANGUAGE】Frequently use High-Speed Push-in, High-Speed Pull-out, Whip Pan, Extreme Macro, Ultra Wide Angle, Low Angle, Top Shot, Dutch Angle, Side Tracking, 180° Orbit, 360° Orbit, Rack Focus, Perspective Distortion, Typography Fly-through, and Letter Surface Tracking. Camera movement can be extremely fast, but the character’s face must never become distorted by wide-angle lenses or motion. Facial features must remain stable, recognizable, sharp, and anatomically correct at all times.【STRICTLY FORBIDDEN】No face swapping, no additional people, no facial-feature drift, no Westernization, no face-shape changes, no age changes, no skin-tone changes, no hair-color changes, no missing bangs; no extra hands, extra legs, extra fingers, malformed hands, body intersections, or melting clothing; no typography passing through the character’s face or covering her eyes; no gibberish typography or spelling mistakes; no typography functioning as ordinary flat subtitles; no typography simply pasted onto background walls; no repetitive “character on the left + text on the right” compositions; no frontal medium shot in every scene; no repeated typography materials across all scenes; no cheap magical particles, no blue-purple cyberpunk aesthetic, no real brand logos, no player UI, no subtitles, no timestamps or numbers; no dialogue, no lip-syncing, no lyrics.【FINAL VISUAL TARGET】This is NOT a conventional Fashion Lookbook and NOT simply “a girl with English words added around her.” Throughout the full 15 seconds, the girl from @Image1 must genuinely enter and inhabit a Fashion World constructed entirely from Typography. Text repeatedly generates behind her → passes around her shoulders → wraps into the space in front of her body → flies toward the camera → circles back behind her. She physically stands between letters, walks through gigantic typography, becomes surrounded by text, controls typography deformation, causes typography to wrap around her body, and ultimately enters the typography itself. All nine scenes must have distinctly different materials, compositions, shot scales, spatial relationships, character actions, and camera movements. Final visual identity: BLACK + HOT PINK + WHITE.

Project video across the entire background surface with a projector. Do not show any outer boundary, frame, or edge of the projection surface. The projected background imagery and the white lyric light are clearly reflected on the floor.

Do not show a large amount of text at once. Do not alter, add, duplicate, or omit any of the specified text. Use a two-stage reveal: first display only the outlines of the letters, then fill in the interiors. Frequently use glitch effects, chromatic aberration, sudden scaling, abrupt stops, position shifts, brief flashing, rotation, and distortion, with strong variations in speed and intensity.

[Negative] Do not make it look like a live concert stage or a children’s recital/performance.

integrated_multimodal_description:

<Image 1> is the CHARACTER APPEARANCE REFERENCE.
<Image 0> is the BACKGROUND LOCATION REFERENCE.

Use <Image 1> to preserve the man's exact facial identity, age, dark hair with gray temples, rugged stubble, body proportions, green-and-black tactical suit, illuminated chest emblem, and power-ring design.

Use <Image 0> to preserve the open landscape, terrain, lighting, atmosphere, and general environmental appearance.

CRITICAL RIGHT-HAND CONTINUITY:
The power ring is worn ONLY on the man's anatomical RIGHT HAND throughout the entire video.
NEVER place the ring on his left hand.
Do NOT mirror or swap hands when the camera angle changes.
His LEFT HAND remains completely ringless throughout the entire sequence.
Every green energy projection originates directly from the ring on his RIGHT HAND.

Photorealistic live-action cinematic realism.

Environment: vast isolated American desert-like prairie, dry golden grass, dusty earth, scattered low scrub, distant low hills, huge open sky. Warm late-afternoon sunlight. No buildings, existing vehicles, roads, or other people visible.

The ONLY vehicle appearing in the scene is the futuristic sports-car construct created by the man's ring.

[00:00–00:02.0]

Wide cinematic tracking shot.

The man from <Image 1> walks casually through the open landscape.

His arms swing naturally as he walks.

After several steps he slows and stops.

He looks across the empty landscape in front of him as though deciding how he wants to travel.

Camera gently moves from the wider walking shot into a medium three-quarter view.

[00:02.0–00:03.0]

Medium shot.

He turns slightly toward an open patch of ground beside him.

He raises his anatomical RIGHT HAND and deliberately points the power ring toward the empty space.

His LEFT hand remains completely ringless.

The ring begins glowing with concentrated emerald-green energy.

[00:03.0–00:06.5]

A narrow, clearly defined GREEN ENERGY BEAM shoots directly from the ring on his RIGHT HAND into the empty space beside him.

CRITICAL:
From this moment through the FINAL FRAME, the green energy beam remains visibly and continuously connected between his RIGHT-HAND ring and the construct sports car.

The beam NEVER disconnects.
The beam NEVER disappears.
The beam NEVER switches hands.
The beam NEVER originates from his left hand.

Camera shifts to a wider three-quarter angle so both the man and the forming vehicle remain clearly visible.

The beam begins DRAWING A FUTURISTIC SPORTS CAR INTO EXISTENCE like a three-dimensional emerald sketch.

The construction is clearly progressive and physically understandable.

Bright emerald lines rapidly trace:

wheels → lower chassis → aerodynamic nose → side profile → rear body → windshield and cockpit → roofline → remaining body panels.

The glowing wireframe establishes the complete shape of a low, sleek, aggressive futuristic sports car.

As each section is drawn, the wireframe rapidly fills and solidifies into dense, physical-looking emerald-green construct energy.

The vehicle is NOT an ordinary green-painted automobile.

It is unmistakably a POWER-RING ENERGY CONSTRUCT: solid and physically usable, but composed entirely of luminous translucent emerald-green energy with subtle internal glowing structure.

Four clearly defined wheels.
Believable tires made from solid green construct energy.
Low aerodynamic body.
Futuristic cockpit.
Sleek windshield.
Aggressive but elegant proportions.

The DRIVER-SIDE DOOR AREA deliberately remains unfinished and open while the rest of the vehicle completes.

[00:06.5–00:08.0]

The sports car finishes forming except for the open driver's entrance.

The man lowers his right arm slightly while STILL maintaining the visible energy connection between his RIGHT-HAND ring and the construct car.

He looks over the completed futuristic car.

A confident, slightly cocky smirk appears on his face.

Hold just long enough to clearly read his expression.

No dialogue.

[00:08.0–00:10.5]

Camera moves into a dynamic medium-wide side angle.

The man walks directly to the open driver's side.

The continuous green energy beam remains connected from his RIGHT-HAND ring to the car throughout his movement.

He naturally steps into the driver's seat.

Do NOT make him teleport into the vehicle.

Do NOT have him pass through the bodywork.

He physically enters through the intentionally unfinished driver's-side opening and sits behind the wheel.

Once he is fully seated, glowing construct lines rapidly draw and solidify the final driver's-side door around him, completing the sports car.

The green beam STILL remains connected from the ring on his anatomical RIGHT HAND to the car.

[00:10.5–00:12.0]

Low cinematic three-quarter shot of the completed vehicle.

The futuristic emerald construct sports car powers up.

Internal green energy pulses subtly through its body.

The wheels begin turning.

Dust shifts beneath the tires.

Through the cockpit, the man gives another brief confident, cocky smirk.

His RIGHT HAND remains the hand sustaining the construct.

The continuous green energy connection remains active.

[00:12.0–00:15.0]

The construct sports car launches forward with powerful acceleration.

Real dust and loose dirt kick backward from beneath the glowing green construct wheels.

Camera briefly tracks alongside at a low angle as the vehicle rapidly gains speed.

A beautiful EMERALD-GREEN ENERGY TRAIL streams behind the construct car as it accelerates across the open landscape.

The car sweeps past the camera and drives COMPLETELY OUT OF FRAME.

Do NOT stop the car before it exits.

Do NOT dissolve the vehicle.

Do NOT transform it into another object.

The construct remains a complete futuristic sports car as it leaves the shot.

CRITICAL FINAL CONTINUITY:
The sports car remains actively sustained by the man's RIGHT-HAND power ring while he drives.

The visible green energy connection remains continuously linked to his RIGHT-hand ring and integrated into the construct car's glowing energy structure through the FINAL FRAME.

The ring NEVER appears on his left hand.

No dialogue.
No attack.
No explosion.
No additional constructs.
No additional characters.
No existing real-world vehicles.

overall_soundscape:

Natural open-land ambience with gentle dry wind moving through grass and subtle footsteps on dusty earth at the beginning.

When the RIGHT-HAND ring activates, introduce a clean concentrated emerald-energy hum.

The three-dimensional drawing process produces precise crystalline energy sounds as glowing lines trace the vehicle into existence, followed by deeper resonant energy tones as the wireframe solidifies into the physical construct.

Once completed, the sports car produces a smooth futuristic energy-powered motor sound rather than a conventional gasoline engine.

Subtle rising energy whine as the vehicle powers up.

Construct tires interact physically with the terrain: dirt crunch, tire movement, and a strong burst of dust and gravel as the car accelerates.

The energy motor rises rapidly in pitch as the car drives away, accompanied by a subtle sustained energy sound from the emerald trail.

Natural wind and landscape ambience remain underneath.

No dialogue.

prompts.prompt:
Use the reference image as the sole source for the character’s identity, design, facial features, hair, proportions, outfit, color language, and illustration style.

Create a clean 16:9 artistic character introduction board with an editorial artbook aesthetic. Keep the layout fixed and keep every section in a stable position.

Layout structure:
- Left 40%: one large stylish waist-up portrait pose of the character.
- Upper-right area: 3 full-body character pose panels arranged horizontally in a single row.
- Lower-right area: 3 cinematic environment panels arranged horizontally in a single row directly below the full-body poses.
- Bottom full-width strip: one horizontal color palette derived directly from the reference character.

Use a single solid off-white background across the entire board. Keep the outer canvas clean and uniform with no gradients, textures, scenery, decorative background patterns, or color blocks behind the layout.

Do not rearrange, resize, swap, or reinterpret these sections. The large portrait must stay on the left. The 3 full-body poses must stay in the upper-right row. The 3 environment panels must stay in the lower-right row. The color palette must stay along the bottom.

The 3 full-body pose panels must clearly show the character’s full silhouette, outfit, and personality through different poses.

The 3 environment panels must also include the character, shown in different natural settings and under different lighting conditions. Give the character a different natural pose in each environment, interacting believably with the space through actions such as walking, sitting, leaning, resting, looking out, or casually occupying the scene. Avoid repeated standing poses.

Choose environments, poses, lighting, and visual accents that naturally fit the character’s design and personality. Carry the character-derived color palette throughout the board.

Keep strong character consistency across all panels. Minimal or no typography, subtle framing lines, elegant spacing, polished concept-art presentation. No redesign, no unrelated elements, no watermark.

---
Bottom Video
MiniMax H3 Prompt for Board Animation:

Use the provided character board @[board reference] as the sole visual source. Animate the existing static board itself while preserving the exact 16:9 composition, panel positions, character design, illustration style, color palette, and solid off-white background.

Keep the camera completely static for the entire video. No zoom, pan, tilt, reframing, parallax, or camera movement of any kind. The board itself must remain perfectly locked in place.

The large waist-up portrait on the left is the main animated focal point. Let the character naturally change pose within the existing portrait area: subtle head turns, gaze changes, shoulder and upper-body shifts, small hand or arm movements when visible, expression changes, blinking, breathing, and gentle hair and clothing motion. Avoid repeating a single idle loop. Make it feel like a short sequence of natural portrait poses.

The 3 full-body characters in the upper-right must remain in their exact panel positions and each perform a smooth full 360-degree turn in place, like a character turntable. Preserve their original proportions, outfit, identity, and panel boundaries.

The 3 environment panels in the lower-right must remain fixed inside their frames. Animate each scene subtly and differently, preserving its original setting and lighting. Let the character perform small natural actions appropriate to the environment, such as walking a few steps, shifting posture, sitting naturally, leaning, looking around, or reacting gently to the surroundings. Warm smile.

Scene & Story:
0–3 sec — The Mystery Package
The video opens with a handheld creator-vlog shot in her cozy bedroom during late afternoon. She walks into frame holding a stylish garment bag, looking genuinely curious. She places it on the bed and looks directly into the camera with a playful expression.

She says naturally: “Okay… I found something for tonight, but I have absolutely no clue if I can pull it off.”

She unzips the garment bag, revealing only a glimpse of the outfit.

3–6 sec — First Reveal
She quickly steps behind a nearby room divider. The camera follows with a fast handheld whip-pan.

She emerges wearing a chic fitted top, tailored trousers, and elegant heels. She looks at herself in the mirror, slightly surprised by how good it looks.

She turns toward the camera and says: “Wait… this might actually work.”

She gives a small confident pose.

6–9 sec — The Unexpected Switch
Instead of snapping her fingers, she grabs a jacket hanging beside her and dramatically throws it toward the camera.

As the jacket briefly covers the lens, the outfit seamlessly transforms underneath it.

When she pulls the jacket away, she is wearing a completely different fashion-forward look: a stylish mini dress with statement shoes and subtle accessories.

She looks down, raises one eyebrow, then laughs.

9–12 sec — The Wild Card
She walks toward the mirror while the camera circles around her. She notices a third outfit hanging on the wardrobe door.

Suddenly, she steps backward and spins.

During the spin, her outfit naturally morphs into a glamorous evening look with a sophisticated silhouette, elegant heels, and refined accessories.

The transformation happens continuously during the movement with realistic fabric motion — no jump cut.

12–15 sec — Final Decision
She walks toward the camera with confident energy, then stops very close to the lens.

She looks at the camera, points toward herself, then gestures toward the three outfits visible behind her.

With a playful smile, she says:

“Okay… you’re choosing. Which one?”

The camera quickly pushes in toward her face as she laughs, ending on a natural freeze-like moment.

Ultra-realistic fashion creator vlog, authentic handheld camera movement, natural body language, expressive facial reactions, realistic fabric physics, seamless outfit transitions, natural hair movement, subtle mirror reflections, cinematic depth of field, realistic skin texture, soft late-afternoon daylight mixed with warm practical bedroom lighting, detailed wardrobe and bedroom environment, premium fashion-film aesthetic while maintaining casual YouTube-vlog energy.

Camera:
Handheld selfie framing, medium shots, quick whip-pans, subtle camera shake, smooth tracking movements, one controlled orbit around the character, final slow push-in.

Natural bedroom ambience, fabric and wardrobe sounds, footsteps, garment movement, subtle mirror-room reverb, upbeat modern fashion-vlog background music, natural spoken dialogue, soft whoosh effects during the outfit transitions. No subtitles, no logos, no watermark.

prompts.prompt:
时长：15秒
画幅：9:16竖屏
类型：超写实家庭情景喜剧、真人短剧、快速对话剪辑
人物：双主角
参考图1：固定为男主
参考图2：固定为女主
人物的脸型、五官、发型、体型、服装和年龄感始终严格沿用各自参考图，不重新设计服装，不交换人物身份。
字幕：不要任何对白字幕、底部字幕、标题或贴纸。
语言：自然英语对白，准确口型同步。

整体风格：
高度真实的真人家庭短剧，普通住宅的客厅与餐厅连通，带一点老式家庭录像质感。暖黄色钨丝灯、自然肤质、轻微胶片颗粒、真实室内阴影，色彩温暖但不过度精致。镜头以固定机位、快速正反打和局部特写为主，节奏紧凑，表演带有克制的荒诞喜剧感，不要夸张卡通化。

场景连续性：
男主坐在木质电脑桌前，桌面放着厚重的老式CRT显示器、米黄色机械键盘和鼠标。女主始终站在男主身后或桌子侧后方。远处餐厅里有几位模糊的家人正在等候吃饭，餐桌上有普通晚餐和餐具，背景人物只做轻微自然动作，不抢镜。

必须锁定以下关键道具：
1. 老式CRT显示器从头到尾始终稳稳留在电脑桌上，绝对不能掉下来、飞起来或罩住男主。
2. 女主拿的是一本轻质硬壳AI资料册，不是显示器、蓝图纸、相框或普通文件夹。
3. 资料册封面朝向镜头时，必须能看见醒目的大字“AI PROMPTS”；下方是较小的“ACTORS AND THE FUTURE OF FILM”，并配有三幅竖向排列的电影概念图。
4. 女主用的是同一本“AI PROMPTS”资料册：先从后方敲男主一下，结尾再把它丢下来盖住男主的脸。

SHOT 1｜家庭争执逐渐升级（00:00-07:60）

Subject：
男主坐在电脑桌前疯狂输入AI提示词；女主站在他身后催促他吃晚饭。

Action：

00:00-00:40：
固定中景建立场景。男主身体前倾，双手快速敲击米黄色键盘，眼睛紧盯CRT显示器，完全沉浸在电脑中。女主站在他身后抱臂，压着怒气注视他。远处家人已经坐在餐桌旁等待。

00:40-01:20：
女主微微弯腰靠近男主，眉头皱起，用质疑、略带厌烦的语气问：

女主：“AI again?”

男主不回头，手指继续敲键盘，用理所当然的语气回答：

男主：“I’m prompting.”

01:20-02:50：
快速切女主肩部近景。她歪了一下头，努力保持耐心，朝餐桌方向示意：

女主：“Come on, it’s dinner time.”

切男主近景。他只短暂回头看她一眼，表情像是被打断后非常不耐烦，随即迅速转回电脑：

男主：“I’m prompting!”

02:50-04:60：
切女主正面近景。她睁大眼睛，难以置信地看着他，声音逐渐提高：

女主：“You’ve been sitting there for twelve hours straight.”

女主说完轻轻摇头，嘴唇抿紧，怒气开始积累。

04:60-07:60：
快速交叉剪辑男主、女主和键盘。

男主越来越亢奋，背部绷紧，身体更加靠近CRT显示器，双手猛烈敲击键盘，连续三次以越来越快、越来越激动的语气喊：

男主：“I’m prompting!”
男主：“I’m prompting!”
男主：“I’m prompting!”

每喊一次就切换一个更近的镜头：第一次是男主半身，第二次是面部近景，第三次是手指高速敲击键盘的超近景。

女主从抱臂变成一只手扶住额头，闭眼缓慢吸气。再次睁眼时，她已经不再争辩，只用冷冷的眼神盯着男主。

Performance：
男主不是单纯生气，而是像沉迷游戏一样对AI生成极度痴迷，语速不断加快；女主的情绪变化必须清楚表现为“克制不满→难以置信→彻底失去耐心”。

Camera：
固定机位快速正反打，男主和女主均采用40—50mm写实人像焦段；随着情绪升级，镜头逐渐由中景推进至近景。不要晃动，不要突然改变房间结构。

Audio：
密集键盘声、远处轻微餐具声和家人交谈声。没有背景音乐，没有字幕。

SHOT 2｜展示所谓“超真实”的AI成果（07:60-11:70）

Subject：
键盘、CRT显示器中的AI生成画面、兴奋的男主与冷漠的女主。

Action：

07:60-08:30：
米黄色键盘超近景。男主双手高速敲击，老式键帽连续下压、回弹，敲击力度越来越大。手指运动必须真实，五指结构正常，不出现多余手指。

08:30-10:30：
切到CRT显示器正面近景。

显示器内是一个简陋的早期AI视频生成界面：灰白色窗口、提示词输入区域、生成进度区域和一个居中的视频预览窗口。

预览窗口中显示一段略显粗糙的AI生成视频：

一名长发女子穿着浅色、略显凌乱并带少量灰尘痕迹的衣服，从一栋带有高大窗户和宽阔入口的庄园建筑前，正对镜头快速奔跑；她神情紧张，双臂弯曲、双手握拳，头发随着奔跑轻微摆动。画面是冷色、低饱和、略微去饱和的电影色调，人物运动有一点早期AI生成视频特有的僵硬和不自然感。

电脑预览画面必须是“长发女子从庄园前正对镜头奔跑”，不是书籍封面的三张图片，不是抽象图案，不是文字页面，也不是现代游戏画面。

10:30-11:20：
切回双人中景。男主兴奋地指向CRT显示器，眼睛发亮，眉毛抬高，像完成了重大作品一样炫耀：

男主：“Look! Very super ultra real!”

说话时男主先指屏幕，然后拍一下键盘，嘴角带着自豪笑容，完全没有注意身后的女主。

11:20-11:70：
镜头焦点从男主缓慢转移到女主。女主面无表情地盯着他，眼神冰冷，随后伸手从桌子侧边拿起一本大号轻质硬壳资料册。

资料册封面必须是：

顶部醒目的大字“AI PROMPTS”；
下方较小的“ACTORS AND THE FUTURE OF FILM”；
封面排列三张电影概念图；
整体看起来像一本关于AI提示词与电影制作的硬壳专业书。

女主拿起资料册后，将它缓慢拉到自己的肩膀后方，准备挥动。男主仍然沉浸在电脑中，毫无察觉。

Camera：
键盘微距特写→CRT正面特写→双人中景→轻微焦点转移到女主与AI资料册。不要使用炫技运镜，以剪辑节奏制造笑点。

Audio：
键盘声突然停止半秒，男主兴奋说话；女主拿起资料册时出现轻微纸壳摩擦声。没有配乐，没有字幕。

SHOT 3｜资料册反转笑点（11:70-15:00）

Subject：
女主、男主、同一本“AI PROMPTS”硬壳资料册，以及始终留在桌上的CRT显示器。

Action：

11:70-12:25：
保持双人中景。女主站在男主右后方，把“AI PROMPTS”资料册拉到右肩后方蓄力，随后沿着清晰的向下弧线快速挥向男主后脑上方。

这是夸张但无伤害的真人情景喜剧动作：资料册为轻质空心道具，第一次拍击发生在男主后脑与后颈上方；接触瞬间由资料册、男主头部和运动模糊共同遮挡，不展示受伤细节。

同时响起一声短促、清脆、稍微夸张的“啪”。

不要让女主拍桌子；资料册的运动轨迹必须明确朝向男主后脑，而不是键盘或桌面。

12:25-12:85：
男主受到惊吓后，头部猛地向前一低，上半身迅速扑向键盘，胸口短暂靠在桌沿。随后身体变软，臀部离开椅子，从椅子侧面顺势滑落到桌子下方，最终跌出画面。

椅子轻微向后滑动，但不要翻倒。动作是连贯的喜剧式滑落，不是人物突然消失、瞬移或被击飞。

CRT显示器始终稳稳留在桌面原位，显示器内仍然停留着庄园前奔跑的AI女子画面。

12:85-14:20：
男主已经跌出画面。女主站在桌边，右手仍然拿着同一本“AI PROMPTS”资料册，身体稍微向前倾，低头看着躺在地上的男主。

她先举起资料册给男主看一眼，封面朝向镜头，确保“AI PROMPTS”清楚可见；随后用冷静、讽刺、带有余怒的语气说道：

女主：“Use this blueprint, you stubborn fool!”

说完后，女主将资料册从手中向男主所在的地面方向松开。不要在中景中完整展示落地过程，以硬切制造结尾笑点。

14:20-14:35：
突然硬切到略微俯拍的地面特写。

男主仰面躺在带有复杂花纹的地毯上，脸部最初完全裸露。双眼闭合，嘴巴微张，双臂无力摊在身体两侧，手掌向上，双腿自然伸直，呈现夸张的“被折腾到没脾气”的喜剧状态。

这一瞬间男主脸上不能有显示器、书籍或其他物品。

14:35-14:55：
停顿约0.1秒后，同一本“AI PROMPTS”硬壳资料册从画面左上方高速落下。

资料册封面始终朝向镜头，运动方向为左上到画面中央的短促斜向下落。它轻轻拍在男主脸上并完整盖住脸部，发出第二声较轻的“啪”。

必须表现完整的三个阶段：

男主裸脸躺地→资料册从左上方进入画面→资料册落下盖住男主的脸。

不能通过瞬间变形或凭空出现省略这个动作。

14:55-15:00：
资料册在男主脸上轻微弹动一次后静止。最终画面定格在封面醒目的“AI PROMPTS”文字、三幅电影概念图，以及男主无力摊开的双臂上。

女主不出现在这个最终地面特写中。CRT显示器也不出现在地面镜头中，因为它仍然留在电脑桌上。

Performance：
第一次资料册拍击前，女主不要大喊大叫，而是保持冷静到有些可怕的表情；男主的跌落需要有明显的头部前倾、身体扑桌、从椅子滑落三个连续动作。最后资料册盖脸是轻质道具喜剧效果，不展示真实伤害。

Camera：
第一次动作使用固定中景，不追随男主跌落；结尾使用略微俯拍、约50mm焦段的地面近景。14.20秒必须使用干净利落的硬切，不能使用溶解、变形转场或镜头穿越。

Audio：
第一次清脆资料册拍击声；
椅子轻微移动声；
男主跌落地毯的闷响；
女主英语对白；
结尾第二次较轻的资料册盖脸声；
最后保留约0.3秒安静的房间环境声。
无背景音乐，无字幕。

---
NEGATIVE / 负面约束：

不要让CRT显示器掉落、移动、飞起、倾倒或罩住男主；
不要让电脑砸到男主；
不要把AI资料册变成CRT显示器、平板电脑、相框、蓝图纸、普通文件夹或其他物体；
不要把第一次动作生成成拍桌子；
不要让资料册击中键盘或桌面；
不要省略男主“扑向键盘→从椅子滑落→跌出画面”的连续动作；
不要让男主瞬移到地面；
不要在最终镜头一开始就用资料册遮住男主，必须先显示裸脸，再让资料册从画面左上方落下盖脸；
不要把资料册封面的三张图误生成在CRT屏幕上；
CRT屏幕只显示长发女子从庄园前正对镜头奔跑的AI生成视频；
除电脑界面和资料册封面外，不要出现任何文字；
不要对白字幕、底部字幕、标题、贴纸、水印或平台Logo；
不要出现血液、伤口、肿胀、骨折或真实受伤效果；
不要恐怖片氛围，不要残酷暴力；
不要卡通渲染、动漫风格、塑料CG皮肤或过度磨皮；
不要人物换脸、身份互换、年龄改变、服装漂移或发型改变；
不要多余人物突然出现；
不要面部融化、嘴型错位、双嘴、唇形不同步；
不要多余手臂、多余手指、手掌粘连、资料册穿手；
不要道具漂浮、穿模、瞬移或尺寸忽大忽小；
不要背景人物完全静止，也不要让背景人物抢镜；
不要镜位漂移、房间结构变化、桌椅位置跳变或CRT显示器位置跳变；

title.en: Dance through the layers of your soul and carve your own masterpiece... ✨
title.zh: Dance through the layers of your soul and carve your own masterpiece... ✨

description.en: A source-verified MiniMax H3 cinematic story prompt with attached video evidence from @abulu8.
description.zh: 由原作者公开 X 帖提供并已核验视频结果的 MiniMax H3电影叙事提示词。

prompts.prompt:
REFERENCE USAGE — nine extracted panels, used in order as @Image1 through @Image9 and matching the nine scenes below. Take every composition, layout, colour, cut shape and layer arrangement from them. The dancer is the same black paper silhouette in all nine.

A 16:9 surreal dance film made entirely of layered cut paper. Every element in every frame is a physical sheet: cut, stacked, embossed and lit on a table. Palette locked to three papers only: warm cream, deep vermilion red and matte charcoal black. No other colour ever appears.

MATERIAL RULE — this governs every movement in the film:
Everything is real cut paper with visible thickness at every cut edge, visible fibre and deckle texture, fine embossed pattern pressed into the sheets, and soft contact shadows from each layer onto the one beneath. Paper moves only as paper can: sheets slide across one another, lift and settle, hinge and fold along creases, curl at their edges, unfurl, fan open, peel back and rotate flat. Nothing ever melts, morphs, liquefies, stretches or deforms. Nothing is smooth, glossy or digital. Keep a handmade imperfection throughout: uneven cuts, a fibre catching the light, a corner lifting.

Lighting and camera: a single soft raking key from the upper left, so every cut edge throws a delicate shadow and every embossed pattern reads in relief. Macro depth of field, shallow focal plane. The camera moves slowly and continuously in every shot, pushing in, drifting or craning, so the stacked layers separate in parallax and the frame reveals itself as real physical depth. This parallax is the most important effect in the film and must be visible in every scene.

Transitions: no hard cuts. Every scene change happens in the material. A foreground paper layer sweeps across frame and when it clears the next scene has been built behind it; or the current scene's layers peel back one by one to the next underneath; or the paper folds along a crease and opens onto somewhere new. Each transition takes about a third of a second and lands on a beat.

The dancer is one flat black paper silhouette throughout, with a fluid skirt cut in loose sweeping shapes. She has no face and no features. She moves with real, elegant, weighted dance motion but always stays a flat cutout: she turns by pivoting flat, she leaps by lifting off the surface with her shadow separating beneath her, and her skirt moves as paper streamers rather than cloth.

[0-1.8s] @Image1. The camera drifts along the winding red ribbon as it unfurls forward across the cream ground, its embossed swirls catching the raking light. The dancer runs and turns along its crest. Paper clouds slide past in the foreground in parallax.

[1.8-3.4s] @Image2. The clouds sweep across and clear onto the profile window. Inside her head the scene assembles: the moon lifts into place, cloud layers slide apart, peonies unfurl petal by petal, the small dancer turns at the centre. The camera pushes gently into the opening.

[3.4-4.8s] @Image3. The scene peels back onto the large black silhouette. She raises one arm slowly and fully as the black and cream waves rise behind her, each wave crest a separate sheet lifting and curling over in sequence. The camera cranes up with her arm.

[4.8-6.5s] @Image4. A wave layer sweeps across and clears onto the valley. The camera flies slowly forward down the pale path between the red mountains as the mountain layers part in deep parallax on both sides. The black sun disc holds still at the far end. The tiny dancer runs ahead of camera.

[6.5-8s] @Image5 The valley folds along a crease and opens onto the spiral. The concentric red rings rotate slowly at different speeds against each other while the dancer turns at the centre, and the camera pushes in toward her. Hypnotic and even.

[8-9.6s] @Image6. The spiral rings slide apart to reveal the carved archway. The camera pushes through the arch as the cranes lift off the flat background one by one and fly in layered depth, the pagodas and red maples separating in parallax. The dancer turns beneath them.

[9.6-11.2s] @Image7. The archway peels open into the field of black shards. The shards fan and scatter outward, red petals lift off the surface and drift through the air, and the dancer moves through the turbulence. The camera holds and lets the paper storm move around her. The most kinetic scene in the film.

[11.2-12.8s] @Image8. The shards settle flat and the enormous red peony unfurls from a closed bud, petal layer by layer opening toward the lens, filling the right of frame. The small dancer walks the cream ground beside it, unhurried. The camera drifts sideways.

[12.8-15s] @Image9. The peony petals sweep across frame and clear onto the sunburst. Every black and red ray fans outward from the centre at once and light blooms behind the dancer as she opens both arms and lifts. Hold on the finished composition, completely still, for the final half second.

Score: an original soothing, mesmerizing, dreamlike piece carries the whole film. Instrumentation is a wordless breathy female voice singing soft open vowels and gentle sighs, warm felt piano, bowed glass harmonics, a plucked koto style string, a low soft pad and a slow shallow pulse. Calm, hypnotic, weightless, quietly emotional. No drums, no percussion beyond the soft pulse, no orchestral swells, no epic build, no words or lyrics of any kind.

The score opens at 0 seconds on a sustained pad and one distant piano note. The breathy wordless vocal enters at 1.8 seconds and floats above everything from then on. The plucked string enters at 4.8 seconds in a slow circling figure. At 6.5 seconds bowed glass harmonics enter under the spiral and the arrangement becomes hypnotic and even. At 9.6 seconds the pulse lifts slightly and the vocal opens wider under the paper storm. At 12.8 seconds everything blooms into one wide sustained warm chord for the sunburst, holding and decaying into silence at the end. The music must never become urgent, dramatic or loud.

Sound design sits very quietly under the score: a soft paper slide on each transition, a delicate rustle as petals lift and shards fan, a light dry flutter as the cranes take off. Barely audible, textural only. No voiceover, no spoken words, no library stock music. The score must be an original composition and must not imitate any existing track.

Do not add text, captions, subtitles, credits, watermarks or logos anywhere. Do not add any fourth colour. Do not give the dancer a face, features or three dimensional volume. No photoreal humans, no cloth simulation, no water, no fire, no glowing particles, no lens flares, no glitter, no digital gradients, no drop shadows that do not come from real layers.

prompts.prompt: Ultra cinematic wide shot: A vast field of burning embers stretches into darkness. Suddenly, an enormous wall of fire races across the ground, sending billions of glowing sparks into the air. The flames twist into a gigantic rotating fire vortex hundreds of feet high. Molten embers, smoke, and liquid fire spiral together, naturally forging the word "IGNITE" from blazing flames. The letters burn brighter and brighter before erupting into a colossal shockwave that fills the screen with fire and incandescent particles. Hollywood fire simulation, ultra-realistic VFX, blockbuster title reveal.

prompts.prompt:
Create a 15-second photorealistic product-fashion video using the uploaded reference video as the primary visual, character, product, and performance reference.

Character & Appearance
Recreate the same woman from the reference video. Keep her facial identity, long dark brown hair with soft bangs, natural glamorous makeup, white fitted sleeveless top, light blue high-waisted jeans, delicate jewelry, bracelets, and rings consistent throughout the video.

Scene & Action

0–3s:
She sits casually on a neatly made bed in a modern luxury bedroom with warm sunlight coming through the windows. She looks directly at the camera and speaks naturally in English while using subtle hand gestures. The exact black sunglasses case from the reference video is beside her.

3–6s:
She picks up the sunglasses case and opens it while continuing to speak. Show a clean close-up of the case and the sunglasses inside.

6–9s:
She removes the black rectangular sunglasses from the case. Show a detailed close-up of the sunglasses, preserving the exact shape, frame design, color, proportions, lenses, and material from the reference video.

9–12s:
She puts the sunglasses on and adjusts them naturally with both hands while continuing to speak directly to the camera. Maintain natural facial expressions and confident fashion-influencer energy.

12–15s:
She moves toward the large mirror and checks her look while wearing the sunglasses. Show both her and her reflection. She makes a final adjustment, then looks confidently toward the camera.

Voice & Lip Sync
The woman must speak naturally in English throughout the video. Use the reference audio as the exact speech reference. Preserve the original words, pronunciation, pacing, pauses, emotion, and conversational tone.

Her speech must be perfectly lip-synced. Match her mouth movements, jaw movement, facial expressions, blinking, eye movement, and subtle head gestures naturally to every spoken word.

Camera
Begin with a medium shot, gradually move closer during the product reveal, use cinematic close-ups for the sunglasses and hands, then transition naturally to a mirror shot. Smooth handheld movement, realistic focus changes, shallow depth of field.

Lighting & Environment
Warm golden-hour sunlight, modern luxury bedroom, white bedding, dark bedside furniture, soft natural shadows, realistic mirror reflections, detailed skin and hair texture.

Style
Photorealistic luxury fashion commercial, realistic human movement, natural influencer-style performance, cinematic composition, premium product detail, realistic hands and fingers, consistent character identity, realistic physics.

Audio
Clear natural female English speech with accurate lip sync, subtle room ambience, and realistic clothing/product sounds. No robotic voice, narrator, subtitles, extra dialogue, or overpowering music.

Important
Follow the reference video's overall visual storytelling, character performance, product appearance, and timing while keeping the final result polished, realistic, and natural.

Format: 16:9
Duration: 15 seconds
Quality: Photorealistic, cinematic, high detail

integrated_multimodal_description:

[Visual Anchor]
A photorealistic cinematic 8-second sequence inside a modern luxury high-speed train. The woman remains seated comfortably beside the panoramic windows while the train continuously moves forward at normal high-speed rail velocity.

ONLY THE WORLD OUTSIDE THE TRAIN travels backward through history.

The train interior NEVER changes.
The woman NEVER changes.
Her clothing NEVER changes.
The windows NEVER change.
The train NEVER changes into an older vehicle.

The woman remains in normal real-time throughout, calmly enjoying the impossible scenery. She breathes naturally, occasionally blinks, subtly follows the landscape with her eyes, and gives a faint knowing smile. She is never frightened, startled, confused, or alarmed. She behaves as though she already knew this would happen.

The historical effect uses a repeating rhythm:

STABLE ERA → RAPID BACKWARD TIME-LAPSE TRANSFORMATION → STABLE ERA → RAPID BACKWARD TIME-LAPSE TRANSFORMATION.

During each stable era, the exterior world moves and behaves at NORMAL REAL-TIME SPEED while the train continues traveling through it.

During each transition, ONLY the exterior environment rapidly rewinds through time.

[00:00.000–00:01.000 — PRESENT DAY]

Begin EXACTLY from <Picture 1>.

The modern train moves naturally forward through the cold snowy alpine landscape.

Strong realistic parallax is visible outside: nearby snow-covered terrain moves quickly past the windows while the distant mountains move more slowly.

The woman quietly watches the scenery.

Natural breathing.
One subtle blink.
Small relaxed eye movement.

The snowy mountain landscape remains stable long enough for the viewer to recognize the present-day setting.

[00:01.000–00:01.500 — FIRST TIME REWIND]

The ENTIRE exterior world suddenly begins rapidly traveling backward through time like an accelerated environmental time-lapse.

There is NO camera cut.

Snow rapidly retreats across the entire landscape.

Frozen ground becomes exposed earth.

Grass spreads rapidly.

Trees and vegetation appear and grow across the mountains and valleys.

The cold white alpine environment smoothly transforms into a lush green temperate landscape.

The transformation happens across ALL visible windows simultaneously.

The woman and modern train remain completely unchanged and continue moving in normal real-time.

[00:01.500–00:02.500 — LUSH GREEN LAND]

The time-lapse transformation STOPS.

The exterior is now a rich green countryside.

Forests, grassy hills, streams, wild vegetation, and distant mountains move naturally past the train.

Everything outside now behaves at normal real-time speed.

Leaves move in the wind.
Water flows naturally.
The train continues traveling forward.

The woman calmly watches and gives a very slight peaceful smile.

[00:02.500–00:03.000 — SECOND TIME REWIND]

The exterior world rapidly rewinds again.

The green countryside transforms through accelerated historical change.

Roads appear as dirt tracks.

Old fences develop.

Buildings rapidly emerge into 19th-century construction.

The entire landscape transitions smoothly into the 1800s.

No cut.

[00:03.000–00:04.100 — 1800s]

The transformation STOPS.

The train now passes through a living 19th-century town and countryside.

The exterior operates at NORMAL SPEED.

Horse-drawn carriages travel along dirt streets.

Horses walk and trot naturally.

People wearing 1800s clothing move along sidewalks and streets.

Old masonry and timber buildings, storefronts, chimneys, wooden fences, wagons, and period street activity pass naturally outside.

NO modern vehicles.
NO modern signs.
NO modern technology outside.

The train continues moving rapidly through the historical environment.

The woman remains relaxed and simply watches.

[00:04.100–00:04.600 — THIRD TIME REWIND]

History rapidly rewinds again.

The 1800s town begins disappearing through a smooth accelerated time-lapse.

Buildings regress and vanish.

Roads deteriorate into ancient tracks.

Modern-style structures disappear completely.

The landscape rapidly transforms into the ancient Roman era.

The transformation occurs across the ENTIRE exterior view simultaneously.

[00:04.600–00:05.800 — ROMAN ERA]

The transformation STOPS.

The train now passes beside a large ancient battlefield.

Everything outside moves at NORMAL REAL-TIME SPEED.

Roman soldiers in historically inspired armor fight opposing barbarian warriors across an open field.

Soldiers run.
Shields collide.
Spears move.
Banners flap in the wind.
Horses cross portions of the battlefield.
Dust rises beneath their feet.

The battle remains at a believable distance from the train and remains entirely outside.

No soldier notices the train.
No soldier approaches the windows.
No one interacts with the woman.

The woman watches the battle calmly.

She gives a small blink and remains completely composed, as though this is expected.

[00:05.800–00:06.300 — MASSIVE TIME REWIND]

The exterior suddenly accelerates backward across an enormous span of history.

The Roman soldiers rapidly disappear.

Battlefield activity vanishes.

Roads disappear.

Structures disappear.

Human civilization disappears completely.

Vegetation, terrain, climate, and geological features rapidly transform in a massive backward time-lapse spanning millions of years.

The modern train and woman remain completely unchanged.

[00:06.300–00:08.000 — PREHISTORIC WORLD]

The transformation STOPS.

The train is now traveling through a vast untouched prehistoric landscape.

Everything outside returns to NORMAL REAL-TIME SPEED.

No humans.
No cities.
No buildings.
No roads.
No modern objects.

A broad primitive landscape stretches toward distant mountains with exposed earth, ancient vegetation, sparse forests, mist, and untouched wilderness.

Several dinosaurs move naturally in the DISTANT landscape.

A huge long-necked dinosaur slowly walks across the far background.

Smaller dinosaurs move farther away among ancient vegetation.

Keep the dinosaurs at believable distances.

NO dinosaur approaches the train.
NO dinosaur looks through the windows.
NO dinosaur attacks.

The train continues traveling forward normally through this prehistoric world.

The woman quietly watches the dinosaurs.

Near the final moment, she gives a subtle knowing smile.

End while the train is still moving through the prehistoric landscape.

[CRITICAL WINDOW CONTINUITY]

ALL panoramic train windows show ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS EXTERIOR WORLD.

The windows must NOT behave like separate television screens.

Do NOT place different eras in different window panes.

Do NOT show snow in one window and green countryside in another.

Do NOT show the 1800s in one window and Romans in another.

Do NOT show Romans in one window and dinosaurs in another.

Whenever time changes, the ENTIRE exterior environment visible through EVERY window changes together as one unified world.

The physical window frames remain normal structural parts of the train, but the exterior beyond them is one continuous landscape.

[CAMERA]

One continuous interior shot for the full 8 seconds.

Maintain approximately the camera composition established by <Picture 1>.

No cuts.
No exterior shots of the train.
No camera leaving the carriage.

Subtle realistic train vibration.

The woman remains clearly visible in the foreground while the panoramic windows remain large enough for the audience to clearly read every historical era.

Strong realistic exterior parallax continuously proves that the train is physically moving forward.

During historical transitions, the camera itself does NOT speed up and the train does NOT accelerate.

Only history outside rewinds rapidly.

overall_soundscape:

Continuous subdued interior ambience of a modern high-speed train: low rail rumble, soft mechanical vibration, subtle air-conditioning, and muted rushing sound from outside.

The woman breathes softly and naturally.

Each stable historical era contributes faint exterior ambience filtered realistically through the sealed train windows.

Present day: soft rushing alpine wind.

Green countryside: faint birds and natural countryside ambience.

1800s: distant horse hooves, carriage wheels, and faint town activity.

Roman era: distant muffled battle cries, shield impacts, horses, and battlefield movement.

Prehistoric era: distant wind, low animal calls, and faint dinosaur vocalizations.

Exterior sounds remain subdued and muffled by the train's glass.

No dialogue.

prompts.prompt:
Create a 15-second viral-ready stylized 3D animation with a bold graphic-poster aesthetic, combining 3D cel shading, abstract motion graphics, surreal transformations, and extremely dynamic camera movement.

STYLE: Stylized 3D toon/cel-shaded animation, low-poly geometric forms, hard-edged shadows, clean surfaces, exaggerated proportions, strong silhouettes, minimal textures, high contrast. Make the world feel like a graphic poster transformed into 3D space. Avoid photorealism and generic CGI.

COLOR PALETTE: Golden yellow, amber, lemon yellow, black, and white dominate the entire video. Metallic gray appears only as a small accent. Red is allowed only on the villain's sofa, liquor, and warning signals.

0–3 SECONDS — INSTANT HOOK:
Open with an extreme close-up of a mysterious 3D graphic object rushing directly toward the camera. Suddenly pull the camera backward to reveal a surreal geometric city made of pipes, grids, sliced buildings, blocks, signs, and mechanical structures. Use a dramatic perspective shift and rapid camera rotation.

3–7 SECONDS — ESCALATION:
The city begins transforming at impossible speed. Buildings split into geometric pieces, pipes twist through the streets, blocks rotate in mid-air, and graphic symbols explode outward. The camera flies through the environment with aggressive parallax, speed ramps, and seamless transitions.

7–11 SECONDS — CHARACTER + SURPRISE:
Reveal the villain sitting on a distinctive red sofa in the middle of the moving city. The villain makes one dramatic gesture. Instantly, the sofa, surrounding architecture, and entire environment transform into a massive surreal 3D geometric structure. Use a rapid push-in followed by a sudden wide shot.

11–14 SECONDS — CLIMAX:
Everything accelerates. Yellow and black geometric elements spiral around the camera. Buildings fold, rotate, compress, and reconstruct. Use extreme perspective, fast tracking, graphic match cuts, silhouettes, diagonal masks, distortion, and a powerful final camera movement.

14–15 SECONDS — LOOP:
The entire world rapidly collapses into the same graphic object from the opening shot. End on the exact visual composition needed to seamlessly connect back to the first frame, creating a perfect infinite loop.

ANIMATION LANGUAGE: Constant motion, squash and stretch, geometric morphing, slicing, flipping, compression, distortion, object transformation, impossible physics, speed ramps, freeze-frame accents, and satisfying visual cause-and-effect.

CAMERA: Extreme push-ins, rapid pull-outs, rotating shots, overhead views, low angles, impossible tracking shots, camera-through-object transitions, sudden perspective changes, and dramatic scale shifts.

FINAL LOOK: Premium, surreal, energetic, highly stylized 3D cel animation that feels like a living graphic poster. Every second must introduce a new visual surprise. Make the first second immediately attention-grabbing and the final second perfectly loopable.

Shaky handheld smartphone footage, pure first-person view, bright clear Manhattan street under shiny midday sun.The camera jerks, sways and shakes heavily like a real phone held by someone walking backward in panic. Sharp sunlight, hard shadows, clean blue sky above brick buildings and dry asphalt. Strong natural motion blur and smartphone digital noise.
Continuous 20-second sequence (new subject + vehicle every 5 seconds):
[0s–5s] Operator walks backward from a white man in a black agent suit and sunglasses. The operator’s hand silently points urgently behind the man. The man turns his head, eyes widening in shock as he sees a bright red sports car drifting sideways at high speed toward him. The car slides in at an angle with screeching tires and physically slams into his body first — the impact throws him hard against the hood. Only after the physical hit does his body dissipate into a chaotic spray of tiny randomized fragments — almost pure thick cream mixed with very small irregular cake crumbs, no large pieces. The intricate cream explosion splatters in all directions, coating the red hood, windshield and street in messy streaks and droplets. The suit is ripped off by the force and either sticks to the car or drops to the ground. Cream heavily sprays across the lens.
[5s–10s] Camera keeps shaking and moving back. A Black woman in a business blazer. Operator silently points hard behind her. She turns, face reacting with sudden fear as a dark blue SUV drifts sharply toward her. The SUV locks brakes mid-drift and physically smashes into her body first. Immediately after the impact her body dissipates into an intricate burst of tiny randomized particles — mostly thick chocolate cream with only minuscule dark cake crumbs. The fine cream spray coats the blue SUV surface and asphalt in dense, chaotic patterns. The blazer and skirt are torn away, parts sticking to the vehicle mixed with cream, the rest dropping naturally. Chocolate cream heavily splatters the lens.
[10s–15s] Operator still walking backward, phone shaking. An Asian man in a hoodie. Operator silently points behind him. The man turns and freezes in panic seeing a white delivery van sliding into a wide drift. The van physically crashes into his body first. Right after the hit he dissipates into a highly randomized spray of tiny fragments — almost entirely cream with very small scattered sponge and fruit particles. The intricate cream explosion covers the van and pavement in messy droplets and streaks. The hoodie and jeans are stripped off, some cloth remaining on the van mixed with cream, the rest falling with natural physics. Cream hits the lens hard.
[15s–20s] Camera continues with heavy smartphone shake. A Latina woman in a trench coat. Operator silently points urgently behind her. She spins around, eyes wide in terror as a black pickup truck performs a long cinematic drift straight at her. The truck physically hits her body first. Only then does her body dissipate into a fine, chaotic spray of tiny randomized particles — mostly thick caramel cream with only minute golden crumbs. prompts.prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-photorealistic live-action war sequence set in the United States in 1947, designed to look like authentic historical footage captured on a 1940s film camera. The entire scene must feel grounded, documentary-like, raw, and physically realistic.
Environment: A rural American town in 1947 with wooden houses, old brick buildings, telephone poles, dirt roads, vintage American cars from the 1940s, wooden fences, farmland, and period-accurate street details. Overcast afternoon light, light fog, drifting smoke, dust in the air, damaged buildings, scattered debris, and a tense wartime atmosphere.
Characters: American soldiers wearing historically accurate late-1940s military uniforms, helmets, boots, and equipment. Civilians wear authentic 1940s American clothing. Natural faces, realistic skin texture, sweat, dirt, fatigue, and believable body movements.
0–3s — Establishing Shot:
Wide handheld shot of a quiet rural American street suddenly filled with smoke and confusion. Vintage 1940s vehicles are parked along the road while soldiers move quickly between wooden buildings. Civilians rush toward safer areas.
3–6s — Tension:
Camera moves through the street at shoulder height, following several soldiers as distant gunfire is heard. They immediately react and take cover behind a vintage vehicle and a brick wall. Their movements are cautious and realistic.
6–10s — Combat:
Fast handheld tracking shot as the soldiers move between cover while distant gunfire impacts the environment. Small pieces of wood, dust, and debris fall naturally from nearby impacts. Weapon recoil, movement, and body weight must be physically accurate. Keep the violence realistic and restrained.
10–13s — Human Moment:
Camera briefly focuses on a soldier helping an injured civilian move behind cover. Their breathing, facial expressions, body language, and movement should feel natural and unscripted.
13–15s — Final Shot:
Camera pulls back into a wide shot of the American town as smoke slowly moves through the street. Soldiers remain behind cover while vintage vehicles and damaged buildings fill the background. The scene ends with an authentic, tense 1940s documentary feeling.
Visual Style: Ultra-photorealistic live-action, authentic 1940s American environment, vintage 35mm film texture, subtle film grain, natural imperfections, realistic exposure, handheld documentary cinematography, muted historical color palette, realistic smoke and dust, natural shadows, accurate depth of field.
Physics: Strictly obey real-world gravity, momentum, inertia, friction, recoil, weight, collision physics, and human biomechanics. No exaggerated explosions, impossible movements, superhero behavior, or choreographed-looking combat.
Negative Prompt: modern buildings, modern cars, smartphones, modern clothing, modern weapons, futuristic technology, CGI appearance, video-game graphics, fantasy, superhero action, excessive explosions, excessive blood, gore, impossible physics, unrealistic recoil, slow-motion physics, distorted faces, extra limbs, floating objects, plastic skin, artificial-looking environments.

Chill:

7.
Fizz:
<d>[English] I’M BACK!</d>

8.
Fizz:
<d>[English] You guys saved me.</d>

9.
Chill:
<d>[English] Technically, the bubble did.</d>

If timing becomes crowded:

REMOVE secondary lines.

Do NOT make dialogue unnaturally fast.

Let:

- expressions
- movement
- sound effects
- music

tell much of the story.

==================================================
SAFETY / CONTENT RULES
==================================================

Everything remains cute and family-friendly.

No injury.
No violence.

No sharp attacks.
