prompts.prompt:
1⃣Reference one: the main menu screen.
📌PROMT:
Render a 16:9 video game main menu screen — one clean in-game screenshot from a premium Renaissance action game.  THE CHARACTER is the woman from Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa, rebuilt as a stylized three-dimensional game character and standing at full body. Her likeness is exact: a serene oval face with a high smooth forehead, softly rounded cheeks, a straight narrow nose, heavy-lidded warm dark brown eyes gazing calmly and directly at the viewer, barely present brows, and the faint closed-lip smile with its ambiguous lifted corners. The right corner of her mouth lifts marginally higher than the left. Long dark brown hair parted at the centre falls in soft loose waves past her shoulders, a sheer dark translucent veil laid over the crown and draping down behind. Warm ivory skin with soft subsurface shading.  She wears her Renaissance Florentine gown: deep olive-brown velvet bodice gathered into fine vertical pleats across the chest, a wide square neckline edged in delicate gold interlace embroidery, ruched ochre-gold satin sleeves full at the upper arm and narrowing to the wrist, and a heavy olive skirt falling straight to the floor in soft folds.  She stands in the left two thirds of the frame, turned a few degrees toward camera, both hands folded one gently over the other at waist height in the exact attitude of the painting, head turned toward the viewer, perfectly still. Beneath her is a dark polished marble floor catching a soft warm reflection of her gown. Behind her the environment falls into a deep shadowed Renaissance interior — suggestions of stone arches and one distant warm window, heavily defocused and dark so she reads clean against it. A soft warm rim of candlelight separates her silhouette from the darkness.  THE INTERFACE sits over the image, rendered as aged gold and dark lacquered plates:  Upper left, a player profile bar — a black plate with an engraved gold border holding a large clear circular portrait frame showing her own face in close detail, the name "LISA" in an elegant engraved serif, a level badge reading "III", and a slim experience meter half filled with warm gold.  Right side, a vertical main menu of five stacked buttons on black plates with gold beveled edges and engraved serif labels, top to bottom: "PLAY", "WARDROBE", "APPEARANCE", "ARMOURY", "SETTINGS". The second button, "WARDROBE", sits highlighted with a solid gold fill and dark engraved text. The rest are gold text on black.  A gold arrow cursor with a fine dark outline rests over the highlighted "WARDROBE" button, a small click burst behind its tip.  Lower left, a health and stamina cluster — two slim stacked meters in warm gold and deep crimson on black, with a small numeric readout beside them reading "3 / 3".  Lower right, a small circular gold-rimmed compass dial on black with faint engraved terrain lines inside and a directional marker at the top.  Bottom centre, three small engraved prompts in a row reading "SELECT", "BACK" and "CONFIRM", each beside a small gold key glyph.  TYPOGRAPHY: every label in an elegant engraved serif with fine hairlines and sharp bracketed feet, uppercase, generously tracked, in warm antique gold. All text English, correctly spelled, every glyph crisp and fully legible.  PALETTE: deep near-black ground, warm antique gold as the only bright interface value, one deep crimson accent appearing solely in the health meter, and the olive and ochre of her gown as the single area of colour in the frame.  LOOK: stylized three-dimensional game character render against a real-time game environment, physically based materials, soft warm candlelight key from camera-left, deep warm shadows, gentle bloom on the gold interface edges, faint craquelure texture in the darkest plate areas.

2⃣Reference two:the item sheet.
📌PROMT:
Render a 16:9 sheet of game interface item slots on a deep near-black ground. The sheet contains three separate vertical panels standing side by side with clear empty space between them. There is no text anywhere on this sheet — no labels, no captions, no numbers, no letters of any kind. Only frames and images inside them.  Each panel is a tall column of three stacked square item slots. Every slot is a black plate with an ornate engraved antique gold frame, fine bracketed corners and a soft inner bevel, in the style of a Renaissance game interface. The three panels are identical in size, frame design and slot spacing.  LEFT PANEL — three outfits, each shown as a small full-body figure of the same dark-haired Renaissance woman standing frontally against the black slot interior, lit warmly from the left: Slot one: a long deep blue brocade court gown with gold thread across the bodice, full skirt to the floor, ruched sleeves. Slot two: a crimson silk gown with a boned dark metal corset laced over it, the skirt split high on one side, gold-trimmed sleeves. Slot three: fitted black leather shorts, a cropped black leather top laced across the chest with gold cord, thigh-high black leather boots and slim gold vambraces on both forearms.  CENTRE PANEL — three hairstyles, each shown as a head-and-shoulders view of the same woman against the black slot interior, seen from the front, lit warmly from the left: Slot one: long loose dark waves parted at the centre under a sheer dark translucent veil. Slot two: the hair wound up into a sculpted coiled braid crown threaded with fine gold chain, the nape bare, two loose tendrils beside the face. Slot three: the hair swept up high on the crown into a long full ponytail bound with a gold cuff, the tail falling heavy behind the shoulder.  RIGHT PANEL — three weapons, each shown as an object alone against the black slot interior, angled diagonally and lit warmly from the left: Slot one: two matched short daggers with dark blued steel blades and gold quillons, crossed over one another. Slot two: a single broad-headed war axe with a dark walnut haft and gold engraving on the head. Slot three: a slender straight duelling sword with an ornate swept gold hilt of interlaced bars and a long polished steel blade.  In every panel the third slot down carries a warm gold highlight fill behind its image, marking it as the selected one, while the upper two sit on plain black.  LOOK: warm antique gold frames catching a soft low sheen with fine engraved line work, deep near-black slot interiors, warm directional light from the left across every miniature, soft contact shadows under the standing figures, gentle bloom on the brightest gold edges, faint craquelure in the darkest areas. Flat even illumination across the whole sheet, every slot equally sharp, rendered as clean production game interface assets.  PALETTE: deep near-black, warm antique gold, and the colour of each item — blue brocade, crimson silk, black leather, dark hair, blued steel.

3⃣Reference three: the game world with its HUD — quest tracker, minimap, health bar, weapon slot.
📌PROMT:
Render a 16:9 in-game third-person gameplay screenshot from a premium Renaissance action game. The frame shows the world and the interface only, with no character present.  THE WORLD: a broad Renaissance city street in Florence at early morning, seen from a third-person camera positioned low and looking down the street. Warm golden sunlight rakes in from the left at a low angle, throwing long soft shadows across pale stone paving. Tall ochre and cream plaster buildings rise on both sides with terracotta roofs, green shutters thrown open, iron brackets and coloured cloth banners hanging still in the calm air. Terracotta pots of flowers sit on windowsills. Market stalls with striped awnings line the near left, a few crates and baskets beside them. Townspeople in period dress move through the middle distance, small and softly out of focus. At the end of the street a great cathedral dome rises against a pale blue morning sky streaked with high thin cloud. Fine dust and pollen drift through the sunbeams. The whole frame is bright, warm and open.  THE HEADS-UP DISPLAY sits over the world, rendered as aged gold and dark lacquered plates with fine engraved line work, kept crisp and readable against the bright scene:  Lower left, a health and stamina cluster — two slim stacked meters on dark plates, the upper one filled deep crimson beside a small engraved heart glyph, the lower one filled warm gold beside a small lightning glyph, with the numerals "3 / 3" alongside.  Upper right, a circular minimap on a gold-rimmed dial — a small overhead map view of the surrounding streets in muted gold line work on near-black, a directional arrow marker at its centre, the letter "N" at the top edge, and two small gold diamond markers placed within it.  Upper left, a quest tracker on a narrow dark plate with an engraved gold border, headed "CURRENT TASK" in small engraved caps, with a single line beneath reading "REACH THE CATHEDRAL" and a small gold diamond marker beside it.  Centre, floating in the world above the road at the far end of the street, a large gold diamond quest marker with a soft glow and a thin drop shadow.  Lower right, a weapon slot — a small square dark plate with a gold frame containing an engraved icon of a slender rapier, with the label "RAPIER" beneath it in small engraved caps.  Bottom centre, three small engraved prompts in a row reading "MOVE", "ATTACK" and "INTERACT", each beside a small gold key glyph.  TYPOGRAPHY: every label in an elegant engraved serif with fine hairlines and sharp bracketed feet, uppercase, generously tracked, in warm antique gold. All text English, correctly spelled, every glyph crisp and fully legible.  PALETTE: warm ochre, cream stone and terracotta under golden morning light, pale blue sky, warm antique gold interface, one deep crimson accent in the health meter.  LOOK: real-time game engine render, physically based materials, volumetric morning sunbeams, gentle bloom on the brightest stone and gold interface edges, soft atmospheric haze building with distance, cinematic third-person framing.

4⃣The animation prompt.
📌PROMT:
Use @Image 1 for the character and the menu interface style. Use @Image 2 for the game world and the in-game HUD style. Use @Image 3 as the source for every item thumbnail shown inside the panels — its left column holds the three outfits, its centre column holds the three hairstyles, its right column holds the three weapons, each in that exact order top to bottom.  One continuous shot, no cuts. The camera moves smoothly and constantly. Every panel stays fully inside the frame, positioned to the right of the character and large enough to read clearly.  [0–2 seconds] Wide shot matching @Image 1, camera drifting slowly forward. The Mona Lisa character stands in the dark candlelit hall in her olive velvet gown and sheer veil, hands folded, still. She blinks once, slowly. The gold cursor travels down the right-hand menu across PLAY and onto WARDROBE, each button flaring gold as it passes. The cursor clicks WARDROBE with a sharp gold burst.  [2–5.5 seconds] Ease in slightly, holding a full-body framing. A WARDROBE panel slides in on the right, filling the right third of frame — a vertical column of three ornate gold-framed slots carrying the three outfit thumbnails from the left column of @Image 3, in that exact order: blue brocade gown at the top, crimson silk gown in the middle, black leather set at the bottom. The selector highlights the top slot and her gown becomes the deep blue brocade court gown. The selector drops to the middle slot and her gown becomes the crimson silk gown with the boned corset. The selector drops to the bottom slot and locks: her long skirt dissolves upward in gold particles and reassembles as fitted black leather shorts, the bodice tightens into a cropped black leather top laced across the chest with gold cord, thigh-high black leather boots build up her legs plate by plate, and slim gold vambraces snap onto both forearms.  [5.5–8.5 seconds] Rise smoothly to a medium shot from the waist up, keeping the panel column fully visible beside her. An APPEARANCE panel slides in on the right in the same position and size, carrying the three hairstyle thumbnails from the centre column of @Image 3, in that exact order: veiled waves at the top, coiled braid crown in the middle, high ponytail at the bottom. The selector highlights the middle slot and her hair winds itself up into the coiled braid crown threaded with gold chain. The selector drops to the bottom slot and locks: the sheer veil dissolves into gold particles and clears frame, her waves sweep upward and gather high on the crown into a long full ponytail bound with a gold cuff, the tail falling heavy behind her shoulder and swinging once as it settles. Her face stays exactly as it is throughout — the same serene gaze and the same faint closed-lip smile.  [8.5–11 seconds] Ease down to a medium shot showing her from the hips up with both hands in frame, the panel column still fully visible beside her. An ARMOURY panel slides in on the right in the same position and size, carrying the three weapon thumbnails from the right column of @Image 3, in that exact order: crossed twin daggers at the top, war axe in the middle, gold-hilted duelling sword at the bottom. The selector highlights the top slot and two matched daggers assemble from gold particles, one in each hand. The selector drops to the middle slot and they break apart and reform as the broad war axe held across her body. The selector drops to the bottom slot and locks: the axe dissolves and the slender duelling sword builds itself in her right hand piece by piece — the swept gold hilt forming first, then the long polished steel blade extending outward with a bright ring. She lowers it to her side, point down.  [11–12.5 seconds] Pull back smoothly to a full-body shot. A CONFIRM button flashes gold at frame centre and the cursor clicks it. Every panel collapses inward and vanishes. A LOADING bar sweeps in along the bottom and races from 0% to 100%. The dark hall brightens as warm golden daylight bleeds in from the left and the shadows retreat.  [12.5–15 seconds] The world loads in around her: the sunlit Florence street from @Image 2 assembles outward from her feet — pale stone paving, ochre buildings, striped market awnings, hanging banners, townspeople walking, the cathedral dome rising at the end of the road under a pale blue morning sky. The camera swings around behind her and settles into a third-person gameplay position at her shoulder. The HUD fades in exactly as in @Image 2: CURRENT TASK reading REACH THE CATHEDRAL at upper left, circular minimap upper right, health and stamina meters lower left, weapon slot lower right showing the sword icon, and a large gold diamond quest marker floating above the road ahead. She stands with her back fully to camera, ponytail swinging, sword at her side, and takes her first step forward down the street.  AUDIO — a game interface soundscape where every selection is loud and unmistakable: The interface sounds sit forward in the mix and are the clearest element in the piece. Every cursor hover fires a bright short gold chime. Every click lands as a hard mechanical thunk with a metallic tail, sharp and percussive, immediately audible. Every selector step down a row snaps with a crisp tick. Every panel slides in on a parchment whoosh and closes on a wooden clack. Under this, open on the quiet hush of a stone hall with a low candle-flame crackle and a soft sustained lute drone. Each outfit change carries a rush of cloth and a fine shimmer of particles; the leather build adds creaking hide and small metal snaps. The hair change is a soft sweep finishing on one gold cuff click. Each weapon assembly is sharp metal on metal, the sword finishing on a long bright blade ring. CONFIRM lands on a full resonant gold chime. The loading bar hums and rises in pitch as it fills. At 12.5 seconds the hall reverb drops away and the open street opens up: distant market chatter, birdsong, a cart wheel, footsteps on stone, warm Renaissance strings and lute swelling underneath. Ends on her boot striking the paving. Do not imitate an existing melody.  Full speed throughout with no slow motion. Her face, gaze and faint closed-lip smile stay identical across every beat. All interface text in English, correctly spelled, every glyph crisp and legible.

prompts.prompt:
Use the reference @ image for the exact character design, clothing, proportions, blue hair, pointed ears and glowing cyan spirit fox. Preserve the cinematic stylized 3D look, saturated teal jungle palette, soft volumetric light and detailed natural textures. No dialogue; environmental sound only.

0–4 seconds: Begin close to the reference composition on the ancient stone bridge. The girl kneels beside the small glowing spirit fox as ripples begin moving backward across the stream below. She notices the unnatural movement and looks over her shoulder. A massive moss-covered stone serpent suddenly erupts from beneath the bridge, lifting one side of the platform. The stone tilts physically under her weight. She loses balance, catches herself with one hand and quickly pulls the spirit fox against her chest as cracks spread beneath her knees.

4–10 seconds: The bridge collapses progressively behind her. She rises naturally from the crouch and sprints barefoot across the tilting stone slabs, carrying the fox securely with one arm. Each footfall dislodges moss and small fragments; broken slabs fall with believable weight and strike the water below, producing delayed splashes. The camera tracks closely beside her at waist height. The serpent sweeps its heavy stone tail across her path. She drops into a fast knee slide beneath it; her torn cloak and blue hair trail behind with clear inertia. Still moving forward, she catches a hanging vine with her free hand. Her momentum pulls the vine taut and swings her outward across the widening gap while the camera arcs alongside her.

10–15 seconds: At the highest point of the swing, the vine begins tearing from the temple ceiling. She releases before it snaps, travels forward in a natural gravity-driven arc and lands hard on the opposite platform. She absorbs the impact through her feet and one hand, then rolls once across her shoulder while protecting the fox against her chest. The camera drops and rolls partially with her, then stabilizes behind her as she rises into a defensive crouch. The spirit fox leaps from her arms and lands in front of her, its cyan light intensifying as the serpent crashes into the broken bridge behind them, sending water, dust and stone fragments through the backlight.

Maintain one continuous route and clear cause-and-effect motion. No teleporting, floating, sudden directional changes, extra characters, costume changes or transformation of the girl. Keep the fox small throughout; only its light becomes brighter in the final moment.

Use all uploaded reference images exactly as provided.

The reference images are authoritative.

Maintain complete consistency throughout the entire video.

Do not redesign, reinterpret, stylize, replace, simplify, or modify the woman's face, skin tone, hairstyle, hands, body proportions, clothing, facial expressions, the AURELIA package, the coffee cup, the kitchen, the lighting, or the environment.

The AURELIA package is the primary subject of the commercial and must remain clearly visible whenever it appears.

The word "AURELIA" on the package must remain perfectly readable throughout the video.

The product is always more important than the typography.

Typography must complement the scene and must never cover the product.

Use natural colours, realistic lighting, realistic steam, realistic reflections, realistic skin texture, realistic hand movements, realistic liquid movement, and realistic shadows.

title.zh: 金继长剑无缝循环

description.en: A source-verified MiniMax H3 fashion prompt with attached video evidence.
description.zh: 由原作者公开 X 帖提供并已核验视频结果的 MiniMax H3时尚提示词。

prompts.prompt:
Prompt #MiniMaxH3 in Chinese:

15秒 | 16:9 | 1440p | 24fps | 无缝循环

[角色锁定] 完全按照 @image1 呈现，不进行任何重新设计。蓬松的蓝灰色波浪短发，刘海垂落遮住上半张脸；面容清秀，唇色偏暖；珊瑚朱红色宽袖长袍，腰间层层缠绕的宽腰带，深色内衬；持剑手戴深色手套。长剑：华丽的银金巴洛克护手与柄头，镜面剑身映出真实的天空与云。全片不得改动发量与卷曲走向、刘海遮眼的方式、袍身轮廓、腰带缠法、手套、护手纹样与剑身比例。

[循环 · 核心设定] 剑身自第一帧起就已布满一张固定的旧金脉之网——那是它此前碎裂并被金继修补留下的痕迹。本片是这一循环中的又一次：它沿着既有金脉再次裂开，碎片散去，熔金重新灌回同样的裂缝，恢复成完全相同的样子。不增添任何新金脉、不改变其走向与数量。最后一帧须与第一帧完全一致。

[剑的恒定 · 最高优先级] 重铸后的剑必须与开场完全相同：长度、宽度、弧度、剑尖、护手雕花、柄头、缠柄、镜面质感、金脉走向数量粗细、刻痕位置，逐一对应。严禁任何形态变化——不得变长变大、不得生出新纹饰或棱刺、不得产生光晕或能量外溢、不得改变颜色材质、不得出现任何“进化”“觉醒”“强化形态”式转变。金只填回原有裂缝，绝不溢出剑身之外、绝不覆盖镜面。

[解剖锁定 · 最高优先级] 全片有且仅有一名人物：两条手臂、两只手、每只手五指、一把剑。严禁多余的手臂、手掌、手指或第二把武器。高速转身与运动模糊中，残影绝不可被渲染成额外肢体。手部每帧结构完整、指节分明；戴手套的手握柄，空出的手须清晰可见且有明确朝向。

[沉浸 · 观众入画] 画面本身是一张真实存在的和纸，镜头是观众伸进这个世界的一只眼睛，世界会反过来影响它。
一、画面裂纹：0.9 秒剑开裂的同一帧，一道极细的裂纹自画面中心向四角蔓延，如同观看的这块玻璃也被划开；裂纹全片存在并缓慢加深，10.8 秒起被金继之金一并填补，13.8 秒前完全消失。
二、纸的边界：画面四边的和纸纤维始终微微起伏，重击时被掀起并向内卷曲，露出纸的毛边。
三、墨上镜头：3.2 秒的长弧甩出的墨点直接溅在镜头上，附着后沿纸纤维缓慢晕开，随后逐渐变淡，13.8 秒前完全干透消失。
四、倒影中的观众：2.2 秒与 13.4 秒各有一片碎片旋转至极近处，其镜面中短暂映出镜头本身与其外的一片天光，仿佛观众看见了自己所在的位置——只出现一瞬即转开。
五、沉入：7.0 至 8.8 秒，墨云直扑镜头并将其吞没，镜头沉入墨中——四周被浓墨包裹，仅上方透出天光与她的剪影，纸纤维如絮状物在“水中”缓缓漂过，画面轻微起伏如同随液体晃动；8.8 秒墨向下退去，镜头破“水面”而出。
所有以上效果必须在 13.8 秒前彻底清除，最后一帧的画面须与第一帧一样干净。

[场景 · 明亮] 高空之上，正午。头顶通透饱和的湛蓝天空，向地平线渐变为明亮浅色薄雾；脚下极远处是被阳光照亮的洁白积云海。她悬浮其中——无地面、无建筑、无道具。金箔长带随上升气流飘过。全片阳光充沛、明亮通透，绝不转阴、绝不去饱和。

[色彩] 天空 #2E6FA8 渐变至 #CFE3EF。长袍珊瑚朱红 #D9563F，褶皱 #A63A2A。头发蓝灰 #8CA3B8，边缘接暖色轮廓光。手套与内衬 #14161C。护手做旧银金。碎片映出真实蓝天白云。墨为纯黑 #0A0A0C。金脉为哑光金箔 #C9962E，熔金前沿炽白金 #FFEBB0，冷却后回到完全相同的 #C9962E。

[风格与质感] 水墨画与照相级玻璃的融合。整个画面覆盖极淡的和纸纤维质感；天空与云以水墨渲染，边缘晕开带枯笔飞白；人物与剑为完全清晰的实体渲染，如实体嵌在画中。金为真实金箔——极薄、有褶皱、氧化磨损、受光不均。碎片有真实厚度与内部裂纹，每片映出不同的云。发丝逐根渲染，逆光半透明；袍料厚重，褶皱有真实重量与回弹；护手雕花凹处压暗。胶片高光滚降，金上柔和光晕，细腻颗粒。

[特效] 逐级升级：剑锋所过之处墨如入水般翻卷晕开；金箔自长带剥落飘散；墨与金彼此排斥绝不相融，如大理石纹互相推挤；高速动作拖出枯笔飞白擦痕；每次重击有一帧纯墨黑剪影；熔金沿裂缝奔流，前沿炽白，其后冷却为哑光金箔。

[动画法则] 每个动作遵循预备—爆发—收势：出手前明确反向蓄势，爆发只占少数帧，收势有减速与轻微过冲后回位，绝不匀速。发丝、宽袖、袍摆、腰带末端各以不同延迟跟随身体，绝不同步启停。所有轨迹为弧线。高空中一切略带浮力感。杜绝任何僵硬、停顿或不自然的关节角度。

[逐拍动作]
0.0-1.4 她双手垂落，右手握剑于身侧偏后，剑斜指下方，头微低、刘海遮眼；仅呼吸使胸口微起伏。剑沿一道既有金脉裂开，手指本能收紧一下。
1.4-3.2 剑沿所有金脉同时裂开脱手，碎片向外散开，断口边缘皆为原有的金。右手仍维持握持姿势停在半空，指节微张；左手抬至胸前，掌心向上；头始终微低。
3.2-5.2 右手将空柄自身侧向斜上方划出完整长弧，腰胯先行带动肩背，宽袖甩开翻卷；收势时手腕轻微过冲后回位，左手向后平展保持平衡。
5.2-7.0 侧身转体半周，重心自右脚移至左脚，袍摆螺旋展开；转身中右手将空柄换至身前反握，左手抬至面侧。
7.0-8.8 虚空中一蹬，身体略下沉蓄势，双臂猛地向两侧张开召回碎片；随后双臂收拢至胸前，掌心相对，碎片锁定成环。
8.8-10.8 一次真实的挥臂与转身，被不同渲染风格切分呈现。
10.8-13.0 右手缓缓翻转、掌心向上再合拢，碎片沿手臂旋绕归位；剑成形时五指依次收紧扣柄，手臂承力下沉半寸，肩线压低。
13.0-13.8 第一次抬起头，刘海被气流分开露出双眼，平视镜头；手腕转动一周使金脉迎光。
13.8-15.0 缓缓垂下手腕，剑回到身侧偏后斜指下方；头重新低下，刘海落回遮眼，左手垂落身侧——完全回到第一帧姿势。

[表演] 全片沉静克制。碎裂时无惊慌，只有指节一次收紧；召回时下颌微抬、呼吸加深；金脉合拢时嘴角极细微的松动；抬头对视时眼神平静笃定；垂下头时回归最初的静默。

[署名] 剑身护手上方刃根处刻有 CIA0（大写 C、大写 I、大写 A、数字零；末位是数字零而非字母 O），小号宽字距镌刻大写，是剑本身的一部分，绝非叠加图层。刻痕内自第一帧起已嵌金，重铸后完全相同，绝不变亮变大或增添装饰。

[文字 · 墨落纸上] 所有文字为湿润毛笔书法渗入画面本身的和纸纤维：落笔带刷毛痕迹与枯笔断白，墨沿纤维晕开一拍后随纸干淡去。拉丁文为厚重镌刻衬线，日文为浓墨重笔竖排于侧三分之一。文字位于她身后并被遮挡，绝不覆盖面部。以下须原样逐字呈现：
0.8秒「墨」竖排右三分之一
2.4秒 "IT HAS BROKEN BEFORE" 单行靠左
5.0秒 "EVERY CRACK" / "REMEMBERS THE SKY" 两行堆叠靠左
7.6秒「金継」竖排左三分之一，墨将干时自笔画渗出金色
10.6秒 "AND WILL AGAIN" 先落墨再被金箔灌满
13.2秒 居中标题组：「天墨」上方，"INKFALL" 下方，须在 14.4 秒前完全淡去，最后一帧不得残留任何文字

@Image1 [摄影] 变形宽银幕，椭圆焦外，暖色条状光斑，180 度快门，轻微桶形畸变。摇臂有质量、起停缓入缓出；甩镜末端轻微过冲后回稳；移焦有极短过冲再回拉。前景始终有金箔长带、碎片或袍袖掠过制造视差。
0.0-1.4 100mm 微距沿镜面剑身向护手行进，云影流过钢面，金脉与刻痕掠过。
1.4-3.2 35mm 环绕碎片场 180 度，穿行于碎片之间。
3.2-5.2 24mm 广角随长弧上升，天空大面积入画。
5.2-7.0 18mm 一镜到底，推入一片碎片的倒影穿过，自另一侧高处回望她。
7.0-8.8 沉入墨中，镜头略微上仰仰望她的剪影，随液体轻微起伏。
8.8-10.8 焦段随拍点跳切，85mm 特写与 24mm 广角交替。
10.8-13.0 50mm 缓慢推入，荷兰角自五度回正。
13.0-13.8 85mm 面部特写。
13.8-15.0 自面部缓缓下降推近，沿剑身回到 100mm 微距，与第一帧完全对位。

[分镜]
0.0-1.4 循环点。微距沿镜面剑身疾行，云影流过钢面。剑沿一道既有金脉缓慢裂开如薄冰崩解；同一帧，一道细裂纹自画面中心向四角蔓延。墨自裂口涌出黑色羽状云。
1.4-3.2 悬停。镜头环绕漂浮的碎片场，每片缓缓自转，各自捧着一角天空，断口的金边闪烁；2.2 秒一片碎片旋至极近，镜面中一瞬映出镜头本身。她悬于中心，刘海遮眼。
3.2-5.2 墨绽。她以空柄划出长弧，在整片天空拖出巨大水墨笔触，湿黑弧带枯笔飞白；甩出的墨点溅上镜头并沿纸纤维晕开。落入墨中的碎片转为剪影。
5.2-7.0 穿镜。一镜到底：镜头推入一片碎片的倒影并穿过，自另一侧高处回望她；金箔长带掠过镜头，她的转身拖出枯笔擦痕。
7.0-8.8 沉入。墨云直扑镜头并将其吞没——四周被浓墨包裹，仅上方透出天光与她张开双臂的剪影，纸纤维如絮状物缓缓漂过，画面随液体轻微起伏，画面裂纹在墨中被压出细密支线。8.8 秒墨向下退去，镜头破出水面，碎片同帧翻转锁成绕她缓转的环。
8.8-10.8 水墨蒙太奇，一帧一姿态交替渲染：纸白底纯墨线稿、朱红与青蓝二色木版画帧、黑底金箔剪影、枯笔拖影帧、一帧全画面墨色反转、完整渲染。墨点与金屑持续累积绝不重置。
10.8-13.0 金继。碎片沿手臂旋绕归位，断口一一对上；熔金沿原有裂缝灌回，前沿炽白，其后冷却为哑光金箔，最终与开场金脉完全一致，不多一道不少一道。同时画面上那道裂纹也被金一并填补、随后金色渐渐淡去。全画面光线转暖。
13.0-13.8 对视。她第一次抬头，刘海分开露出双眼，平视镜头；13.4 秒一片余留的碎片旋过，镜面中再度一瞬映出镜头。手腕转动一周使金脉迎光。
13.8-15.0 归位。她垂下手腕与视线，剑回到身侧，刘海落回遮眼；镜头上的墨点干透消失，画面裂纹与金色痕迹尽数退去，文字淡尽；镜头沿剑身回到开场微距。最后一帧与第一帧完全一致。

[音频] 每个音效卡在准确帧上，混音首尾相接可循环。底层：高空稀薄空气感，远处持续的风，一层极淡的纸张摩挲声。
0.0-1.4 上行金属长鸣，玻璃缓慢开裂的绵长脆响，接墨入水的低沉涌动，画面裂开时一记极细的近场脆响仿佛就在耳边。
1.4-3.2 近乎静默——碎片自转的细微水晶轻响，墨翻卷的低频液流，一次屏住的呼吸。
3.2-5.2 宽阔湿笔拖过纸面的摩擦，墨沿纤维扩散的细密嘶声，墨点溅上镜头的一记极近的湿响，其下尺八吐息升起。
5.2-7.0 进入碎片时气压骤降，内部闷响的封闭音，穿出一记清亮释放，金箔长带掠过的猎猎。
7.0-8.8 沉入——全频瞬间被厚重低通滤波吞没，只余低沉的液体涌动、遥远变形的风声与一次缓慢的心跳；8.8 秒破水而出，高频与空气感轰然回归。
8.8-10.8 八记毛笔击打卡在每次剪辑上，墨点飞溅，风格间以短滤波门分隔，反转帧一记太鼓。
10.8-13.0 温暖低鸣升起，熔金奔流的柔和噼啪，每道裂缝闭合一声清亮短鸣，古筝音阶逐级上行。
13.0-13.8 延长的尺八长音，剑身转动的清亮金属鸣响。
13.8-15.0 一切收束——袖摆落定的柔响，一次平缓呼气，解析为与开场完全相同的高空风声与纸声，无缝接回起点。
配乐：极简温暖，仅古筝与尺八。3.2 秒进入，7.0 至 8.8 秒随沉入被一同滤掉，8.8 秒回归，10.8 秒起弦乐加入，13.8 秒退出仅余风声，与开场首音无缝相接。无对白。

[限制] 只有一名人物，两条手臂，两只手，一把剑。剑自第一帧即带金脉，重铸后与第一帧完全相同，严禁任何形态、尺寸、纹饰、颜色或光效变化。墨保持纯黑、金保持金箔，绝不混合成褐色。所有文字须为湿墨渗入纸面，绝非平贴叠加。镜头上的墨、画面裂纹与金痕须在 13.8 秒前彻底清除。刻痕须准确拼写为 CIA0。除上述文字外无任何标识、水印或字幕。无地面、无建筑、无道具。全片明亮饱和。首尾帧完全一致，两帧中都不得残留任何文字或镜头污迹。

prompts.prompt:
Create a 15-second photorealistic cinematic dark-fantasy battlefield sequence in 16:9 widescreen. The video contains exactly two shots connected by one clean hard cut at approximately 11 seconds. No dissolves, morphing transitions or montage editing.

MASTER CREATURE LOCK:
Show exactly one colossal ash-white bat-dragon with wyvern anatomy. The creature has one broad skull-like head, two glowing ember-red eyes, one enormous mouth filled with long dark teeth, pale hairless scaled skin, a powerful chest, two muscular hind legs, one long narrow tail and one pair of gigantic bat-like wings. Its wings have strong finger-like bones supporting huge semi-translucent pale membranes. The wings glow warm orange when backlit by the battlefield fires.

The bat-dragon has no separate forelegs or human arms. Its wings are its only front limbs. Its design, colour, face, size, anatomy and wing structure remain identical throughout both shots. It never transforms, multiplies, changes colour or grows additional limbs.

BATTLEFIELD AND ARMY:
A vast apocalyptic fantasy battlefield beneath turbulent charcoal-grey storm clouds. The ground is dark, broken and covered with ash, embers, scorched rocks and drifting smoke. Large walls of orange fire burn across the distant horizon, strongly backlighting the approaching bat-dragon.

Hundreds of shadowy horned warriors crowd the battlefield. The warriors wear dark rough armour and simple horned helmets. Keep the warriors anonymous, visually similar and mostly seen as small silhouettes. No individual warrior is a main character and no faces require close detail. The army fills the foreground and middle distance to establish the impossible scale of the flying creature.

Use a cold grey-blue environment contrasted with intense orange firelight, glowing embers and warm translucent wing membranes. The environment must remain clearly visible through the smoke.

SHOT 1 — COLOSSAL LOW FLYOVER, 0–11 SECONDS:
Begin with a low ground-level ultra-wide camera positioned inside the tightly packed horned army, looking toward the burning horizon. Foreground warriors partially frame the bottom and sides of the image. The handheld camera moves slightly between the crowd while always looking forward.

Through the smoke and fire, the silhouette of one colossal bat-dragon appears in the sky. Its enormous folded wing shape initially resembles two mountains rising through the flames. The dragon then opens both wings to their full symmetrical width, completely dominating the sky. Bright orange fire shines through the pale wing membranes while the creature’s red eyes become visible.

The dragon performs one slow, immensely powerful downward wingbeat and descends toward the battlefield. The wingbeat pushes smoke outward in a huge circular pattern. The army looks upward and begins moving in panic as the creature rapidly approaches.

The bat-dragon glides extremely low above the battlefield without landing. Its chest and head pass just above the horned warriors. It banks slightly, bringing one enormous wing close over the foreground camera while the other wing remains fully visible and correctly attached. The wing itself does not physically strike the warriors.

The pressure wave created by the low flyover blasts across the army. Ash, embers, loose weapons, cloth and small pieces of debris surge sideways through the frame. Foreground warriors are knocked off balance, lifted briefly and scattered by the powerful wind, tumbling away from the creature without graphic impact or injury. Keep the movement chaotic but physically believable.

The camera shakes violently from the wing pressure and quickly pans to follow the dragon’s low flight across the battlefield. Flames bend beneath the airflow and smoke rolls outward behind the creature. Maintain a clear view of the same bat-dragon throughout the flyover. The dragon must not disappear completely behind its own wing or the smoke.

SHOT 2 — FRONTAL ROARING CHARGE, 11–15 SECONDS:
At approximately 11 seconds, make one clean hard cut to a frontal low-angle telephoto shot directly in the bat-dragon’s flight path. The creature is already flying forward through thick smoke and towering flames, coming straight toward the camera.

Keep both enormous wings visible on either side of its body as they perform one powerful coordinated wingbeat. The glowing red eyes remain locked directly on the camera. Burning embers stream around the creature while the orange flames behind it illuminate the translucent wing membranes.

As the bat-dragon rapidly closes the distance, it lowers its skull-like head and opens its enormous mouth, revealing multiple rows of long sharp teeth. It releases a deafening roar directly toward the camera. The force of the roar pushes smoke and embers outward from its face.

The camera retreats slightly while the dragon continues approaching, creating intense forward momentum. Finish just before impact with the creature’s roaring face, glowing eyes and wings dominating the frame. The dragon does not hit or pass through the camera.

CAMERA AND MOTION:
Shot one uses a low handheld battlefield perspective with strong scale, foreground silhouettes, realistic parallax and a fast pan following the flyover. Shot two uses a steady frontal tracking camera that retreats as the dragon approaches. Use cinematic motion blur on the wing tips, airborne ash and scattered debris, but keep the creature’s face and body sharply readable. The motion must feel fast, heavy and dangerous rather than weightless.

VISUAL QUALITY:
Premium big-budget dark-fantasy visual effects, photorealistic creature texture, physically accurate wing membranes, believable muscles moving beneath pale skin, enormous scale, detailed fire and smoke simulations, dense volumetric atmosphere, realistic aerodynamic pressure, strong depth, natural motion blur, sharp creature details and dramatic fire backlighting.

AUDIO:
No dialogue and no music. Roaring battlefield fire, panicked distant army sounds, rushing wind, deep leathery wingbeats, armour rattling, debris scraping across the ground, heavy low-frequency pressure wave and one terrifying creature roar during the final frontal approach.

STRICT CONSISTENCY:
Exactly one bat-dragon. No additional flying creatures. No rider. Exactly one head, two eyes, one mouth, two wings, two hind legs and one tail. No extra wings, arms, heads, faces or tails. The wings must remain attached to the same creature and must not turn into hands. The dragon never lands, breathes fire or changes design. Keep both wings intact and symmetrical. The horned warriors remain separate from the dragon and do not merge into its body. No visible casualties, blood, gore, text, subtitles, logos or real-world symbols.

Create a surreal 15-second fashion-film sequence inside a minimalist monochrome blue studio.  The woman performs an elegant contemporary dance.  The man casually walks into frame wearing a completely serious expression.  Without explanation, he immediately joins the choreography.  His movements are awkward, strangely confident, almost ritualistic.  The woman never acknowledges him.  The horse behaves as though both dancers are part of its routine.  It wanders through the studio.  Runs behind them.  Appears from impossible places.  Stops.  Looks directly into the camera.  Leaves.  Returns again. Every movement is intentional.  Every frame feels designed.  Throughout the sequence, premium kinetic typography appears as part of the composition, not subtitles, but editorial motion graphics inspired by high-end After Effects title design.  Animated words flash for only a few frames:  THE GARDENER.  THE DRIVER.  THE HORSE.  THE WOMAN.  KNIFE.  MOVE.  FASTER.  AGAIN.  THE EXIT. These words slam into frame, wrap around the dancers, disappear behind bodies, stretch with motion blur, rotate in 3D, fragment into pieces, reveal through masks, pulse with the bass, smear across cuts, become oversized, tiny, vertical, upside down, and constantly transform using premium motion-design techniques.  Add abstract editorial graphics: animated arrows, circles, blueprint lines, tape labels, interface markers, halftone textures, scribbles, grain, tracking graphics, geometric overlays, chromatic aberration, liquid masks, flash frames, split screens, typography trails, speed ramps and graphic wipes.  Music evolves into strange electronic art-pop.  Analog synths.  Mechanical breathing.  Heavy bass.  Everything is synchronized to the rhythm.  Final close-up.  The woman whispers:  "Again."  The man quietly smiles for the first time.  The horse suddenly sprints directly toward the camera.  The word  AGAIN.  fills the screen before an instant cut to black.

Editing: Fast rhythm editing. Only hard cuts. No fade. No smooth transitions. Every cut follows: bass hit, snare, rap vocal impact.

Character Performance Three female performers from reference image 1. Keep: same 3D chibi doll faces, big sparkling eyes, pastel Y2K idol makeup, pink/blue/purple fashion styling, soft cute cold expression. Each member has a signature prop: A holds a chunky rhinestone microphone, B has a plush bear shoulder bag, C wears oversized heart-shaped sunglasses pushed up on head. They are not posing. They are performing rap. Actions: aggressive eye contact, head nodding, shoulder movement, leaning toward camera, hand pushing toward lens, confident cute facial expression, sharp body movement, wink on snare hit, tongue-out on bass drop, hair flip on beat. Lip sync: perfect rap mouth synchronization. The performance should feel like a real K-pop rap unit MV with Y2K crush energy.

Typography Animation Typography is a visual weapon. Not subtitles. Not static graphics. Use: giant English words inflated 3D rubber bubble font, jelly plastic material, pink lavender ice-blue chrome, soft puffy candy letters, compressed bold balloon fonts, stretched vertical puffy letters, handwritten graffiti titles, 3D extruded candy text, glitch displacement, print error effect, Y2K game UI pixel corruption. Text appears only when the beat hits. Characters can cover the text. Text can cover parts of clothing. Never cover eyes or main facial expression. Tiny Y2K stickers burst on beat: heart, star, smiley, sparkle, chain link, bow, four-leaf clover, mini bear.

Shot 1 — Member A · Extreme Close-up「RUN NOW」 Character A face close-up, framed inside a pink heart-shaped iris wipe transition (in only, hard cut out). She looks directly into camera. Cute cold doll expression, big dewy eyes, soft blush, frosted pink lip gloss, rhinestone tear sticker under one eye. Starts rap. Chunky rhinestone microphone enters frame from below, she grips it tightly. Camera slowly pushes closer. Tiny pink heart stickers float up from bottom edge like bubbles. Huge inflated bubble letters crash into frame from left and right. Typography: "RUN NOW" — Pink jelly rubber 3D font, glossy candy surface, soft inner glow. Letters stretch vertically like puffy balloons. The word vibrates and squishes with bass, casts soft pink shadow on her cheek. Rap: "Run now, I don't chase." Confetti burst on final syllable. Hard cut.

Shot 2 — Member B · Rap Performance「BREAK LIMIT」 Member B medium close-up, slight low angle, camera orbits 15° around her during the take. Lavender fur jacket, Y2K layered top, plush bear bag bouncing on her hip, chunky pearl choker, star-shaped earrings. She performs aggressively. Shoulders hit the rhythm. Hair flips hard on the second snare, blue hair ties catch the light. Hair moves naturally. Background: pastel gradient pink-to-lavender with faint Y2K perspective grid lines floating. Behind her appears huge handwritten text. Typography: "BREAK LIMIT" — Ice-blue bubble graffiti brush writing, soft inflated stroke, candy-coated, letters appear one by one with bounce easing. Animation: letters tear apart, reassemble, rotate 360° on snare, shake with bass. Chain link graphic swings across frame, sparkle stickers pop on every beat. Rap: "Break limits, break rules." Hard cut.

Shot 3 — Member C · Hand Attack Shot「NO APOLOGY」 Member C moves close to camera. Top-down camera angle, she leans over the lens. Hand reaches toward lens. Nails are long pink acrylic with 3D star and heart charms. Focus: rings with mini plush bear charm, heart-cut gemstone, baby-pink leather texture, knit ribbed sleeve, plushy toy surface. Foreground vertical text: "NO APOLOGY" — Stretched vertical pink bubble letters, jelly puffy material, letters pierce through the back of her hand visually. Hand covers part of the typography. Fingers spread wide on the bass hit. Camera: handheld vibration. Film grain strong. Candy halftone dots bloom in shadow. Tiny "XOXO" sticker tag pulses in corner. Rap: "No apology, no regret." Hard cut.

Shot 4 — Fashion Magazine Impact Cut「UNSTOPPABLE」 Member A close-up. Her face appears inside a broken Y2K trading card / idol photo card frame, with barcode at bottom, "SYS.07-A" serial tag, holographic foil border torn on left side. Not a full layout. Only one graphic element. Typography: "UNSTOPPABLE" — Huge lavender handwritten bubble text, inflated 3D rubber, glossy plastic finish, letters explode outward from center of her forehead, push edges of the card frame. Animation: text suddenly expands from behind her. Card frame rips in half vertically, holographic confetti pours from the tear, revealing pastel gradient background underneath. A second smaller photo card of her winks in from the right, slightly rotated. Rap: "Can't stop my wave." Hard cut.

Shot 5 — Glitch Double Image「STATIC」 Member B close-up, slight Dutch angle (5° tilt). Create: duplicate frame, pastel RGB separation (pink/blue/lavender channels), xerox shadow, motion trail, VHS tracking line at bottom edge. Main face stays sharp. She holds a sparkly heart-shaped lollipop up beside her cheek, the lollipop leaves a trail of echo frames. Background text: "STATIC" — Y2K pixel font, candy pink chrome, letters flicker like broken game sprite, jump between frames, sometimes inverted color, sometimes missing entirely. Like corrupted music video signal + cute game glitch. A tiny "ERROR 404" sticker blinks in upper corner. Rap: "Static noise, I get louder." Hard cut.

Shot 6 — Pink Blue Purple Battle「PINK OUT」 Member A and C alternate close-ups, rhythm: A-A-C-A-C-C, two frames each. Fast switching. Visual split: each member sits in a vertical color block (A=pink, C=lavender, alternating). Center text: "PINK OUT" — Pastel pink-to-purple gradient bubble 3D, letters appear one word at a time, syncing to each cut. Words appear one by one. Each word: stretch vertically on entry, compress horizontally on hold, invert color on snare, explode into heart stickers and star confetti on exit. Tiny "1.2.3.GO!" counter graphic ticks in corner. Rap: "Lights out, pink out." Hard cut.

Shot 7 — Group Rap Performance「UNBREAKABLE」 Three members together.

prompts.prompt:
Create a 15-second cinematic showdown between the most technologically advanced human and the most primordial warrior.

The technological fighter wears adaptive nano-armor, holographic interfaces, energy weapons, and glowing cybernetic implants.

The primordial fighter is massive and feral, covered in ritual markings, bone armor, and animal hides, wielding a brutal stone weapon.

prompts.prompt:
@Hailuo_AI Prompt #MiniMaxH3 in Chinese:

无缝循环 | 网页首屏动画

[核心概念] 她的每一个动作都对应一种网页交互行为，她不是站在网页前，而是在演示这个网页如何运作。加载、悬停、点击、滚动、拖拽、轮播、提交、刷新——八种交互依次发生，每一种都有对应的冰质界面反馈。

[人物锁定 · @image1] 完全按照该参考图呈现，不进行任何重新设计。
容貌：年轻女性，薄荷绿齐颏短发，发丝随动作轻扬；锐利的浅青碧色双眼，青色指甲，水晶坠耳饰。
服装：白色剪裁西装——敞开的外套与长裤，领口环绕金色巴洛克卷草纹饰件，肩披缀满蓝色冰晶尖刺的深色皮草披领，腰间垂挂细金链，大腿绑黑色枪套束带。
武器：两把华丽的银质左轮手枪，一手一把，枪管为冰蓝色水晶质，枪身雕花，转轮与击锤细节完整。
场景：宏伟的宫殿大厅，高耸的拱形长窗，暖金色内饰，大理石地面有真实反射。窗外天光冷，室内金暖，冷暖对比贯穿全片。
全片不得改动发型、面容、西装轮廓、金饰卷草纹、披领结构、枪械造型与比例。

[解剖与武器锁定 · 最高优先级] 全片自始至终只有：两条手臂、两只手、每只手五指、恰好两把左轮——右手一把、左手一把，绝无第三把。拖拽段左枪明确入套，左手空出且五指清晰。所有转枪、滑步、射击及其运动模糊中，残影绝不可被渲染成额外肢体或额外枪械；手部每一帧结构完整、指节分明、扳机指位置明确。枪绝不悬空、绝不复制。

[网页 UI/UX 系统 · 冰质界面] 画面按 12 栏网格构建，外边距 6%，栏间距 2%。安全区：第 1 至 5 栏为网页标题与按钮预留，人物与主冰晶结构全程不进入第 1 至 4 栏。
所有界面元素由「冰」构成——发丝级霜线，半透明，具真实折射，如结在一层看不见的玻璃上。界面配色：霜线冰白 #EDF4F8，激活态冰蓝 #9FD8EC，确认态暖金 #D9A94C。
骨架屏：加载段中，尚未「载入」的画面区域以磨砂半透明冰板占位，微微闪烁，内容载入时冰板融化、真实细节浮现。
光标：一枚冰晶准星即是鼠标指针，全片跟随她当前的注意力移动，悬停时展开一圈细霜，点击时收缩并溅霜。
悬停态：被准星悬停的物体表面泛起一层冰蓝微光并轻微上浮。
涟漪反馈：每次「点击」命中处先扩出一圈材质涟漪，再生长冰晶。
滚动条：右缘一根细冰柱随滚动段的横移同步充填。
对齐参考线：拖拽段中，画面闪现发丝级的洋红对齐线 #E23D9B，元素吸附入位时消失。
弹数指示：右下六格冰晶弹仓图标，随射击逐格碎裂。
载入环：一圈环形霜环兼作页面载入条，1.2 秒起步，7.8 秒半圈，11.4 秒闭合爆亮，13.0 秒后逆向融化。
缓动：所有界面与文字入场为标准缓出约 0.4 秒，退场缓入约 0.25 秒，吸附与回弹为轻微过冲后回位，绝不线性、绝不夸张弹跳，多元素错位约 0.06 秒。

[文字系统 · 皆由场景物质生成] 共三处，字形统一为厚重镌刻衬线体——粗竖笔、发丝细横笔、凿刻楔形衬线、宽字距。每处均为三维实体，具厚度、倒角、折射与投影。
以下引号内为画面实际渲染文字，须原样逐字呈现：
1.8秒 "GLACIA"（G-L-A-C-I-A，全大写）由悬浮冰晶碎片在她身侧半空组装，每片旋转就位成为字母的一个刻面，冰体内部具次表面散射与气泡，边缘折射细彩虹，保持两拍后碎为粉雪。
7.4秒 "HAILUO AI"（H-A-I-L-U-O 空格 A-I，全大写）以霜花在最大拱形长窗玻璃上蔓延书写——霜沿字形边缘呈羽毛状结晶生长，背后天光透过微亮，随后被继续蔓延的霜幕吞没。
13.4秒 "Cia0"（大写 C、小写 i、小写 a、数字零；末位是数字零而非字母 O，须更窄更椭圆）以细雕刻纹刻于右枪银质枪身，与周围雕花同深度同色泽，仅在收枪入套、掠射高光扫过的一瞬显现，绝不发光、描边或放大。
全片无任何其他文字、日文字符或字幕。

[色彩渐变体系] 全片色彩以渐变构成，绝不平涂。宫殿内饰自受光面暖金 #C9A24A 渐变至阴影蜜褐 #8A6B35；大理石地面冷白 #E8E6E0 带灰纹，反射中带一层冰蓝。窗外天光自窗顶冷蓝 #A8C4D8 渐变至窗底近白。她的西装受光纯白 #F4F0E8 渐变至阴影暖灰 #C9C2B4。冰体自表层冰蓝 #9FD8EC 渐变至核心深青 #3D7A9E，最深处近墨蓝 #1E3A52，边缘折射完整细光谱。霜哑光白。粉雪在逆光中金边、在冷光中蓝边。冷色只属于冰、霜与窗光，暖色只属于宫殿与金饰，冷暖交界处始终是画面张力所在。

[渲染品质] 最高保真。冰具真实次表面散射、内部气泡、生长纹与裂隙，边缘真实色散；霜以羽毛状晶枝逐帧生长，绝非淡入；粉雪具体积感受气流卷动。银枪抛光，雕花凹处压暗，转轮转动时反射流动。西装挺括、褶皱真实回弹；皮草逐撮渲染，冰刺在其间折射；发丝逐根渲染，甩动滞后。大理石反射她与冰晶的完整倒影。胶片式高光滚降，阴影提亮，最亮金处柔和光晕，细腻颗粒，绝不过曝。

[特效 · 冰之弹道] 每发子弹是一颗冰种：弹道拖出瞬间结晶的霜线；命中处先扩涟漪、再以延时摄影速度生长冰花、冰枝、倒悬冰吊灯，逐帧可见生长；枪口喷冷雾而非火光；弹壳空中结霜、落地叮当结冰；她呼吸带白汽；足下薄霜外蔓；冰体折射窗光在金饰上投下游动冷斑

@Hailuo_AI @Image1 ；变形镜条状光斑掠过每处高光；焦外粉雪呈椭圆光斑；高潮处大厅被冰晶架构半包裹，暖金自冰后透出。冰晶持续累积，绝不消失，直至终段统一升华。

[动作编排 · 交互映射，每拍双手双枪明确]
0.0-1.4 加载。无人物。窗玻璃霜结微距，四角霜框结晶延展，骨架屏冰板铺陈画面，载入环起步。
1.4-3.0 载入完成。骨架冰板自左至右依次融化，大厅细节逐区浮现锐化，最后一块融化处是她——背对长窗，双枪在套，抬眼，一次白汽呼吸。准星光标出现。"GLACIA" 组装。
3.0-4.6 悬停与点击按下。准星飘移至她的右侧枪套，枪套泛起冰蓝悬停微光并轻浮；她右手拔枪的瞬间即是按下——准星收缩溅霜。左手随后拔左枪，双枪各转一周停稳，动作利落克制。
4.6-6.2 点击反馈。右枪射出第一发——弹道霜线飞越大厅，命中远柱：先一圈材质涟漪扩开，再炸开生长冰花。左枪抬起戒备。准星随弹道飞移并在命中点收缩。
6.2-7.8 滚动。她沿大理石侧滑横移——整页随之「滚动」：前景柱、中景冰晶、远景长窗以不同速度视差掠过，右缘冰柱滚动条同步充填。滑行中双枪交替朝上射三发，各在头顶炸开一座倒悬冰吊灯，如同锚点依次钉入。霜同时在长窗上写出文字。
7.8-9.6 拖拽与跳转，一镜到底。她滑停，左枪利落入套；左手抓住一块悬浮的冰晶面板向右横拖——洋红对齐参考线闪现，面板轻微过冲后吸附入位；吸附瞬间右枪朝面板中心射出一发，镜头贴弹穿过面板冰体——穿越时全画面被冰内折射充满，如一次页面跳转——穿出后甩回她，她已单膝滑跪停稳。
9.6-11.4 轮播。八拍每拍 0.225 秒，如八张卡片依次滑入：一、白底冰蓝线稿，仅双枪与双手；二、冰蓝与暖金色块拼贴；三、二色剪影纯白配金；四、完整渲染一记真实双枪同射；五、拖影帧；六、整帧负片反转仅此一帧；七、线稿叠加冰晶折射；八、完整渲染短暂静止。每拍以水平滑切衔接如卡片轮播，冰晶持续累积。
11.4-13.0 提交。两帧全静止。她起身，双枪缓缓合拢指向镜头——如按下主按钮——同时扣动扳机，两发弹道在镜头正前交汇，一朵冰花在镜面绽放生长为成功态；透过冰花看见她放下双枪、直视镜头的双眼。载入环闭合爆亮转暖金。
13.0-15.0 刷新。全厅冰晶自下而上依次升华为粉雪与冷雾，如一次下拉刷新将页面推起。她双枪先右后左旋入枪套，掠射高光扫过右枪显现刻纹。首屏版式于第 1 至 5 栏短暂组装——霜线导航与三枚冰晶圆点、显示级 "GLACIA"、其下霜线圆角按钮内含 "ENTER"——保持 0.8 秒后融化。镜头推回窗玻璃霜结微距。最后一帧与第一帧完全一致。

[摄影] 变形宽银幕，椭圆焦外，冷暖双色条状光斑，180 度快门。每镜头具明确动机与前中后三层纵深——粉雪、悬浮冰屑或披领冰刺始终在前景制造视差。人物始终位于第 6 至 12 栏。
0.0-1.4 100mm 微距贴窗，霜枝逐帧生长掠过，随后离窗后拉。
1.4-3.0 摇臂自窗顶缓降至她身后半身，逆窗光，骨架冰板在镜头前逐块融化。
3.0-4.6 40mm 低位轻推，拔枪双臂划过前景，荷兰角三度。
4.6-6.2 85mm 咬住枪口，射击瞬间甩镜追弹道，命中点急停看涟漪与冰花生长。
6.2-7.8 24mm 低位横移与滑步同速同向，三层视差完整展开，三次射击各一次轻微震镜。
7.8-9.6 一镜到底：随拖拽横移，吸附瞬间轻微过冲，随后贴弹穿板，穿越段升格至四分之一速，甩回实速。
9.6-11.4 焦段随拍点跳切，85mm 与 24mm 交替，以水平滑切模拟轮播。
11.4-13.0 50mm 正面缓推，冰花在镜面绽放时短暂定格。
13.0-15.0 缓慢后拉环视升华的大厅，随后推回窗玻璃微距，与第一帧对位。
转场一律以粉雪与冷雾溶解；仅轮播段硬切加静音门；提交前两帧全静止蓄力。

[物理] 重量与利落优先。左轮真实后坐——腕部上弹、小臂吸收、肩部微沉，双枪同射全身后压半步。滑步真实借力，外套下摆与披领变向滞后回弹。拖拽面板时左臂可见牵引力，吸附瞬间手臂随之一顿。弹壳受重力落地弹跳。冰晶生长推开空气，粉雪受动作气流卷动。杜绝任何僵硬、停顿或不自然的关节角度。

[音频] 每个音效卡在其画面拍点的准确帧上，混音首尾相接可循环。界面音与物理音融合：每种交互都有一枚清脆的冰质界面音——悬停一声轻霜，点击一声脆响，吸附一声实响，确认一声暖钟。底层：宏大室内安静混响，窗外极远风声，细微冰体应力吟。
0.0-1.4 霜枝生长的细密结晶声，骨架冰板的低频闪烁嗡鸣，载入环起步的一声轻起。
1.4-3.0 冰板逐块融化的水晶滴落音阶，她的呼吸与白汽，冷弦乐铺底进入，"GLACIA" 组装的逐片轻响。
3.0-4.6 悬停轻霜音，拔枪的皮革与金属滑响、点击脆响，转枪机械咔哒，双击锤两声。
4.6-6.2 第一声枪响带冰质混响尾音，涟漪扩开的一圈水纹音，冰花生长密集脆响，弹壳冰叮。
6.2-7.8 滑步摩擦与滚动条充填的细流声，三声交替枪响各带回声，冰吊灯层叠生长，霜爬窗细密声。
7.8-9.6 左枪入套一声，拖拽的冰面摩擦，对齐线两声轻嘀，吸附一声实响带轻微过冲回弹音；穿板段一切拉长降调，甩回实速，滑跪一声实响。
9.6-11.4 八记打击卡在八拍——枪响、冰裂、击锤交替，水平滑切各带一声卡片掠

prompts.prompt: /gen prompt: Cinematic wildlife documentary, vertical framing, subject centered, National Geographic award-winning cinematography, anamorphic lens, rich natural color, natural sunlight, natural motion blur. States: the scream never stops, the camera always rises, every touched object reacts. Characters: a blue-and-gold macaw, cobalt wings, golden chest, green crown, white face patch, black beak; a young man, short dark curly hair, olive t-shirt. Israeli white stone apartment building, living room. 0-2s macro: silence, the macaw inhales, chest swelling, throat feathers rising, the man mid-sip. 2-5s the beak opens, the world slams into extreme slow motion: a ripple of distorted air expands from the beak, rings race across his coffee, the mug shattering into countable shards, coffee hanging in ropes, his cheeks rippling back. 5-9s time snaps back; the wave blows the shutters open, the camera rides it out, straight up the facade. 9-14s rising floor by floor: laundry lines whipping, a dog howling in one window; crawl on pigeons detonating off a ledge, feathers suspended, the ripple passing them; snap back. 14-17s the roof: solar heaters trembling, tank water rippling, car alarms flashing far below; bold 3D text "105 DB" slams centered mid-frame. 17-20s hard cut to the room: the macaw fluffs, tilts its head, one tiny chirp; the man frozen with the mug handle. Audio: silence, a heartbeat on the inhale; a sub-bass shockwave, one raw macaw screech Doppler shifting as the camera climbs, glass shatter, dogs and alarms join, biggest boom on the text, ringing silence, a tiny chirp. prompts.prompt:
CHARACTER & WORLD LOCK + FULL 15-SEC MASTER PROMPT

A 15-second continuous UGC-style vlog in 9:16 vertical format. Jessy, a woman in her mid-20s — use her facial features exactly as shown in her reference photo, keep everything else about the scene freshly designed — wears an attractive pastel-colored dress (soft lavender, mint, or buttery yellow) that visually pops in contrast against the bubblegum-pink Olipop can. Location: a bright, clean modern kitchen/countertop with soft natural daylight. Product: a can of Olipop Blackberry Vanilla — pastel pink can, magenta blackberry illustration, white vanilla flower, dark green "Blackberry Vanilla" wordmark, "Supports Digestive Health" text near the top, "A New Kind of Soda™" tagline (use the uploaded product photo as the exact visual reference for the can). Style: authentic smartphone UGC vlog, natural handheld feel, realistic skin texture, no over-retouched look. She speaks casual, upbeat, conversational English directly to camera with natural lip-sync.

The video follows this exact beat sheet, with clean cuts between each moment:

00:00–00:02 — Front-camera selfie, slight handheld sway, Jessy fans herself lightly in the kitchen, looking for something refreshing, smiles at camera: "Okay I need something fun to drink right now."

00:02–00:04 — Eye-level medium shot, she opens the fridge and pulls out the pink Olipop can, face lighting up with delight: "Ooh, Blackberry Vanilla Olipop — yes please."

00:04–00:06 — Close-up on her hands slowly turning the can, label details ("Prebiotics, Botanics, Plant Fiber") visible: "Prebiotics AND it tastes like dessert? Sold."

00:10–00:12 — Close-up on her face as she sips, eyes lighting up with genuine, pleasantly surprised reaction: "Wait... that's actually so good."

00:13–00:14 — Medium shot, she smiles at camera, can raised slightly at chest height: "Blackberry vanilla was the right call."

00:14–00:15 — Close front-camera selfie, can held beside her face, warm bright smile into the lens: "Go grab an Olipop, seriously."

Continuous natural ambient kitchen sound, subtle upbeat pop background music underneath, her voice clear and casual throughout. Consistent face, outfit, and setting across every beat. No text overlays, no captions, no watermarks, no horizontal framing, no changes to the can's design or branding.

prompts.prompt:
@Hailuo_AI Prompt #MiniMaxH3 in Chinese:

15秒 | 16:9 | 1440p | 24fps | 无缝循环 | 网页首屏动画

[人物锁定 · @image1] 完全按照该参考图呈现，不进行任何重新设计。金色卷发、闭合的双眼、仰起的面容与安详神情；象牙色垂坠长袍；左右两枚金色玫瑰花章肩甲，含中心宝石与放射浮雕；金丝胸饰、十字垂饰、多层珠链；水晶巨剑，含金色巴洛克护手与剑柄头、缠绕剑柄，双臂高举过头横持，金色火柱自上贯入；白色大理石圆台；下方云海；深蓝天空；身后刻满金色符文的巨大光环与放射状水晶碎片及其硬边 RGB 衍射。全片不得改动发型、面部、肩甲浮雕、胸饰、长袍轮廓、护手纹样与剑身比例。
她的双眼全片闭合，仅在 11.4 至 12.6 秒睁开，并在 15.0 秒前再次闭合。

[字形锁定 · @image2] 本片所有拉丁文字必须完全采用 @image2 的字形——相同的衬线结构、凿刻感收笔、字宽比例与字距，不得发明或替换字体。材质取自 @image2：抛光铬银，每一笔画的左上缘带温暖琥珀色轮廓光，细微倒角，细腻颗粒。

[解剖锁定 · 最高优先级] 全片自始至终只有两条手臂、两只手、每只手五指、一把剑。严禁多余的手臂、手掌、手指或第二把武器。快速旋转与运动模糊中，残影绝不可被渲染成额外肢体；手部每一帧结构完整、指节分明、无粘连。剑柄同时只被该拍指定的手握持；空出的手须明确可见且有清楚朝向。

[网页 UI/UX 系统 · 全片骨架] 画面按 12 栏网格构建，左右外边距各占画幅宽度 6%，栏间距 2%。
安全区：第 1 至 5 栏留空，供网页标题与行动按钮使用。人物、剑与光环全程不得进入第 1 至 4 栏。
视窗框：铬色发丝级四角框线于 1.4 秒延展到位并保持，每次转场轻微重新吸附，绝不重置。
载入指示：光环的进度弧兼作页面载入条——1.4 秒起步，7.8 秒约半圈，11.4 秒闭合爆亮，12.6 秒后逆向清空。
副环：三层同心符文环于 3.2 秒依次向外展开，以不同速度反向旋转。
准星：追踪剑身并随她运动持续修正，撞击时收紧。
数据列：画面右缘细长字形条滚动，速度随配乐加快。
计数器：持续攀升，9.6 秒跳动异常，11.4 秒爆红归零。
频谱条：环外一圈径向条形随音频脉动。
所有界面元素为铬色发丝线条与薄光，半透明，被水晶折射，统一笔画粗细，绝不越过面部，绝不进入第 1 至 4 栏。
缓动：所有界面与文字元素以缓出曲线入场，约 0.4 秒；退场约 0.25 秒。绝不线性，绝不弹跳。多元素之间错位约 0.06 秒。

[文字 · 稀少且为实体，绝非叠加] 全片只有四处文字，每一处都是场景中真实存在的物体，具备厚度、倒角、投影与光照响应，随镜头产生透视变形，被前景遮挡，被水晶折射。
以下引号内为画面实际渲染的文字，须原样呈现，不得翻译、不得替换、不得增删：
1.8秒 光环符文带上一段符文重组为 @image2 的字形 "ASCENSION"，呈深铬阴刻切入环体，随环旋转出画。
4.6秒 "SCROLL" 作为小号铬色标签，下方带一枚细箭头，居于画面下缘第 6 至 7 栏，轻微脉动。
12.8秒 首屏版式于第 1 至 5 栏组装：顶部一条铬色发丝导航横线与三个圆点；显示级 "ASCENSION"；其下一枚发丝圆角按钮内含小号 "ENTER"。保持 0.8 秒后整体溶解。
14.2秒 "CIA0" 以深铬阴刻切入符文带，刻痕深度、笔画宽度、边缘磨损与氧化程度与周围符文完全一致。绝不更亮、绝不更大、无发光、无描边。它随环体弧面产生透视变形，被前方水晶碎片局部遮挡，仅在侧光扫过的一瞬显现，在正光下几乎重新隐没于金属之中。
全片不出现任何日文字符、字幕或其他文字。

[色彩] 天空自顶部深海军蓝 #0B2350 至宝石蓝 #12356B，地平线转暖白 #F0E4CE。火柱核心过曝白，向外为浅金 #FFE9B0、琥珀 #FFD98A、橙金 #E8A63C，最外缘半透明热扰动。剑身自剑尖冷青 #9FD8E0 渐变至护手暖金，中段穿插全光谱色散带沿剑身流动。长袍受光面象牙白 #F5EDDC 至暖灰米 #C9BBA4，褶皱深处冷蓝影 #8C93A6。金属高光 #FFF0C0、中调 #E0B454、暗部 #8A6220、最暗带绿调，绝不平涂。日冕自内向外为白、金、琥珀、品红、靛蓝、透明六段。云海暖白 #FFF6E6 至灰蓝 #7E96B4 至紫蓝 #4A5A85。铬色文字与界面 #E8ECEF，带暖琥珀 #D9A05B 轮廓光。全光谱仅以折射形式出现，绝不平涂。

[风格与特效] 电影级手绘感 2.5D 动画，巴洛克式密度。胶片高光滚降，阴影提亮，最亮处柔和光晕，细腻颗粒，饱和浓郁不过曝。皮肤具次表面散射；金色为各向异性拉丝金属；水晶具真实色散；织物为多层布料解算，有惯性与回弹；头发逐丝渲染，逆光半透明。
特效逐级升级：碎片投出硬边 RGB 衍射光带；金色高光上的星芒光斑；火柱以翻腾丝带状降下；上帝之光穿透云海；碎片剥落光之羽；棱镜焦散在肩甲与胸饰上爬行；圆台由内发光；可见的冲击波畸变环；日冕绽放时短暂过曝再回落；空气中始终悬浮尘埃与晶屑。

[摄影] 变形宽银幕，椭圆焦外，蓝金双色条状光斑，180 度快门，轻微桶形畸变。每个镜头都有明确运动动机与前中后三层纵深——云絮、光之羽、晶屑或长袍一角始终位于前景制造视差。人物始终位于第 6 至 12 栏内。
0.0-1.4

@Hailuo_AI @Image1 微距置于水晶剑身内部，在晶体裂隙间穿行，光沿裂纹色散，随后自剑刃穿出进入开阔天空。
1.4-3.2 摇臂沿光环内缘攀升，符文自近及远依次点亮，透视强烈压缩。
3.2-4.6 35mm 弧形轨道绕至碎片之后，全光谱扫过镜头，她以逆光剪影浮现。
4.6-6.0 40mm 低角度缓推，火柱自画面顶部入画与剑尖相接，构图收束为首屏比例。
6.0-7.8 50mm 空中环绕，随她 180 度旋转同步绕行，斩击瞬间升格至四倍慢速再回落。
7.8-9.6 18mm 一镜到底随她坠落穿过光环，穿越时全光谱填满画面，绝不切。
9.6-11.4 焦段随拍点跳切，85mm 特写与 18mm 广角交替，中间插入一次甩镜。
11.4-12.6 摇臂升降加滑动变焦，由低仰角升至面部齐平，背景压缩感随之改变。
12.6-15.0 缓慢后拉，随后沿剑身推进再次进入水晶内部，与第一帧完全对位。
开场与收束段一律使用带光晕的溶解与镜头位移，绝不硬切；仅 9.6 至 11.4 秒使用硬切并加静音门。

[分镜]
0.0-1.4 循环点。镜头在水晶剑身内部穿行，裂纹、气泡与色散缓缓掠过，随后自剑刃穿出，天空豁然展开。四角框线开始延展。
1.4-3.2 点火。摇臂沿环内缘攀升，火沿环周逐个点亮符文奔跑一圈。1.8 秒处一段符文重组为深铬阴刻的 "ASCENSION" 并随环转出画。进度弧起步。
3.2-4.6 浮现。轨道绕至碎片之后，全光谱扫过镜头，她以剪影浮现，双手同握剑柄将剑垂于身前。三层符文环展开，数据列开始滚动。
4.6-6.0 举剑。双手将巨剑举过头顶横持，回到 @image1 姿态，下颌微仰，火柱降下与剑尖相接。"SCROLL" 落位于画面下缘。构图锁定为首屏比例。
6.0-7.8 接光。她将剑举迎向降下的火柱——由剑身承接，双手始终紧握剑柄绝不松手——随即全身旋转 180 度带出一记横斩。棱镜光爆炸开，UI 全线爆红。双眼仍闭合。
7.8-9.6 坠落。她背向下坠穿过光环中心，右手单手持剑于身侧缓慢旋转，左手向上伸展，长袍如伞面张开。一镜到底，穿越瞬间全光谱填满画面。
9.6-11.4 蒙太奇，八拍每拍 0.225 秒：一、白底铬色线稿，仅剑与双臂轮廓；二、平涂光谱色块拼贴；三、二色剪影，象牙白配纯金；四、完整渲染，一记真实的空中回旋；五、拖影帧，拉出长条残像；六、整帧负片反转，仅此一帧；七、铬色线稿叠加彩虹衍射；八、完整渲染并短暂静止。光与云的扰动八拍之间持续累积，绝不重置。
11.4-12.6 顶点。左手回握剑柄，双手同握将剑锋钉入虚空，冲击波向外扩散。她睁开双眼——青碧色，平静，直视镜头。睫毛先分离，眼睑上抬，瞳孔收缩后放大，泪膜捕捉火柱高光，眼角一道光。日冕绽放，进度弧闭合爆亮。
12.6-15.0 归位。她上升落回圆台，双臂举剑横于头顶回到 @image1 姿态，各环反向折叠，日冕收敛为一道金线，双眼闭合。首屏版式于左区组装、保持、溶解。"CIA0" 随环转入画面，被侧光扫过而显现，随后转入正光重新隐没。镜头沿剑身推进，再次进入水晶内部。最后一帧与第一帧完全一致。

[动态] 重量与优雅优先于摆姿势，动作连贯绝不生硬。长袍、卷发与垂带在每次转向时滞后，布料有真实惯性与回弹。巨剑沉重，挥动时可见承力与减速。一切略带高空浮力感。云层流动与人物动作互相影响。杜绝任何僵硬、停顿或不自然的关节角度。

[音频] 每个音效卡在其画面拍点的准确帧上，混音首尾相接可循环。底层：高空空气感，远处风声，极淡持续人声。
0.0-1.4 水晶内部的封闭共鸣，极轻的晶体应力声，穿出剑刃时空气骤然开阔。
1.4-3.2 符文逐个点亮的清脆金属点火声，沿环奔跑形成加速连音，合唱自远处涌起，铬色文字落定时一记低音。
3.2-4.6 全光谱扫过的高频泛音，布料舒展的柔和摩擦，副环展开的层叠环鸣。
4.6-6.0 举剑的低频蓄势，火柱降临的持续嗡鸣，剑尖相接时一声清亮长音。
6.0-7.8 撞击。管风琴与超低频同时落下，玻璃爆裂，反向镲片渐强，警报般明亮的界面爆红音。
7.8-9.6 坠落气压呼啸，入环骤然滤波为水下感合唱，穿出时爆发大空间混响。
9.6-11.4 八记打击声分别卡在八拍上，合唱断奏，每拍之间硬静音门，负片帧加一记反相金属噪音。
11.4-12.6 顶点。完整合唱、管风琴、钟声与一记低沉铜管齐鸣，睁眼那一帧落下一声清亮的钟，混音随日冕展宽。
12.6-15.0 收束为延长的合唱长音，各环以相反节奏收拢，最终回到与开场完全相同的水晶内部封闭共鸣。
无对白。

[限制] 画面中只有一个人物，两条手臂，两只手，一把剑。人物绝不进入第 1 至 4 栏。所有拉丁文字须完全匹配 @image2 的字形。"CIA0" 须准确拼写，绝不发光、描边、放大或比周围符文更亮。光谱仅以折射形式出现。界面层保持铬色发丝质感，绝不越过面部。特效持续累积直至归位段。双眼仅在 11.4 至 12.6 秒睁开。无日文字符、无品牌标识、无水印、无字幕。首尾帧完全一致，两帧中都不得残留任何浮动文字。.

description.zh: 同时定义玩家运动、武器操作、战场环境与 HUD 的第一人称军事游戏画面。

prompts.prompt: Camera: First-person perspective at eye level with authentic handheld player movement, as if recorded directly from a modern AAA military shooter. The player carries a highly detailed assault rifle with realistic animations, visible hands, tactical gloves, dynamic reload mechanics, and weapon sway.  **Opening Action:** The video immediately begins with the player already aiming down a roadway inside a modern military base. Multiple enemy soldiers are visible in the distance near sandbags, barricades, and military vehicles. The player carefully tracks one target, making small aim corrections while maintaining ADS (aim down sights). Fire several controlled bursts immediately at the visible enemies, producing realistic muzzle flashes, shell casings ejecting, smoke, recoil, hit reactions, and dust impacts around the targets. Continue firing in multiple short bursts while adjusting aim between enemies, simulating authentic FPS gameplay rather than scripted animation.  **Movement:** After the opening firefight, lower slightly from ADS and begin advancing cautiously along the road beside concrete barriers, Hesco walls, and parked military vehicles. Frequently check left and right corners, briefly stop to reacquire targets, then raise the weapon and fire additional controlled bursts whenever enemies appear ahead. Continue pushing forward with deliberate player-controlled movement, using cover naturally and maintaining believable tactical pacing.  **Environment:** Large modern military base with guard towers, armored vehicles, shipping containers, blast barriers, damaged buildings, smoke plumes, burning debris, scattered shell casings, dust clouds, and atmospheric battlefield haze. Cool natural daylight mixed with smoke and orange firelight creates a cinematic battlefield atmosphere.  **Camera Motion:** Authentic player-controlled movement with subtle head bob, weapon sway, natural mouse-look adjustments, small left-right corrections while aiming, realistic recoil, smooth tracking of moving targets, brief pauses before shooting, and fluid forward progression. Avoid cinematic camera moves—everything should feel like genuine live gameplay captured by a skilled player.  **Visual Quality:** Ultra-photorealistic, AAA game graphics with realistic PBR materials, detailed weapon models, physically accurate lighting, volumetric smoke, dynamic particle effects, crisp textures, realistic bullet impacts, muzzle flash illumination, motion blur only during rapid movement, and high-end military shooter presentation.  **Gameplay UI:** Display a realistic modern FPS HUD inspired by games like PUBG, Battlefield, or Call of Duty (without copying exact copyrighted assets). Include:  * Central dynamic crosshair or reticle * Ammo counter with magazine and reserve ammunition * Fire mode indicator * Compass at the top * Squad/team status panel * Mini-map in the upper corner * Health bar * Tactical equipment icons (grenades, medkit) * Hit markers when bullets connect * Directional damage indicators * Kill notification feed * Objective marker in the distance * Subtle interaction prompts and realistic HUD animations  The HUD should feel polished, modern, and fully integrated into the gameplay, enhancing the illusion of authentic recorded footage from a contemporary military FPS.

prompts.prompt:
@Arcane_Aii Using the attached reference image for the character and the attached audio track for timing, generate a jazz-noir anime title sequence in a stylized pop-art style. Every cut must land exactly on a beat of the audio — treat the track as the edit timeline.

VISUAL STYLE — apply throughout:
Render characters as flat, high-contrast black silhouettes against solid single-color backgrounds (saturated red, mustard yellow, deep blue). No naturalistic shading — each shot commits to one or two dominant colors only, like a screen-printed poster.

Compose shots like comic-book panels and pulp-magazine covers: bold panel divisions splitting the frame, hard geometric shapes, dramatic off-center cropping, extreme close-ups intercut with full-body poses.

Use freeze-frames as a core device: the character hits a dynamic pose (drawing a weapon, mid-stride, lighting a cigarette, turning toward camera) and the frame HOLDS completely still for one full beat before cutting. Do not smooth or interpolate through these holds — they must be dead stops.

Title typography in mid-century Saul Bass style: stark geometric letterforms, bold sans-serif, text that slides in as flat colored bars or snaps into frame on the beat.

Overlay the entire sequence with heavy analog film grain, slight gate weave, and worn-print color texture — it should look like a scratched 35mm print of a 1960s jazz album cover, not clean digital animation.

MOTION AND EDITING:
Alternate between two modes — (1) fast kinetic bursts of motion (whip pans across silhouettes, rapid cut sequences, a silhouette sprinting across a solid color field) and (2) hard freeze-frame holds. The contrast between the two IS the rhythm. Cuts are hard cuts only: no dissolves, no fades, no morphing between shots. Each new shot snaps in on the downbeat with a fresh background color.

End on the character in silhouette, frozen mid-pose against a solid red field, with the title card snapping in beside them on the final hit of the track.

真夏の明るい昼のビーチ。白い砂浜、透明感のある青い海、強い日差し、爽やかな風。
登場人物は20代前半の成人男女2人。健康的でおしゃれ、自然な笑顔、友達同士の軽快で爽やかな空気感。

ワイドショット。真夏のビーチ。男女2人が浅瀬を走りながら海へ入っていく。水しぶきがきらめく。爽快で青春感のある始まり。

女性の上半身寄り。女性が SPARKRUSH ULTRA FIZZ のボトルをカメラに向けて掲げ、爽やかに笑う。ボトルの青いラインと粒粒の炭酸デザインがしっかり見える。

SE：炭酸の鋭い開栓音

CUT5 0:08-0:10

男性がボトルを飲む寄りショット。冷えたボトルの水滴、喉を通る爽快感、飲んだ瞬間の刺激的で気持ちいい表情。

2人のツーショット。笑い合いながらボトルを持つ。自然な距離感、眩しい日差し、夏が弾けるような空気感。

男「夏って感じ！」

CUT7 0:12-0:14

海辺の商品イメージカット。手前または岩場近くに SPARKRUSH ULTRA FIZZ のボトル。背景の海ではイルカの群れが数頭ジャンプしている。爽やかで開放的な奇跡のような演出。海しぶきと太陽光がきらめく。

エンドカット。海を背にして並ぶ2人、または海辺に座る2人の後ろ姿。画面の手前または横に商品ボトルを大きく配置。最後は商品が主役。

prompts.prompt:
Create a 15-second, 16:9 photoreal cinematic action sequence with native stereo audio. Treat the five images as coordinated multimodal references for identity, vehicle design, environment, performance, action, cinematography, and sound.

Use Image 1 as the strict facial-identity reference for the female racer. Preserve her exact face, dark tied-back hair, amber goggles, dusty skin, black tactical suit, shoulder armor, gloves, and focused expression.

Use Image 2 as the strict reference for her full costume, body proportions, armored black dune buggy, tire scale, exposed suspension, cyan headlights, roll cage, desert lighting, and industrial-outpost background.

Use Image 3 as the action reference for the pursuing drones, vehicle speed, dust trails, fire, debris, chase intensity, and camera proximity.

Use Image 4 as the location reference for Outpost 07, including its rusted towers, pipelines, bridges, rocky terrain, distant mountains, warm sunset atmosphere, and industrial scale.

Use Image 5 as the cockpit and performance reference. Preserve the same steering wheel, open roll cage, goggles, gloves, facial identity, driving posture, and vehicle interior.

Sequence
[0–2.5 seconds]

Open on Image 4 with an extreme-wide aerial establishing shot of Outpost 07 at sunset. The industrial complex fills the right side of frame while an empty desert route curves through the rocky foreground.

The camera dives rapidly toward the road as a small black dune buggy bursts from beneath an elevated pipeline, throwing a long dust plume behind it.

Keep the vehicle moving consistently from left to right toward the outpost. No direction reversal.

Audio begins with dry desert wind, distant industrial machinery, a low cinematic pulse, and the buggy engine approaching rapidly.

[2.5–5 seconds]

Cut at peak engine sound to Image 5.

Tight frontal cockpit shot mounted just ahead of the driver. The vehicle shakes naturally over rough ground. Her hands hold the steering wheel firmly while she makes small, physically accurate corrections.

Her amber goggles remain on top of her head. Loose strands of hair and fabric straps react to wind and vibration. Her eyes briefly check the left mirror, then return immediately to the road.

A red warning light reflects across her face as a targeting alarm begins.

Do not make her turn the steering wheel excessively. Her body, wheel movement, and vehicle direction must remain mechanically connected.

[5–8 seconds]

Cut to a low front three-quarter tracking shot based on Image 3.

Three pursuit drones descend behind the buggy in a triangular formation. Their rotors, stabilizers, and body movement respond realistically to speed and turbulence.

The lead drone fires into the sand beside the buggy. The impact creates a narrow eruption of dirt, sparks, and fragmented rock rather than an oversized fireball.

The racer steers sharply around the impact. The buggy’s front wheels turn first, the suspension compresses, the body leans, and the rear tires slide outward before regaining traction.

The camera tracks beside the vehicle without spinning or overtaking it.

[8–11 seconds]
Continue the same drift into a rear three-quarter shot.

The buggy races toward a narrowing passage between a rock wall and the outer structures of Outpost 07. The racer pulls a mechanical handbrake lever for one brief moment, rotating the vehicle through the opening.

One drone follows too closely and clips a rusted overhead pipe. Its wing breaks, sending the drone tumbling into the sand behind her.

Show the collision in the background while keeping the buggy dominant and moving forward. No slow motion.

Audio: tire scrape, suspension impact, metal tearing, drone rotors failing, engine rev rising.

[11–13 seconds]

Cut to a wheel-level macro shot.

The right rear tire bites into loose sand. Stones fire backward while the suspension rebounds. The camera rises naturally along the buggy’s side and reveals the two remaining drones closing in.

The racer presses a guarded switch beside the steering wheel.

A compact rear-mounted electromagnetic pulse discharges as a restrained blue-white distortion wave, briefly disrupting the drones’ lights and stabilizers.

No magical energy, lightning storm, or giant explosion.

[13–15 seconds]
Cut to a low frontal hero shot as the buggy clears the outpost gate at full speed.

The two disabled drones fall into the dust behind it while the vehicle launches from a shallow ridge. Keep the jump low, heavy, and physically believable.

During the brief airborne moment, cut to Image 1 for a tight close-up of the racer. Preserve her exact identity as warm firelight and cool dashboard light cross her face. Her expression remains controlled and determined.

The buggy lands hard beyond the gate. The suspension compresses, the engine roars, and the vehicle continues directly into the desert.

End with a sharp cut to black on the landing impact.

Visual Direction
Premium live-action science-fiction action trailer with realistic CGI integration, warm orange sunset light, restrained steel-blue technology accents, dusty atmosphere, hard surface detail, cinematic contrast, subtle film grain, realistic motion blur, and 24 FPS movement.

Use wide shots to establish scale, cockpit close-ups for tension, low tracking shots for speed, and mechanical macro shots for physical detail.

Keep the editing fast but readable. Every shot must begin from the physical state established by the previous shot.

Audio Direction
Native stereo sound with:
Aggressive combustion engine
Tire friction over sand and rock
Suspension rattles and chassis vibration
Drone rotors and targeting alarms
Sand impacts, metal collisions, and falling debris
Low percussion and rising electronic tension
One heavy bass impact on the final landing

Keep music underneath the vehicle and environmental sounds. No dialogue or voice-over.

Restrictions

[00:00-00:03] 开局试探
手机视角越过前排观众的后脑勺拍向拳台：铃声"铛"一响，两人从各自角落逼近，主角1压低重心左右晃动寻找角度，主角2双拳护脸小步游走，两人互相试探刺拳，拳套相碰发出闷响。

[00:03-00:07] 第一波对攻
拍摄者猛推数码变焦怼近：主角1突进一记左刺拳接右摆拳，主角2侧头闪过、贴身回敬两记摆拳组合，两人拳套砰砰互击、汗珠在顶灯下甩出，画面因变焦过快糊了半秒又对上焦。
【现场音】拳套击打的连续闷响、观众爆发的"哦——！"、拍摄者忍不住的一声"卧槽"。

[00:07-00:10] 缠斗与遮挡
两人进入贴身缠斗互相抱架，裁判上前分开——此时前排观众激动起身，手机画面被后脑勺挡住一瞬，拍摄者手忙脚乱举高手机越过人头继续拍：两人分开各退半步，主角2抹了把脸，主角1活动了下脖子。
【现场音】裁判喊"Break！"，人群骚动声浪盖过一切。

[00:10-00:13] 高潮重击

【现场音】重击一声爆响后观众声浪掀顶，拍摄者激动大吼，手机剧烈晃动。

[00:13-00:15] 终场定格
画面抖着拉回全景：裁判冲上前查看，主角1退到中立角高举双拳，台下无数手机屏幕的亮光连成星海，拍摄者边喊边把镜头怼向台上，画面在主角1振臂的糊焦瞬间定格。
【现场音】欢呼、口哨、有人狂拍前座椅背，收束在鼎沸人声里。

【备注】全片保持手机直出的粗粝感：允许过曝的顶灯、糊焦、拖影和构图歪斜，禁止任何电影感调色和稳定器丝滑运镜；击打动作写意图和结果（命中、踉跄、坐地），保持竞技体育范畴，无出血无伤情特写

prompts.prompt:
The Brief: "Jessy x RadiantGlo"

15 seconds. One face, one mask, one ritual — quiet luxury skincare.

Jessy stands at her mirror at night, cool blue light on her skin, studying her reflection before she says a word. Final beat: the mask alone on a matte surface, LEDs still glowing, logo catching the light — hero shot. Fade to black.

Cold nights fading into warm dawn color science throughout — think a skincare brand's flagship campaign, not an infomercial. Same face, same mask, same world, held together across every cut.
